english:
Alexandrovskaya Sloboda grew into a princely residence amid the forests northeast of Moscow. From 1505 it served Grand Prince Vasily III as a country seat, with churches and royal buildings enclosed in the fortified residence. Its greatest political importance came under his son Ivan IV, who withdrew here with his court and sacred objects from Moscow in December 1564.

Ivan's departure set the stage for the establishment of the #italic oprichnina#!, the separate domain and apparatus through which the tsar pursued his enemies. For years the Sloboda served as his residence and a centre of government: the boyar council and administrative offices operated there, and envoys came to the court. From here Ivan set out on his devastating campaign against Novgorod. The Vasily Gates, taken from Novgorod's Saint Sophia Cathedral, later adorned the entrance to the Sloboda's cathedral. The settlement's role as a royal seat ended in 1581, but its churches and walls retained the imprint of the years when power was exercised from this retreat. In 1778 it became the town of Alexandrov.
simp_chinese:
亚历山德罗夫斯卡亚斯洛博达在莫斯科东北的森林中发展为王公驻地。1505年起，它成为瓦西里三世大公的乡间居所，设防驻地内有教堂和王室建筑。其政治地位在他的儿子伊凡四世统治时达到顶峰：1564年12月，沙皇带着宫廷及圣物离开莫斯科，迁到这里。

伊凡的离去为建立沙皇特辖区铺平了道路。沙皇通过这一独立领地和机构追击自己的敌人。此后多年，斯洛博达既是他的居所，也是政府中心：贵族会议和行政机构在此运作，外国使节也来到宫廷。伊凡从这里出发，对诺夫哥罗德发动了毁灭性的征讨。从诺夫哥罗德圣索菲亚主教座堂取走的瓦西里门，后来装饰了斯洛博达主教座堂的入口。1581年，聚落作为沙皇驻地的时期结束，但教堂和城墙保留了权力从这处居所发出的岁月印记。1778年，它成为亚历山德罗夫城镇。

english: Alexandrovskoye grew from a Russian fortress between the Bolshoy and Maly Tomuzlov streams on the North Caucasian steppe. Founded in 1777, the stronghold formed part of the Azov–Mozdok line, a chain of forts intended to secure Russia's southern frontier. Cossack families settled beside the garrison. In 1785 the fortress became the town of Alexandrov and the centre of a district. Its place on the line linked the Kuma country with the forts farther west and the passes toward the Caucasus.
simp_chinese: 亚历山德罗夫斯科耶由北高加索草原上大、小托穆兹洛夫溪之间的一座俄罗斯要塞发展而来。1777年建立的据点属于亚速—莫兹多克防线，这条要塞链旨在巩固俄罗斯的南部边疆。哥萨克家庭在驻军旁定居。1785年，要塞改为亚历山德罗夫城，成为地区中心。它在防线上的位置连接库马河地区、西方诸要塞与通向高加索的道路。

english:
Alexeyevka lies on the Tikhaya Sosna, a river of the Don basin. It began as a sloboda settled by Ukrainian Cossacks from Bohuslav in the late seventeenth century, on lands belonging to the Russian southern frontier. Further settlers followed from Ukrainian lands, and the settlement passed into the possession of the Cherkassky princes and later the Sheremetev family.

In 1829 Daniil Bokarev, a local serf, pressed oil from sunflower seeds with a hand-operated press. The experiment gave a new use to a plant originally brought from America. In 1833 the merchant Papushin, assisted by Bokarev, opened a horse-powered oil mill in the sloboda; Bokarev established his own the following year. Sunflower oil would become closely associated with Alexeyevka and its surrounding fields.
simp_chinese:
阿列克谢耶夫卡位于顿河流域的季哈亚索斯纳河畔。十七世纪末，来自博胡斯拉夫的乌克兰哥萨克人在俄罗斯南部边疆的土地上建立了这座斯洛博达。后来又有乌克兰各地的移民来到此处，聚落先后归切尔卡斯基亲王家族和舍列梅捷夫家族所有。

1829年，当地农奴丹尼尔·博卡廖夫用手动压榨机从向日葵种子中榨出油，为这种原产美洲的植物找到新的用途。1833年，商人帕普申在博卡廖夫协助下在聚落开设了一座马力榨油坊；次年博卡廖夫也建立了自己的作坊。向日葵油后来成为阿列克谢耶夫卡和周围田野的鲜明特色。

english: Alexeyevskaya is a Cossack stanitsa on the Buzuluk, a tributary of the Khopyor. In 1700 the ataman Pakhom Sergeyev named it among the Cossack and watch towns on the Buzuluk, Khopyor and Medveditsa. The settlement first stood on the Buzuluk's right bank, but a severe flood in 1764 led its inhabitants to move to the left bank. Such moves were familiar along the rivers of the Don Host, where spring waters repeatedly forced communities to seek safer ground.
simp_chinese: 阿列克谢耶夫斯卡亚是霍皮奥尔河支流布祖卢克河上的哥萨克村社。1700年，阿塔曼帕霍姆·谢尔盖耶夫报告布祖卢克河、霍皮奥尔河和梅德韦季察河上的哥萨克及守望城镇时提到了此地。聚落最初位于布祖卢克河右岸；1764年的严重洪水迫使居民迁往左岸。在顿河军团的河流沿岸，春汛屡次迫使社区寻找更安全的地点，这样的迁移并不少见。

english:
Alfambra stands on a red-clay landscape in the province of Teruel, Aragon. Its name comes from the Arabic al-hamra, “the red (town),” a reference to the deep red clay beneath the settlement. Archaeology at Peña Dorada and El Castillo traces occupation in the immediate area to the Bronze Age, while the town's recorded political history becomes clearer under Muslim rule. A castle from that period was regarded by several authors as one of the most important in southern Aragon, though only limited remains survive; excavated finds are held in the local museum.

Alfonso II of Aragon captured Alfambra in 1169. A charter followed in 1174, when the place was entrusted to the recently founded Military Order of the Holy Redeemer, also known as Montegaudio. From 1196 until the order's dissolution, it served as a commandery of the Knights Templar. Between 1488 and 1495 it belonged to the sobrecullida of Teruel. Red earth, fortress remains and successive lordships show how geography and changing political authority shaped the same small frontier community.
simp_chinese:
阿尔凡布拉位于阿拉贡特鲁埃尔省的红土地景观中。地名来自阿拉伯语 al-hamra，意为“红城”，指聚落下方深厚的红色黏土。佩尼亚多拉达与埃尔卡斯蒂略的考古遗存把附近的人类活动追溯到青铜时代，而城镇的政治历史在穆斯林统治时期更加清楚。多位作者认为，当时修建的城堡是南阿拉贡最重要的要塞之一；仅有少量残迹留存，出土文物保存在地方博物馆。

1169年，阿拉贡的阿方索二世攻占阿尔凡布拉。1174年颁发特许状后，这里被交给新近成立的圣救世主军事修会，也称蒙特高迪奥修会。1196年起至该修会解散，阿尔凡布拉成为圣殿骑士团辖地。1488至1495年，它属于特鲁埃尔征税区。红土、要塞遗存与连续更替的领主权力，显示地理环境和政治权威如何共同塑造同一座小型边疆社区。

english: Alfeld stands on the Leine, south of Hildesheim, and was recorded as Alvelde in the early thirteenth century. Beer, hops, linen and yarn brought prosperity to this small town in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries. In 1426 Alfeld joined the Saxon League of Towns, becoming indirectly connected to the Hanseatic League. It passed from the bishopric of Hildesheim to Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel after the diocesan feud of 1519–1523. The period before the Thirty Years' War brought further economic and cultural growth, marked by the town hall built in 1586.
simp_chinese: 阿尔费尔德位于希尔德斯海姆以南的莱讷河畔，十三世纪初以阿尔费尔德之名见于记载。十四至十五世纪，啤酒、啤酒花、亚麻布和纱线贸易为这座小城带来繁荣。1426年，它加入萨克森城市联盟，间接成为汉萨网络的一部分。1519至1523年的主教领争斗后，阿尔费尔德从希尔德斯海姆主教领转归不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔。三十年战争之前，当地经济与文化继续发展，1586年建成的市政厅便是这一时期的标志。

english: Alfenas lies in the rolling country of southern Minas Gerais. Its early settlement grew around a chapel dedicated to Saint Joseph and Our Lady of Sorrows, built at the turn of the nineteenth century. Local accounts differ over the precise date of the first chapel, but by the early 1800s land had been donated for the religious community that became the centre of the settlement.
simp_chinese: 阿尔费纳斯位于米纳斯吉拉斯南部起伏的丘陵地区。早期聚落围绕十九世纪前后兴建的一座小教堂发展，教堂供奉圣若瑟和忧苦圣母。当地记载对首座教堂的确切年代有所分歧，但十九世纪初已有土地捐给宗教社区，成为聚落的中心。

english:
Alferovskaya is a village in the forested north of Vologda country, in the lands historically known as Totma and Ustye, between the Sukhona basin and the upper reaches of the Northern Dvina. This is northern taiga where settlements were separated by woodland, tracks and rivers, and where villages, usually named for a founder or his family, formed a sparse chain along streams and portage routes.

Russian settlers from Novgorod and from Rostov and Suzdal moved into this country over the centuries. Totma was first recorded in 1137 and became known for its salt works, while Veliky Ustyug at the junction of the Sukhona and the Yug was recorded in 1207. After 1553 the Sukhona and the Dvina carried English and Dutch trade toward Arkhangelsk, and the peasants of villages like Alferovskaya farmed, fished and cut timber along the same routes.
simp_chinese:
阿尔费罗夫斯卡亚是沃洛格达地区北部森林中的一座村庄，位于历史上称作托季马和乌斯季耶的地带，处在苏霍纳河流域与北德维纳河上游之间。这里是北方针叶林，聚落之间隔着林地、土路和河流，村庄多以创建者或其家族命名，沿溪流和陆路联运线路零星排列。

数百年间，来自诺夫哥罗德以及罗斯托夫—苏兹达尔的俄罗斯移民陆续进入这片土地。托季马最早见于1137年的记载，以盐场闻名；苏霍纳河与尤格河交汇处的大乌斯秋格则见于1207年的记载。1553年以后，苏霍纳河与德维纳河载着英国和荷兰的贸易通向阿尔汉格尔斯克，阿尔费罗夫斯卡亚这样的村庄里的农民沿同样的路线耕作、捕鱼和采伐木材。

english:
Alfta lies in the historic province of Hälsingland, in a valley of forested hills and small rivers in central Sweden. The Voxna valley provided a route from the coast toward inland forests and marshes. Lakes, streams and cleared ground gave the region water, hay and access to hunting and fishing, while long winters limited the farming season.

Iron Age farmers left slag, graves and a furnace near the river, showing that the valley belonged to a settled rural landscape before written records. A large hoard containing Arabic silver coins from the eighth century and nearby Viking-era burials point to connections through the Baltic and Russian river routes. These objects did not make Alfta a town, but they show that inland Hälsingland took part in long-distance exchange.

During the Middle Ages, Alfta became the church village of its parish and an administrative centre for a scattered farming population. The church, local assembly and roads to neighbouring parishes gave the community a stable focus. By the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, ironworking, tar production, forestry and livestock supplemented agriculture. Farms remained dispersed around the village, while the parish system linked forest settlements to the regional economy.
simp_chinese:
阿尔夫塔位于瑞典中部海尔辛兰的森林丘陵谷地。沃克斯纳河谷从海岸通向内地森林和沼泽。湖泊、溪流与开垦地提供饮水、干草、狩猎和捕鱼条件，漫长冬季又限制农耕季节。

铁器时代农民在河边留下矿渣、墓葬和一座熔炉，说明书面记载以前这里已有定居农业。当地一处窖藏包含两百枚八世纪阿拉伯银币，附近还有维京时代墓葬，反映内地海尔辛兰通过波罗的海和俄罗斯河路参与远距离交换。这些遗物没有使阿尔夫塔成为城镇，却显示其贸易联系。

中世纪时，阿尔夫塔成为堂区教堂村和分散农业人口的行政中心。教堂、地方会议与通往邻区堂区的道路赋予社群稳定核心。十六、十七世纪，冶铁、焦油生产、林业和畜牧补充农业，农庄仍散布村外，堂区制度把森林聚落纳入区域经济。

english:
Alghero is a fortified port on Sardinia's northwestern coast. The Genoese Doria family established the town in the early twelfth century, and its harbour grew within the world of the Italian maritime republics. Later settlers from the Crown of Aragon left a lasting Catalan language and culture in the city.

After the Aragonese conquest, Peter IV encouraged families from Catalonia, Valencia, Majorca and Aragon to settle in Alghero. They replaced the earlier inhabitants, some of whom were carried away as slaves. In the early sixteenth century the town gained recognition as a bishopric and a royal city, and its economy grew. It passed with Sardinia to the House of Savoy in 1720; a famine provoked a revolt in 1821 that was harshly suppressed.
simp_chinese:
阿尔盖罗是撒丁岛西北岸的一座设防港口。热那亚的多里亚家族于十二世纪初建立此城，港口在意大利海上共和国的世界中发展。后来来自阿拉贡王冠领地的移民在这里留下了持久的加泰罗尼亚语言和文化。

阿拉贡征服后，佩德罗四世鼓励来自加泰罗尼亚、瓦伦西亚、马略卡和阿拉贡的家庭迁居阿尔盖罗。他们取代了原有居民，其中一些人被掳为奴隶。十六世纪初，城镇获得主教驻地和王室城市的地位，经济也得到发展。1720年，它随撒丁岛归入萨伏依家族；1821年饥荒引发的起义遭到严厉镇压。

english:
Algiers rose from the old settlement of Jazair Bani Mazghanna on the bay of the same name, refounded in 972 by Buluggin ibn Ziri. In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries it was a modest port in the kingdom of Tlemcen, and the Thaaliba emirs held the Mitidja plain behind it. After the Moors were expelled from Spain many sought refuge here, and in 1510 the Spaniards under Pedro Navarro fortified the Peñón, a rocky islet off the harbour, and made the emir swear obedience to Ferdinand of Aragon.

In 1516 the emir Selim b. Teumi invited the corsair brothers Oruç Reis and Hayreddin Barbarossa to drive the Spaniards out. Oruç killed the emir and seized the town, and Hayreddin, who lost it in 1524 and took the Peñón in 1529, offered Algiers to Suleiman the Magnificent. From then on it was the chief seat of the Barbary corsairs, and when Charles V attacked with some 30,000 men in October 1541 a storm wrecked his fleet and the pasha Hassan defeated the army. In 1556 a citadel was built at the highest point of the city wall.

By the seventeenth century as much as 40 percent of its 100,000 inhabitants were enslaved Europeans, and the writer Miguel de Cervantes was held here for almost five years. The upper city, al-Gabal, was a maze of Andalusian, Jewish, Moorish and Kabyle quarters, and the lower city held the Ottoman dignitaries and the markets. A British squadron under Lord Exmouth bombarded the harbour on 27 August 1816, and in 1830 a French fleet and army ended the rule of the dey.
simp_chinese:
阿尔及尔起源于同名海湾边的旧聚落“杰扎伊尔·贝尼·马兹加纳”，972年由布卢金·伊本·兹里重建。14至15世纪，它是特莱姆森王国治下的一座小港，身后的米提贾平原由萨阿利巴人的埃米尔控制。摩尔人被逐出西班牙后，许多人来此避难；1510年，佩德罗·纳瓦罗率领的西班牙人在港外的岩石小岛佩尼翁筑垒，并迫使埃米尔向阿拉贡的斐迪南宣誓效忠。

1516年，埃米尔塞利姆·本·特乌米邀请海盗兄弟奥鲁奇·雷斯和海雷丁·巴巴罗萨驱逐西班牙人。奥鲁奇杀死埃米尔，占据了城镇；海雷丁1524年失去此城，1529年夺取佩尼翁后，向苏莱曼大帝献上了阿尔及尔。此后它成为巴巴里海盗的主要巢穴。1541年10月，查理五世率约3万人来攻，风暴摧毁了舰队，总督哈桑击败了他的军队。1556年，城墙最高处建起一座城堡。

到17世纪，10万居民中多达四成是被奴役的欧洲人，作家塞万提斯曾在这里被关押近五年。上城“加巴勒”是安达卢西亚人、犹太人、摩尔人和卡拜尔人的街区迷宫，下城则是奥斯曼权贵和市场所在。1816年8月27日，埃克斯茅斯勋爵率领的英国舰队炮轰港口；1830年，法国舰队和军队结束了德伊的统治。

english: Alhambra stands on an isolated hill in the Campo de Montiel, where its castle overlooked routes across the plains of La Mancha. The site was occupied in Roman times and later became a Muslim stronghold. After the Christian victory at Las Navas de Tolosa, the fortress was taken in 1213 and passed into the hands of the Order of Santiago. The order controlled the surrounding district before its lands were divided among other military orders, diminishing the castle's strategic role.
simp_chinese: 阿尔罕布拉坐落在蒙铁尔地区的一座孤丘上，城堡俯瞰横穿拉曼恰平原的道路。此地在罗马时代已有居民，后来成为穆斯林要塞。基督徒在纳瓦斯德托洛萨取胜后，堡垒于1213年被攻取，随后转入圣地亚哥骑士团之手。骑士团曾掌管周围辖区，后来土地被分给其他军事修会，城堡的战略地位随之下降。

english:
Ali Sabieh lies in an enclosed valley in southern Djibouti, where granitic mountains surround the site and the ground stands about 756 metres above sea level. The higher elevation moderates the heat compared with the coast, while the hot semi-arid climate still brings long, dry summers. To the east, grassland savannah attracts gazelles, jackals, caracals, baboons and many birds. These mountains and pastures give the location a basin setting at once sheltered and exposed to scarce rainfall.

The valley lies in the wider meeting zone of Somali Issa and Afar societies, connected by routes toward the Ethiopian highlands, the Red Sea coast and the Gulf of Aden. Wells, grazing and seasonal movement guided passage through this dry country. Muslim traders and teachers had reached the Horn of Africa long before European ships rounded it, and Islam became a lasting part of local identity.

The medieval Muslim sultanate of Ifat, whose traders used the port of Zeila, drew on the same belt of pasture and caravan track between the highlands and the coast. The location's identity lies in the mountain basin and the pastoral routes of camel, sheep and goat herders that connected coast and highlands.

The later city of Djibouti City lies here.
simp_chinese:
阿里萨比赫位于吉布提南部一处封闭谷地，周围花岗岩山地环绕，地面海拔约七百五十六米。较高地势使这里比海岸温和，但炎热半干旱气候仍带来漫长干燥的夏季。东侧草原吸引瞪羚、黑背胡狼、狞猫、狒狒和多种鸟类，山地与牧场共同构成一处既受遮蔽、又承受稀少降水的盆地。

谷地位于索马里伊萨人与阿法尔人社会交汇的更广区域，道路通向埃塞俄比亚高原、红海海岸和亚丁湾。水井、牧场与季节性迁徙决定人们如何穿过这片干旱土地。在欧洲船只驶入附近海域以前，穆斯林商人和教师早已抵达非洲之角，伊斯兰信仰因而成为当地身份的长期组成部分。

中世纪信奉伊斯兰教的伊法特苏丹国，其商人经泽拉港出入，利用的正是高原与海岸之间的这条牧场和商队通道。这里的身份来自山地盆地，以及骆驼、绵羊和山羊牧民连接海岸与高原的牧道。

后来的吉布提市即位于此地。

english: Aliabad-e Katul lies between the Gorgan plain and the wooded northern slopes of the eastern Alborz. Streams descend through forested valleys toward the lowlands, where the mountains give way to cultivated ground. Pottery from the nearby Shoghal Tepe mound bears witness to settlement in the Sasanian and Islamic periods, long before the growth of the town that came to occupy the area.
simp_chinese: 阿里阿巴德卡图勒位于戈尔甘平原与东厄尔布尔士山脉森林茂密的北坡之间。溪流穿过林木覆盖的山谷流向低地，山地在这里逐渐让位于耕地。附近沙加尔丘出土的陶器，见证了萨珊和伊斯兰时期的人类居住，远早于后来在此发展起来的城镇。

english:
Alibey Lagoon occupies the old mouth of the Khadzhyder River on the Black Sea coast of Bessarabia. It is shallow and saline, about fifteen kilometres long and eleven wide, with an average depth of only two and a half metres. A sand bar separates it from the sea, while narrow channels connect it through the Kurudiol Lagoon with the Burnas, Shagany and Karachaus lagoons.

Fresh river water, seawater seeping through the bar and strong evaporation produced changing salinity, making the lagoon a meeting place for fish, waterbirds and the people who fished the coastal lakes and gathered salt from the shore. The lagoon lay within the Bessarabian borderlands contested by the Ottoman Empire, the Crimean Khanate and the Russian Empire, near the Ottoman fortress of Akkerman on the Dniester estuary. Control of the Danube mouths and the coastal corridor gave strategic weight to places that were physically slight. The shallow basin and its linked lagoons lay on the Danube-Dniester route, where grain, salt and river traffic moved between inland markets and Black Sea shipping.
simp_chinese:
阿里贝伊潟湖位于比萨拉比亚黑海沿岸，占据哈吉德尔河的旧河口。湖泊浅而咸，长约十五公里、宽约十一公里，平均水深仅二点五米。沙坝把它与外海隔开，狭窄水道又经库鲁迪奥尔潟湖，把它同布尔纳斯、沙加尼和卡拉恰乌斯等潟湖连接起来。

河水、渗过沙坝的海水与强烈蒸发共同改变盐度，使湖泊成为鱼群、水鸟、沿海渔民以及在岸边采盐者汇聚之地。阿里贝伊潟湖处在奥斯曼帝国、克里米亚汗国与俄罗斯帝国长期争夺的比萨拉比亚边地，附近是德涅斯特河口的奥斯曼要塞阿克曼。多瑙河口与沿海走廊赋予这些浅水地以战略意义。这片浅水湖盆及其相连的潟湖位于多瑙河—德涅斯特河路线上，谷物、盐与河运货物经此往来内陆市场与黑海船只。

english: Aligudarz lies in the eastern Zagros, among the cold highlands and valleys of Lorestan. Mountains such as Tamandar rise above the Borborud country, while oak woods cover parts of the surrounding slopes. The district belongs to the lands of the Bakhtiari Lurs, whose communities moved between mountain pastures and lower country with the seasons. Streams descend through the rugged valleys toward the rivers of Khuzestan.
simp_chinese: 阿里古达尔位于扎格罗斯山脉东部、卢里斯坦寒冷的高地与谷地之间。塔曼达尔等山峰耸立在博尔博鲁德地区之上，周围部分山坡覆盖着橡树林。这里属于巴赫蒂亚里卢尔人的土地，他们的社群随季节往返于山地牧场与低地之间。溪流穿过崎岖山谷，流向胡齐斯坦的河流。

english: Aly lies on the left side of the Bytantay valley in the mountainous heart of the Verkhoyansk country. The Bytantay drains the eastern slopes of the range and joins the Yana farther north. Forested valleys and high ridges mark this remote part of northern Yakutia, where long winters and brief summers govern the river. The Yana carries the waters of these mountains onward to the Laptev Sea.
simp_chinese: 阿利位于上扬斯克山地腹地的贝坦泰河谷左侧。贝坦泰河汇集山脉东坡的水流，在更北方注入亚纳河。森林河谷与高山脊构成雅库特北部这片偏远地区的景观，漫长冬季和短暂夏季支配河流。亚纳河将山地水流继续送往拉普捷夫海。

english: Alikovo, known in Chuvash as Alikasy, lies in the countryside southwest of Cheboksary. Its name is associated with the personal name Alik and the Chuvash word for a settlement. A document of 1694 records the village among lands granted to the Dormition Monastery of Cheboksary. A wooden Church of the Dormition was built in 1744, and the village was also known by the church's name, Uspenskoye.
simp_chinese: 阿利科沃在楚瓦什语中称阿利卡瑟，位于切博克萨雷西南的乡村。地名与人名阿利克及楚瓦什语中表示聚落的词有关。1694年的文书记载该村属于赐予切博克萨雷圣母安息修道院的土地。1744年，村中建起木造圣母安息教堂，此地也因此被称为乌斯片斯科耶。

english: Alinchak lies on the Alaska Peninsula, where the volcanic Aleutian Range rises near Mount Chiginagak and the Aniakchak caldera. Aniakchak has erupted at least forty times in the last ten thousand years, and its crater, about ten kilometres across, sits in the same chain of peaks. The Koniag Alutiiq of the peninsula belonged to the same Alutiiq world as the people of Kodiak, whose coast the Russian fur trade reached in 1784.
simp_chinese: 阿林查克位于阿拉斯加半岛上，附近是由火山构成的阿留申山脉，奇吉纳加克山与阿尼亚克恰克火山口都在这一山链之中。阿尼亚克恰克在过去一万年中至少喷发过四十次，火山口宽约十公里。半岛上的科尼亚格阿卢提克人与科迪亚克群岛的人同属阿卢提克世界，俄国毛皮贸易于1784年抵达科迪亚克海岸。

english:
Alirajpur stands in the hills of western Madhya Pradesh, near the borders with Gujarat and Maharashtra, in the Bhil country south of Malwa and north of the Narmada valley. Its landscape of rocky ridges, teak and mahua woods, and small millet and maize fields has long been the homeland of Bhil and Bhilala villagers, whose scattered hamlets kept to the forested heights while roads ran through the valleys into neighbouring regions.

The state of Alirajpur took its name from the fort of Ali and the settlement of Rajpur. Its ruling family claimed Rathore descent from the royal house of Jodhpur, though that claim was not accepted by Jodhpur, and its early history is unclear, with the founder named either as Anand Deo or Ude Deo. Anand Deo is dated to 1437, and he and his successors ruled as Ranas over a small hill territory, balancing Bhil chiefs, the sultans of Malwa and later the Mughals, Marathas and neighbouring Rajput states. The state came under British protection in 1817.

About five kilometres away, the Panchalingeshwar Mahadev temple is carved directly from stone, with small shrines and figures of deities cut into the rock. Its form reflects the region's craft traditions and Hindu religious landscape. Alirajpur's character comes from this meeting of hill settlement, Bhil village life, Rajput lordship and carved stone.
simp_chinese:
阿里拉杰布尔位于中央邦西部的丘陵地带，靠近古吉拉特邦和马哈拉施特拉邦边界，处在马尔瓦以南、讷尔默达河谷以北的比尔人地区。这里岩脊起伏，有柚木和马华树林，以及小块的小米和玉米田，长期是比尔人和比拉拉人的家园；分散的村落依附在森林覆盖的高地上，道路则穿过谷地通向邻近地区。

阿里拉杰布尔邦的名称来自阿里堡和拉杰布尔聚落。统治家族自称是焦特布尔王室的拉索尔后裔，但焦特布尔并不承认这一说法；早期历史并不清楚，创建者被说成安纳德·德奥或乌德·德奥。安纳德·德奥被系于1437年，他和继任者以拉纳的身份统治一片狭小的山地领地，在比尔首领、马尔瓦苏丹，以及后来的莫卧儿、马拉塔和邻近拉杰普特诸邦之间周旋。该邦于1817年归入英国保护之下。

城北约五公里处，潘查林盖什瓦尔·马哈德夫神庙直接在岩石上雕出，包含小神殿和神像，反映地方石作传统与印度教景观。丘陵聚落、比尔人的村落生活、拉杰普特领主制和石雕共同塑造了阿里拉杰布尔的地方性格。

english:
Alishang names a village, a river, and a fertile valley northwest of Jalalabad in Laghman Province, eastern Afghanistan. The Alishang River, also called the Nadjil, rises on the southern slopes of the Hindu Kush, runs for about ninety miles, and joins the Alinghar at the village. The Alinghar is known as the Kow and has its own mountain records. In some narrow reaches the river can be forded by a rider who dismounts from the horse. This water network supports cultivated land, settlement, and movement through a valley framed by hills and mountains.

The valley's history appears in Mughal records. Babur camped at Alishang in the 1520s and hunted wildlife in the neighbouring mountains before returning toward India. Such descriptions show a place defined by its position between Kabul, Jalalabad, and mountain communities.

Floods, snowfall, and drought have also shaped the district, with agricultural land, crops, and animals vulnerable to natural hazards. The fertile valley remains an agricultural corridor among the Badrow hills. Its cluster of settlements follows the river, and the ruins or standing castles of local leaders recall the authority attached to control of land and roads. The meadows and forest margin, along with the river's seasonal force, make Alishang a route and a livelihood as much as a single village.
simp_chinese:
阿利尚是阿富汗东部拉格曼省的一组名称，同时指贾拉拉巴德西北的村庄、河流和肥沃谷地。阿利尚河又称纳吉勒河，发源于兴都库什山南坡，流程约九十英里，在阿利尚村汇入阿林加尔河。阿林加尔河也称科河，同样源自山地。部分狭窄河段必须下马才能涉水而过，这组水系因此支撑耕地、聚落与谷地交通。

谷地历史见于莫卧儿文献。十六世纪二十年代，巴布尔在阿利尚扎营，并在周围山地狩猎后返回印度方向。这些记录说明阿利尚处于喀布尔、贾拉拉巴德与山地社区之间。

洪水、降雪和干旱也影响该区，农田、作物和牲畜都面对自然风险。肥沃谷地仍是巴德罗丘陵间的农业走廊，聚落沿河排列，地方首领的城堡或遗迹则反映控制土地和道路的权力。草场、森林边缘与季节变化强烈的河流，使阿利尚兼具交通通道和生活空间的双重意义。

english:
Aliskerovo occupies broken hill and taiga country in western Chukotka, between the Maly Anyuy basin and the Ilirney and Kyrganay ranges. No permanent town stood here; the country is one of valleys, winter routes, and sheltered hunting grounds.

Before Russian expansion, this interior formed part of a wider Paleo-Siberian world. Yukaghir communities ranged from the Lena to the Anadyr, hunting deer, moose, and sable, fishing in rivers, and using reindeer for transport. Inland Chukchi moved seasonally across the tundra with their herds, while river valleys supplied meeting places and practical routes.

After a fort was established at Anadyrsk in 1649, the Maly Anyuy helped connect it with the Kolyma and Yakutsk. The indigenous peoples retained considerable independence, but trade drew them into relations with the Russian Empire. A fair on the Bolshoy Anyuy began in 1788, and expeditions led by Ferdinand von Wrangel and Fyodor Matyushkin surveyed both Anyuy rivers between 1821 and 1825.

Fur-bearing forests, fish, pasture, and river movement sustained this frontier economy. The older location belongs to mobile northern peoples rather than a fixed town.
simp_chinese:
阿利斯科罗沃位于楚科奇西部破碎的山地和针叶林地带，夹在小阿纽伊河流域与伊利尔内、克尔加奈山脉之间。这里没有永久城镇，只有谷地、冬季道路和隐蔽猎场组成的通行地带。

俄罗斯扩张以前，这一内陆属于广阔的旧西伯利亚世界。尤卡吉尔人从勒拿河活动到阿纳德尔河，猎取鹿、驼鹿和紫貂，在河中捕鱼，并以驯鹿运输。内陆楚科奇人随鹿群季节迁徙，河谷既提供会面地点，也构成实用通道。

1649年阿纳德尔斯克堡垒建立后，小阿纽伊河帮助连接阿纳德尔、科雷马和雅库茨克。当地民族仍保有相当大的独立性，但贸易把他们与俄罗斯帝国联系起来。1788年，大阿纽伊河畔开始举办集市；1821年至1825年，弗兰格尔与马秋什金考察了阿纽伊河流域。

毛皮森林、鱼类、牧场与河谷交通支撑边区经济。当地的历史属于迁徙不定的北方民族，而非固定城镇。

english:
Alkalawa was the walled capital of Gobir, the northernmost of the Hausa kingdoms, standing on the banks of the Gulbin Rima River. Its ruler Babari raised it in the mid-eighteenth century, after Gobir's warriors had sacked Birnin Zamfara, and gave it a name that recalled the farmland of Zamfara's chief judge (alkali), on which it was built. Gobir, once pushed south from Aïr by the Tuareg, now held the fertile Zamfara country, and the city became the seat of a military monarchy.

Under Bawa Jan Gwarzo (r. 1777–1795), Gobir's armies raided Katsina, Zamfara and Kebbi from Alkalawa. In 1788 the ageing Bawa summoned the Fulani preacher Usman dan Fodio, who taught at nearby Degel, to Magami and granted him freedom to preach, but his successors grew wary of the scholar's growing following. Yunfa, who took the throne in 1803, tried to have him killed and then drove him out; dan Fodio answered with a jihad that began in 1804. After years of fighting, his forces stormed Alkalawa in October 1808 and killed Yunfa. Gobir's court fled north, and the city's fall opened the way to the Sokoto Caliphate.
simp_chinese:
阿尔卡拉瓦是戈比尔的城墙都城，位于里马河河畔，戈比尔是最北端的豪萨王国。18世纪中叶，戈比尔武士攻陷比尔宁扎姆法拉之后，国王巴巴里在此筑城，城址原是扎姆法拉大法官（阿尔卡利）的田庄，城名即由此而来。戈比尔曾被图阿雷格人从艾尔高地一路挤向南方，此时已握有扎姆法拉肥沃的土地，这座城市成为一个军事君主国的驻地。

巴瓦·扬·瓜尔佐（1777—1795年在位）时期，戈比尔军队从阿尔卡拉瓦出发，袭扰卡齐纳、扎姆法拉和凯比。1788年，年迈的巴瓦把在附近德盖尔讲学的富拉尼传教士奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥召到马加米，准许他自由传教，但继任者对这位学者日益壮大的追随者越来越警惕。1803年即位的云法设法刺杀他不成，又将他逐出；丹·福迪奥以1804年开始的圣战作答。数年战事之后，他的军队于1808年10月攻入阿尔卡拉瓦，杀死云法。戈比尔宫廷北逃，都城陷落为索科托哈里发国的建立扫清了道路。

english: On the Sunzha River near Alkhan-Kala lie the remains of a large ancient settlement, extending for more than a kilometer along the riverbank. Burial mounds surround the site, while deep layers of occupation record a long history of habitation. Archaeologists have linked the settlement with the Alan world of the North Caucasus; it has been proposed as a center of a cluster of settlements in the Sunzha valley during the tenth to twelfth centuries. The river joined the foothills to the Terek plain farther north.
simp_chinese: 阿尔汉卡拉附近的孙扎河畔保存着一处大型古代聚落遗址，沿河岸延伸一公里以上。遗址周围分布着墓冢，深厚的文化层记录了这里长期有人居住的历史。考古学者将这处聚落与北高加索的阿兰世界联系起来，并提出它可能是十至十二世纪孙扎河谷一组聚落的中心。孙扎河将山麓地带与更北方的捷列克平原连接起来。

english:
Alkmaar grew on an old sandbank that rose above the surrounding lowlands, giving its earliest inhabitants some protection from flooding. Granted town rights in 1254, it became a centre for the countryside of polders and waterways around it. Its weighing house and cheese market speak to a long tradition of trade in the produce of the region.

During the Dutch Revolt, Spanish troops under Don Fadrique besieged Alkmaar in 1573. The defenders appealed to the Prince of Orange, who arranged for the surrounding land to be flooded. As the waters rose, the Spanish lifted the siege, giving the revolt a celebrated victory. In 1799 an Anglo-Russian expedition occupied the town, but after defeat at Castricum its withdrawal was arranged at the Convention of Alkmaar. The North Holland Canal opened through Alkmaar in 1824.
simp_chinese:
阿尔克马尔兴起于一条略高于周围低地的古老沙脊上，使早期居民免受部分洪水威胁。它于1254年获得城市权利，成为周围圩田与水道地区的中心。称重所和奶酪市场见证了当地农产品贸易的悠久传统。

荷兰起义期间，唐·法德里克率领西班牙军队于1573年围攻阿尔克马尔。守军向奥兰治亲王求援，后者安排放水淹没周围土地。水位上升后，西班牙军队解除围攻，起义者由此获得一场著名胜利。1799年，英俄远征军占领城镇，但在卡斯特里克姆战败后，通过阿尔克马尔协定安排撤军。1824年，穿过阿尔克马尔的北荷兰运河通航。

english:
All Saints Bay opens from the Atlantic behind the coast of Bahia, sheltering the waters in front of Salvador and giving the state its name. Its shallow basin is studded with islands, and Itaparica, the largest, guards the entrance. The Paraguaçu River enters through the Recôncavo lowlands, carrying inland water into the bay.

Amerigo Vespucci entered the bay on All Saints' Day, 1 November 1501, during his second expedition to the Americas, and named it after the date and the Florentine church of Ognissanti. By the early eighteenth century Salvador had become a major port serving the sugar plantations of the Recôncavo, and the old fort at Barra controlled the approaches. The bay's anchorage tied the plantations to the Portuguese Atlantic world.
simp_chinese:
万圣湾从巴伊亚海岸背后向大西洋敞开，湾内水域护住萨尔瓦多前方的海面，巴伊亚州也因它得名。浅水盆地散布着岛屿，最大的伊塔帕里卡岛扼守湾口。巴拉瓜苏河经雷孔卡沃低地注入海湾，把内陆水带进湾内。

1501年11月1日万圣节，阿美利哥·韦斯普奇在第二次美洲航行中驶入此湾，以节日和佛罗伦萨的奥格尼桑蒂教堂为其命名。十八世纪初，萨尔瓦多已成为服务雷孔卡沃蔗田的重要港口，湾口的巴拉要塞控制着进入海湾的通道。海湾的锚地把种植园与葡萄牙的大西洋世界连接起来。

english:
Allagash is a town on its namesake river in the North Maine Woods, a sparsely settled region of northern Maine. The town belongs to Aroostook County and covers 131.42 square miles, of which 128.61 are land and 2.81 are water. That scale is revealing: Allagash consists of a large rural territory around a small community rather than a densely built settlement. The river forms the central corridor through forests, lakes and rocky portages.

Wabanaki peoples, especially the Wolastoqiyik or Maliseet and neighboring Mi'kmaq and Penobscot, used the river and its waterways for fishing, hunting and travel long before European settlement. Canoes joined the Allagash with the Saint John and other watersheds, while carrying places allowed travelers to bypass rapids. Their seasonal routes followed fish, game, birch bark and materials needed for shelter.

From the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, French and British traders entered the region for furs. Control of routes between the Saint John, Penobscot and St. Lawrence made the northern woods important during imperial wars, and the Allagash became part of a contested borderland. The river's identity thus grew from Wabanaki canoe knowledge and a forest economy rather than from dense urban settlement. Their routes followed seasons and weather.
simp_chinese:
阿拉加什是缅因州北部森林地区同阿拉加什河沿岸的一座城镇，属阿鲁斯图克县。全镇面积131.42平方英里，其中陆地128.61平方英里、水域2.81平方英里。广阔边界说明这里由大片乡村土地环绕小型社区，而非稠密建筑群；河流穿过森林、湖泊和多岩陆运路段，成为中央通道。

欧洲人定居以前，瓦巴纳基诸族，特别是沃拉斯托基伊克人（马利西特人）以及邻近的米克马克人和佩诺布斯科特人，长期利用这条河及相连水道捕鱼、狩猎和旅行。独木舟把阿拉加什河同圣约翰河等流域连接起来，陆运小径则让行人绕过急流。季节性路线追随鱼群、猎物、桦树皮和搭建住所所需的材料。

十六世纪和十七世纪以后，法国与英国商人进入此地收购毛皮。通往圣约翰河、佩诺布斯科特河和圣劳伦斯河的路线，使北部森林在帝国战争中具有战略意义，阿拉加什由此成为有争议的边地。河流身份来自瓦巴纳基人的独木舟知识和森林经济，并非来自密集城镇。

english:
Allakaket lies on the south bank of the Koyukuk River in interior Alaska, southwest of where the Alatna joins it. Koyukon Athabascan families lived here and moved seasonally among camps to follow fish and game, while neighbouring Eskimo peoples traded with them along the river. This network of camps and river routes made the Koyukuk a corridor for subsistence, exchange, and encounter.

Salmon, whitefish, moose, bear, small game, berries, and caribou provided much of the food, while trapping and handicrafts brought in some income. The river is ice-free from June through October. Life in the settlement depended on the river's seasonal abundance and on the floods that periodically reshaped the ground beside it.
simp_chinese:
阿拉卡基特位于阿拉斯加内陆科尤库克河南岸，在阿拉特纳河汇入处西南方。科尤康阿萨巴斯卡人家庭在此生活，并随季节在营地间移动，追随鱼群和猎物；邻近的爱斯基摩社群则沿河与他们交换货物。营地与水路网络使科尤库克河成为生计、交换和接触的通道。

鲑鱼、白鲑、驼鹿、熊、小猎物、浆果和驯鹿提供了大部分食物，捕猎毛皮与手工艺也带来一些收入。科尤库克河六月至十月无冰。聚落的生活依赖河流的季节性丰饶，也依赖周期性洪水对河畔土地的改写。

english:
The Allegheny River winds through wooded hills before meeting the Monongahela to form the Ohio. This junction and the valleys beyond it were home to Indigenous communities, including Seneca, Lenape and Shawnee people. In the eighteenth century the rivers became a focus of rivalry between France and Britain, as traders and soldiers entered a country already shaped by Indigenous diplomacy and settlement.

The French built Fort Duquesne at the forks of the Ohio in 1754. Four years later, as a British army approached, they burned and abandoned it. The British established Fort Pitt on the same strategic ground, and the settlement of Pittsburgh grew beside it. Allegheny County was created in 1788, taking its name from the river, while the waterways continued to connect the growing town with the Ohio country.
simp_chinese:
阿勒格尼河蜿蜒穿过林木茂密的丘陵，与莫农加希拉河汇合，形成俄亥俄河。河流交汇处及周围谷地是塞内卡、莱纳佩、肖尼等原住民社群的家园。十八世纪，商人和士兵进入这片早已有原住民聚落与外交关系的土地，河流也成为法国与英国争夺的焦点。

1754年，法国人在俄亥俄河的岔口修建迪凯纳堡。四年后，随着英国军队逼近，法国人焚毁堡垒并撤离。英国随后在这一战略要地修建皮特堡，匹兹堡聚落也在旁边成长。1788年，阿勒格尼县以河流命名建立；水道继续将发展中的城镇与俄亥俄河地区连接起来。

english: Allègre stands beneath a castle on Mont Baury, a height overlooking the volcanic country of the Velay. The lords of Allègre fortified the summit, while the settlement developed on its slopes below. In November 1698 fire broke out in the castle and spread through its timber roofs, severely damaging the great residence. The surviving walls still mark the place from which its lords once dominated the town and its approaches.
simp_chinese: 阿莱格尔坐落在博里山的城堡下方，山顶俯瞰着韦莱的火山地带。阿莱格尔领主在高处修筑防御工事，聚落则在下方山坡上发展起来。1698年11月，城堡发生火灾，火势蔓延至木制屋顶，使这座宏大的宅邸严重受损。残存的墙垣仍标示着领主昔日俯瞰城镇及其通道的所在。

english: Lac des Allemands lies west of the lower Mississippi amid the swamps and bayous of southeastern Louisiana. Its waters pass through Bayou des Allemands toward Lake Salvador and the coastal marshes. The French name means Lake of the Germans, recalling immigrants who settled in the surrounding region during the eighteenth century. Shallow water, cypress swamps and the connected bayous make the lake part of a freshwater landscape that gradually gives way to the marshes near the Gulf.
simp_chinese: 阿勒芒湖位于密西西比河下游以西，四周是路易斯安那东南部的沼泽与河汊。湖水经阿勒芒河汊流向萨尔瓦多湖和沿海湿地。其法语名称意为“德国人之湖”，使人想起十八世纪在周边地区定居的德国移民。浅水、柏树沼泽和相连河汊构成一片淡水地景，逐渐过渡到墨西哥湾附近的湿地。

english: Alingsås grew after Danish troops burned Nya Lödöse, leaving its inhabitants without homes. Gustavus Adolphus granted the new town a royal charter in 1619. Jonas Alströmer, born here in 1685, established a large textile manufactory at Alingsås and promoted cultivation of the potato in Sweden. His enterprise became the country's largest of its kind, but financial difficulties, fires and political setbacks led to its closure in 1779. Nearby, Gräfsnäs Castle on Lake Anten was built around 1550 and rebuilt after fires in 1634 and 1734.
simp_chinese: 阿灵索斯在丹麦军队焚毁新勒德瑟、使居民无家可归之后发展起来。古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫于1619年授予新城王室特许状。1685年出生于此的约纳斯·阿尔斯特勒默在阿灵索斯创建大型纺织工场，并在瑞典推广马铃薯种植。他的企业一度成为全国同类工场中最大的，但财务困难、火灾和政治挫折使其于1779年关闭。附近安滕湖畔的格雷夫斯奈斯城堡约建于1550年，在1634年和1734年火灾后重建。

english: South of Acobamba, Allpas is known for the many small openings cut into a hillside of volcanic rock. These niches, often called ventanillas, form part of a pre-Inca archaeological complex overlooking the highland countryside. Their makers also shaped terraces and other structures on the slope. The site stood near an old route leading towards the Casaví River and the settlements beyond it.
simp_chinese: 阿科班巴以南的阿尔帕斯以火山岩山坡上众多小洞口闻名。这些被称作小窗的岩凿穴室是印加以前一处建筑群的组成部分，俯瞰着高地乡野。营建者还在坡上修筑台地等构造；遗址靠近一条通往卡萨维河及对岸聚落的古道。

english: Alluyes stands on the left bank of the Loir, where its castle guarded a crossing on the eastern edge of the Perche. It was the chief place of one of the five baronies of the Perche-Gouët, a district of lordships between the wooded hills and the plains of Beauce. Its position gave the castle military value during the Hundred Years' War: English forces occupied Alluyes and the surrounding country for a long period in the late fourteenth and early fifteenth centuries. The village remained gathered around the river and its old stronghold.
simp_chinese: 阿吕耶位于卢瓦尔河左岸，城堡守卫佩尔什东缘的渡口。这里是佩尔什—古埃五个男爵领地之一的中心，该地区位于林木覆盖的丘陵与博斯平原之间。百年战争期间，这一位置使城堡具有军事价值：十四世纪末至十五世纪初，英军长期占据阿吕耶及周围地区。村庄仍围绕河流与古老据点聚集。

english: Almadén is a mining town built around one of the world's great deposits of cinnabar, the ore from which mercury is extracted. Its shafts, furnaces and workers' quarters reflect centuries of labour beneath the hills of La Mancha. From the sixteenth century mercury acquired particular value for the amalgamation of silver ores in Spanish America. Almadén supplied mines in New Spain, linking the workings of this inland town to the wealth and demands of the overseas empire.
simp_chinese: 阿尔马登是一座矿业城镇，围绕世界上重要的辰砂矿床之一发展，辰砂可用于提取汞。矿井、熔炉和工人居所反映出拉曼恰丘陵下数百年的劳作。十六世纪起，汞因可用于西属美洲银矿的汞齐法冶炼而格外珍贵。阿尔马登向新西班牙的矿山供应汞，使这座内陆城镇的矿业与海外帝国的财富和需求紧密相连。

english: Almalik lies in the Ahangaran valley southeast of Tashkent, in the old mining country of Ilak. Medieval geographers described Ilak as a region between the mountains and the steppe, with towns whose wealth was tied to the extraction and working of metals. Silver and other ores were mined in the surrounding hills, and the products supported local workshops and mints. The valley connected this mineral country with the settlements of Chach and the Syr Darya plain.
simp_chinese: 阿里麻位于塔什干东南的阿杭加兰河谷，处在古伊拉克矿区内。中世纪地理学家将伊拉克描述为山地与草原之间的地区，城镇的财富与金属开采和加工密切相关。周围丘陵开采银等矿石，矿产支撑当地作坊和铸币所。河谷将这一矿产地区与赭石聚落及锡尔河平原相连。

english:
Almaliq was an important city of the upper Ili valley, amid the pastures and cultivated lands of the high northern Tian Shan mountains. Its name, associated with apples, belonged to a busy trading centre on the long-distance routes between Central Asia and China. Under Mongol rule it became a residence of Chagatai and his successors, bringing merchants, envoys and religious communities to the heart of the khanate.

In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries Christians of the Church of the East and Muslim communities lived in the city, alongside the merchants and officials who served the Mongol court. The historian Ata Malik Juvayni stayed there in 1253 while travelling on imperial business. Franciscan missionaries also reached Almaliq; several were killed in 1339 during a change of rulers. A papal envoy, Giovanni de' Marignolli, passed through the Ili valley soon afterwards on his journey toward the Yuan court.

In the later fourteenth century Almaliq remained associated with the rulers of Moghulistan. The tomb of Tughluq Timur, who embraced Islam, stands among the remains of the old city and its decorated brickwork recalls the architectural traditions of the Chagatai world. By the time Babur wrote at the end of the fifteenth century, he described Almaliq among the once flourishing towns that had fallen into desolation.
simp_chinese:
阿力麻里是伊犁河上游谷地的一座城市，坐落在天山北部的牧场与耕地之间。其名称与苹果有关，城镇是中亚通往中国道路上的贸易中心。蒙古统治时期，它成为察合台及其继承者的驻地，商人、使者与不同宗教社群来到汗国腹地。

十三至十四世纪，景教徒和穆斯林社群居住于此，也有服务蒙古宫廷的商人和官员。历史学家阿塔·马立克·朱韦尼在1253年因帝国事务出行时曾留住阿力麻里。方济各会传教士也来到这里；1339年统治者更替期间，数名修士遇害。不久，教宗使节马黎诺里在前往元朝宫廷的途中经过伊犁河谷。

十四世纪后期，阿力麻里仍与蒙兀儿斯坦的统治者相联系。皈依伊斯兰教的秃忽鲁帖木儿陵墓坐落在古城遗迹中，其装饰砖工令人想起察合台世界的建筑传统。十五世纪末巴布尔写作时，已将阿力麻里列为昔日繁荣、当时荒废的城镇之一。

english: The Almanzora valley crosses a dry landscape of hills in eastern Andalusia. Its river waters fields and gardens along the valley, although its flow changes greatly with the seasons. Settlements such as Armuña drew on irrigation for their fertile land, while sudden floods could devastate fields and houses farther downstream. The river gives its name to communities along its course.
simp_chinese: 阿尔曼索拉河谷穿过安达卢西亚东部干燥的丘陵地带。河流灌溉着沿谷的田地和园圃，水量却随季节大幅变化。阿尔穆尼亚等聚落利用灌溉耕作肥沃土地，而突发洪水也会摧毁下游的田地与房屋。河流为沿岸多个聚落留下了名字。

english:
Almatu, “apple place”, was a medieval town at the foot of the Trans-Ili Alatau, where streams from the Tian Shan run out into the plains of Zhetysu. Two silver dirhams of the thirteenth century that carry its name, the first written mention, show that it had a mint on the Silk Road under the Mongols. Chagatai khans ruled the region, then the breakaway Moghulistan. Timur's army, moving in 1390 from Tashkent to Issyk-Kul and on to the Irtysh, passed by the town the Persian chronicler Sharaf al-Din Yazdi calls Almalyk, and after his attacks trade moved south and the towns declined.

By the early sixteenth century the country around Almaty had passed to the Kazakh khans, and in Babur's memoirs Almatu stands among ruined towns. Oirat chronicles of the seventeenth century call the place Gurban Alimatai, “where three apple trees grow”, at a time of Dzungar power. The Kazakhs fought the Dzungars, defeating them in 1730 in the Anyrakay hills about seventy kilometres northwest of Almaty, and the Senior Horde, the Uly Zhuz, held the district; in the eighteenth century it lay near the frontier of the Khanate of Kokand.
simp_chinese:
阿尔马图意为“苹果之地”，是中世纪的城镇，位于外伊犁阿拉套山脚下，天山的溪流在此汇入七河地区的平原。两枚刻有它名字的13世纪银迪拉姆是最早的文字记载，表明蒙古人治下这里在丝绸之路上设有铸币厂。察合台汗们统治该地，随后是分裂出来的莫卧儿斯坦。1390年，帖木儿的军队从塔什干出发，经伊塞克湖前往额尔齐斯河，途经波斯编年史家谢拉夫丁·亚兹迪称作阿尔马雷克的城镇，他的进攻之后，商路南移，城镇衰落。

16世纪初，阿拉木图周围地区归于哈萨克汗，巴布尔回忆录把阿尔马图列在荒废的城镇之中。17世纪的卫拉特编年史称此地为古尔班·阿里马泰，意为“三棵苹果树生长之处”，当时准噶尔势力强盛。哈萨克人与准噶尔人作战，1730年在阿拉木图西北约七十公里的安拉卡伊山地击败了他们，大玉兹管辖这一地区；18世纪，这里靠近浩罕汗国的边境。

english: Almazán overlooks the Duero in eastern Castile, its walls and churches recalling its medieval position on a contested frontier. The palace of the Hurtado de Mendoza family rises above the river, its galleries opening toward the valley. The Catholic Monarchs visited the town several times and stayed in the palace for an extended period in 1496. Their son Prince John also established a household here, briefly bringing the activity of the royal court to the residence of the town's noble lords.
simp_chinese: 阿尔马桑俯瞰卡斯蒂利亚东部的杜埃罗河，城墙与教堂令人想起它在中世纪争议边境上的地位。乌尔塔多·德门多萨家族的宫殿高踞河上，回廊面向河谷。天主教双王多次访问此镇，并于1496年在宫殿居住了一段时间。他们的儿子胡安王子也在此设立自己的宫廷，短暂地将王室生活带入当地贵族领主的府邸。

english: Almenara stands on the lower Jequitinhonha River, a waterway that crosses the wooded interior toward the Atlantic. Its early settlement, called Vigia, grew around a military post established in connection with the São Miguel division in 1811. These posts formed part of the Portuguese advance along the river, a campaign that brought violent dispossession to Indigenous communities and opened land to colonial settlement.
simp_chinese: 阿尔梅纳拉坐落在热基蒂尼奥尼亚河下游，这条河流穿过森林覆盖的内陆，向大西洋奔去。早期聚落称为维吉亚，围绕1811年与圣米格尔军事分区一同设立的哨所发展。这些哨所是葡萄牙人沿河推进的一部分，军事行动以暴力夺取原住民土地，并为殖民定居开辟道路。

sources.title: Vale do Jequitinhonha Desenvolvimento e Sustentabilidade SOUZA NOGUEIRA 2011.pdf

english: Almenevo lies among the lakes of the southern Trans-Ural country. The village was established by Ichkin Tatars on the shore of Lake Yunli-Alman, and its inhabitants combined cultivation with military service. Their settlement formed part of the Tatar communities of the region, in a landscape where woodland and open country meet east of the Ural Mountains.
simp_chinese: 阿尔梅涅沃位于南外乌拉尔的湖泊地区。伊奇金鞑靼人在云利阿尔曼湖畔建立村庄，居民兼事耕作与军役。这个聚落属于当地鞑靼人社群的一部分，坐落在乌拉尔山以东森林与开阔地带相接的地区。

english: The village of Almetyevo stood on the Zay River. Its founder is remembered as Mullah Almet, and an early register lists its inhabitants as tribute-paying Tatars. In a letter of 1735, Almet warned a Russian officer about the gatherings and intentions of rebels during the Bashkir uprising, signing from his village on the Zay. Later accounts placed the village's foundation around 1719. By 1795 its population included hundreds of people recorded as Teptyars and Bashkirs, reflecting changes in the official classification of the region's communities.
simp_chinese: 阿尔梅季耶沃村位于扎伊河畔，相传由阿尔梅特毛拉建立，早期登记簿将居民列为缴纳赋税的鞑靼人。1735年巴什基尔起义期间，阿尔梅特致信一名俄罗斯军官，警告起义者的集会和意图，并署名来自扎伊河畔的村庄。后来的说法将村庄建立时间定在约1719年。1795年，数百名居民被登记为捷普佳尔人和巴什基尔人，反映了当局对地区社群分类的变化。

english: Almodóvar del Campo lies near the pastures of the Alcudia valley in southern La Mancha. Its fairs and connection with the Mesta, the association of sheep owners whose flocks grazed the surrounding dehesas, contributed to its medieval prosperity. The town was also the birthplace of the preacher John of Ávila, who celebrated his first Mass in the parish church in 1526. Its church preserves a richly worked Mudéjar ceiling, a reminder of the region's intertwined artistic traditions.
simp_chinese: 阿尔莫多瓦尔德尔坎波位于拉曼恰南部，靠近阿尔库迪亚谷地的牧场。当地集市以及与梅斯塔牧羊业联盟的联系促进了中世纪的繁荣，联盟的羊群在周围牧场放牧。传教士阿维拉的若望也出生于此，1526年在教区教堂举行首场弥撒。教堂保存着精工制作的穆德哈尔式天花板，体现出当地交融的艺术传统。

english:
The Almofala shore belongs to Itarema on Ceará's Atlantic coast, where the Aracati-Mirim and Aracati-Açu meet low beaches, dunes and lagoons. Fishing and travel along the strand tied its small settlements to both river mouths and the open sea.

Almofala was also a center of Tremembé life. In the early eighteenth century, Jesuit missionaries worked among the Tremembé and a chapel dedicated to Nossa Senhora da Conceição was built on land assigned to the community; the masonry church was completed in 1712.

The church, its brotherhood and the surrounding village became the focus of a distinct coastal community. Shifting sand was already a force in local life, and winds repeatedly reshaped the dunes behind the shore.

Estuaries offered sheltered water for boats while the Atlantic supplied fish and a route between coastal hamlets. Almofala's identity grew from this practical junction of Indigenous settlement, Catholic mission and a shore forever being remade by wind and tide.
simp_chinese:
阿尔莫法拉海岸属于塞阿拉州伊塔雷马，位于阿拉卡蒂米林河与阿拉卡蒂阿苏河汇入大西洋的一带。两处河口同低矮海滩、沙丘和潟湖相接，捕鱼与沿岸往来把小型聚落同海面和内陆水路联系起来。

这里也是特伦贝人生活的重要中心。十八世纪初，耶稣会传教士在特伦贝人中间活动；划归该社群的土地上建起了圣母无原罪小教堂，砖石教堂于1712年完工。

教堂、兄弟会与周围村落共同形成一处独特的沿海社群。流沙早已影响当地生活，海风反复重塑滩后的沙丘，也迫使居民不断适应岸线变化。

河口为小船提供避风水面，大西洋则带来鱼群和连接沿岸村落的航路。原住民聚落、天主教会与风潮塑造的海岸在这里交会，构成了阿尔莫法拉的历史身份。

english: Almonaster la Real lies in the wooded hills of the Sierra de Aracena beneath an old fortress. Within its walls stands a mosque built in the age of the caliphs of Córdoba, using columns and stones from earlier buildings. After the Christian conquest it became a church, and additions over the centuries joined Christian worship to an unusually well-preserved rural monument of al-Andalus.
simp_chinese: 阿尔莫纳斯特拉雷阿尔位于阿拉塞纳山脉林木覆盖的丘陵中，古老要塞俯瞰聚落。城墙内有一座建于科尔多瓦哈里发时代的清真寺，建筑利用了更早时期的柱子与石料。基督徒征服后，它被改为教堂，历代增建使基督教礼拜与这座保存难得完好的安达卢斯乡村建筑结合在一起。

english:
Almora stands on a ridge in the Kumaon hills, with the Koshi and Suyal rivers below and the snowy Himalayas beyond. Founded by Kalyan Chand in 1568, it became the seat of the Chand kings of Kumaon. Local tradition connects its name with a plant gathered to clean the vessels of the sun temple at nearby Katarmal.

The Chand rulers adorned their capital with temples. In 1688 Udyot Chand built several shrines to mark victories over Garhwal and Doti; one later became the Nanda Devi temple. In 1791 Gorkhali forces invading from Nepal captured Almora and held it for more than two decades. Their defeat in the Anglo-Nepalese War brought Kumaon under the East India Company, and the old Lal Mandi fort was renamed Fort Moira.
simp_chinese:
阿尔莫拉坐落在库马昂山地的一道山脊上，科希河和苏亚尔河流经下方，远处可见白雪覆盖的喜马拉雅山。1568年，卡利扬·昌德建立此城，它随后成为库马昂昌德诸王的驻地。地方传说将城名与一种植物联系起来，人们采集它来清洗附近卡塔尔马尔太阳神庙的器皿。

昌德统治者在都城修建神庙。1688年，乌迪约特·昌德为纪念战胜加尔瓦尔和多蒂而建造数座圣所，其中一座后来成为南达提毗神庙。1791年，从尼泊尔入侵的廓尔喀军队占领阿尔莫拉，统治二十余年。英尼战争中廓尔喀战败后，库马昂转归东印度公司，旧拉尔曼迪堡被改名为莫伊拉堡。

english: Almudévar lies south of Huesca beneath the hill known as La Corona, where a castle guarded the settlement. In 1170 Alfonso II of Aragon granted the town a charter and gave its inhabitants the castle hill for a church, abbey and houses. The charter began a collection of medieval documents recording the privileges and affairs of the community.
simp_chinese: 阿尔穆德瓦尔位于韦斯卡以南，科罗纳山俯瞰城镇，山上城堡曾守卫着聚落。1170年，阿拉贡国王阿方索二世授予城镇特许状，并将城堡山交给居民兴建教堂、修院和房屋。这份特许状开启了当地的中世纪文献档案，记录着共同体的特权与事务。

english: Almuñécar occupies a headland on the coast of Granada, overlooked by the castle of San Miguel. Its history stretches from the ancient town of Sexi through centuries of Muslim rule. The town surrendered to the Catholic Monarchs in 1489, and records made in the following years describe the division of its property. In 1562 a storm wrecked much of a Spanish galley fleet in nearby La Herradura bay.
simp_chinese: 阿尔穆涅卡尔占据格拉纳达海岸的一处岬角，圣米格尔城堡俯瞰着城镇。它的历史从古代塞克西延续到数百年的穆斯林统治。1489年，城镇向天主教双王投降，随后几年的记录记载了当地财产的分配。1562年，一场风暴使西班牙桨帆船舰队的大部分船只在附近的拉埃拉杜拉湾遇难。

english: Alnwick stands in Northumberland beneath the great castle of the Percy family. The Percys acquired the stronghold in 1309 and strengthened its walls, towers and gatehouse during the fourteenth century. Their lands and military power made them leading figures on the turbulent border with Scotland. Henry Percy, known as Hotspur, was born at Alnwick and fought in the border wars before rebelling against Henry IV. He was killed at the battle of Shrewsbury in 1403. By the eighteenth century the castle had declined, but a revival of the family's fortunes brought an ambitious restoration, transforming the old fortress into a grand Gothic residence.
simp_chinese: 阿尼克坐落在诺森伯兰，珀西家族的宏伟城堡俯瞰着城镇。珀西家族于1309年取得要塞，并在十四世纪加强城墙、塔楼和门楼。土地与军事力量使他们成为动荡的英苏边境上的重要人物。人称“热刺”的亨利·珀西出生于阿尼克，曾参加边境战争，后来反叛亨利四世，1403年在什鲁斯伯里战役中阵亡。到十八世纪，城堡已经衰败；家族财富复兴后，一项雄心勃勃的修复工程将古老要塞改造成宏伟的哥特式宅邸。

english: The Alor Strait separates the islands of Lembata and Pantar in the eastern Lesser Sundas. It divides the Solor and Alor island groups, providing a passage between the seas north and south of the island chain. Strong currents run through these narrow channels, driven by tides, monsoons and the flow of water between the Pacific and Indian oceans.
simp_chinese: 阿洛尔海峡分隔小巽他群岛东部的伦巴塔岛与潘塔尔岛，也将索洛尔群岛和阿洛尔群岛分开。水道连接岛链南北两侧的海域；潮汐、季风及太平洋与印度洋之间的水流共同推动着海峡中的强劲海流。

english:
The Australian Alps rise across southeastern Australia, and they are the highest mountains on the mainland. Their snowfields lie above forests and woodlands, and traces of ancient ice remain in hollows on the highest ground. The Ngarigu people used the high plains and valleys seasonally, travelling up from the lower country as the weather allowed.

In summer the bogong moth gathered in large numbers in the rock crevices and caves of the mountains, and people came up from the plains to harvest them. The rugged, snow-bound country was hard for travellers to cross, and few Europeans entered the high ranges before the 1830s.
simp_chinese:
澳大利亚阿尔卑斯山脉横跨澳大利亚东南部，是大陆上最高的山脉。雪原位于林地与森林之上，高处洼地仍留有古代冰川的痕迹。纳里古人依季节利用高原与河谷，天气许可时从低地上山。

夏季，布冈夜蛾大量聚集在山间岩缝和洞穴中，平原上的人们上山采集。崎岖多雪的山地难以穿越，1830年代以前，欧洲人很少进入这些高地。

english: Alpo'wa was a village at the meeting of Alpowa Creek and the Snake River, in the dry uplands of the Columbia Plateau. Nez Perce and Palouse communities lived along this stretch of the river, where fishing places linked villages to the seasonal salmon runs. In 1805 Lewis and Clark traveled down the Snake through a country already connected by trails and river routes.
simp_chinese: 阿尔波瓦是一座位于阿尔波瓦溪与斯内克河交会处的村落，坐落在哥伦比亚高原干燥的高地间。内兹佩尔塞人和帕卢斯人的社群居住在这段河流沿岸，渔场将村落与季节性洄游的鲑鱼联系起来。1805年，刘易斯与克拉克顺斯内克河而下，经过这片早已由小径和水道连接起来的土地。

english: The Alpowna were among the Nimíipuu, or Nez Perce, peoples whose country reached along the Clearwater and Snake rivers. Their fishing and hunting grounds connected river valleys with the Bitterroot Mountains, and neighboring groups shared access to some places. At Weippe Prairie, families gathered camas roots; there in 1805 they met members of the Lewis and Clark expedition emerging from the mountains.
simp_chinese: 阿尔波纳人是尼米普人，也就是内兹佩尔塞人的群体之一，他们的土地沿克利尔沃特河与斯内克河延伸。渔场和猎区将河谷与比特鲁特山脉连接起来，有些地点也与邻近群体共同使用。在韦佩草原，各个家庭采集卡马斯根茎；1805年，他们在此遇见穿越山脉而来的刘易斯与克拉克探险队成员。

english: Alpu is a Wichí community name in the Pilcomayo country of the northern Argentine Chaco. The Wichí speak languages of the Mataguayan family and traditionally used extensive territories of woodland and riverbank. Hunting, fishing and gathering supplied food as the seasons changed. The Pilcomayo descends from the Andes into the lowlands, where floods spread across the flat country and its channels shift through sand and marsh.
simp_chinese: 阿尔普是阿根廷北部查科皮尔科马约河地区一个韦奇社群的名称。韦奇人使用马塔瓜约语族语言，传统上利用广阔的林地和河岸领地，随着季节变化狩猎、捕鱼与采集。皮尔科马约河从安第斯山流入低地，洪水在平坦地区漫开，河道在沙地与沼泽间变化。

english:
Alsfeld lies on the upper Schwalm in central Hesse, between the Vogelsberg and the Knüll mountains. Its position on the Kurze Hessen trade route helped crafts and commerce flourish. In 1429 the Korebrief gave the guilds a role in municipal politics and established a constitution that lasted into the nineteenth century.

The town's prosperity found expression in the timber-framed town hall, built from 1512 to 1516, and other buildings around the market square. Alsfeld passed to Hesse-Marburg in 1567. The Thirty Years' War brought plunder, famine and plague; in 1646 fighting and destruction left many houses and barns in ruins.
simp_chinese:
阿尔斯费尔德位于黑森中部施瓦尔姆河上游，坐落在福格尔斯山与克尼尔山之间。“短黑森”商路经过此地，促进了手工业与贸易的发展。1429年的《科雷书》使行会得以参与城市政治，确立的市政制度延续至19世纪。

市场广场周围的建筑体现了城市的繁荣，其中木框架市政厅建于1512至1516年。1567年，阿尔斯费尔德归属黑森—马尔堡。三十年战争带来了劫掠、饥荒和瘟疫；1646年的战斗与破坏使许多住宅和谷仓成为废墟。

english: Alsigontekw lies near the lower Saint-François River, where the Abenaki community of Odanak stands not far from the St. Lawrence. Families from several Wabanaki peoples made the village their home. In October 1759 Robert Rogers led New England rangers against Odanak, burning the settlement during the war between Britain and France.
simp_chinese: 阿尔西贡特克位于圣弗朗索瓦河下游附近，阿贝纳基人的奥达纳克村坐落在距圣劳伦斯河不远的河岸。来自多个瓦巴纳基族群的家庭在此安家。1759年10月，罗伯特·罗杰斯率新英格兰游骑兵袭击奥达纳克，在英法战争中焚毁了村落。

english:
Alstahaug is a church site on the island of Alsta, among the islands and sheltered waters of Helgeland. Its stone church dates from around the end of the twelfth century, and the parish long served a large area of northern Norway. The sea linked its scattered farms and islands to the church and to the fish trade with Bergen.

In 1689 the poet and priest Petter Dass became parish priest at Alstahaug, an office he held until his death in 1707. His parish was exceptionally extensive, reaching from the coast into the inland valleys. Dass also owned vessels that carried fish south to Bergen. His poetry included religious songs and descriptions of northern life; his celebrated Nordlands Trompet was published after his death.
simp_chinese:
阿尔斯塔海于格是阿尔斯塔岛上的教会所在地，周围是海尔格兰的岛屿和受庇护的水域。石教堂约建于十二世纪末，这个教区长期服务于挪威北部的大片地区。海路将分散的农场和岛屿与教堂、以及通往卑尔根的鱼货贸易联系起来。

1689年，诗人兼牧师彼得·达斯成为阿尔斯塔海于格的堂区牧师，直至1707年去世。他的教区幅员辽阔，从海岸一直延伸到内陆山谷。达斯还拥有将鱼货南运至卑尔根的船只。他的诗作既有宗教歌曲，也有北方生活的描写；著名的《诺尔兰的号角》在他去世后出版。

english:
Alta belongs to Finnmark, the northern Norwegian county that forms part of Sápmi and the Barents region. The district lies just below the 70th parallel at the head of the Altafjord, closer to the North Pole than to much of Central Europe. Despite the latitude, the Gulf Stream softens the climate, and the lower ground is covered by boreal forest, while the midnight sun and the polar night each last for weeks. The name comes from the fjord, and may derive from an Old Norse word for swan or from a Finnish word for lowland.

People have lived here for thousands of years. The rock carvings near the Jiepmaluokta bay, made between about 7000 and 500 BC, show hunters, animals and boats, and the Komsa culture takes its name from a mountain in the district. The district is a homeland of the Sámi, who made up most of the population in much of the interior, while the fjord areas were long ethnically mixed. Norwegians had lived on the outer islands for centuries, and coastal settlement by Norwegians began in the tenth century. Water routes and sheltered land shaped where different communities settled and how they connected.
simp_chinese:
阿尔塔属于芬马克，这是挪威北部的一个郡，也是萨普米和巴伦支地区的一部分。这片地区位于阿尔塔峡湾湾头，刚好在北纬70度线以南，离北极比离中欧许多地方更近。尽管纬度很高，墨西哥湾暖流使气候趋于温和，较低处覆盖着北方针叶林，午夜太阳和极夜则各持续数周。地名来自峡湾，可能源自古诺尔斯语中表示天鹅的词，也可能来自芬兰语中表示低地的词。

人类在这里生活了数千年。耶普马卢奥克塔湾附近的岩画创作于约公元前7000年至前500年，描绘猎人、动物和船只；科姆萨文化也以当地一座山命名。这里是萨米人的故土，内陆许多地区长期以萨米人为主，峡湾地区则长期有多个族群共同生活。挪威人居住在外围岛屿已有数百年，沿海地区的挪威人定居始于10世纪。水路和避风的陆地共同影响着不同社群的分布与往来。

english:
At the head of Herjolfsfjord, near Greenland’s southern tip, a narrow strip of pasture faced the open Labrador Sea. Herjólfr Bardsson established the homestead in the late tenth century. Most Norse settlers chose sheltered inner fjords for farming; his exposed site instead placed a reception point for ships from Iceland and Europe.

Herjolfsnes became the principal harbour of the Norse colony. The Greenlanders’ saga connects it with Bjarni Herjólfsson, who was driven off course while seeking his father and sighted the North American coast. A church was raised after Greenland’s conversion to Christianity; its thirteenth-century replacement was the third-largest church in Norse Greenland.

The settlement remained active during the fourteenth century. Ivar Bardarson, a Norwegian priest and representative of church and crown, called Herjolfsnes the colony’s major port, known to sailors as Sand. The Skálholt map later placed it near Cape Farewell, making it the only Greenland settlement shown on that late medieval world map. Maritime traffic declined as ice and storms made the old Iceland route more dangerous.

Herjolfsnes existed alongside Thule Inuit activity in nearby fjords. Seal hunting, fishing, and trade in walrus and narwhal ivory helped sustain the Greenland Norse as farming became precarious. The last certain written reference to Norse Greenland dates from the early fifteenth century, though a remnant population may have lasted for decades. Whale and seal fishers later used the region.
simp_chinese:
赫约尔夫斯菲约德尽头、格陵兰南端附近，一片狭窄牧地直接面向拉布拉多海。十世纪晚期，赫约尔夫·巴德松在此建立庄园。多数诺斯移民选择受遮蔽的内湾务农，他却把住地放在迎海处，使冰岛和欧洲来船能够直接靠岸。

赫约尔夫斯内斯后来成为诺斯格陵兰殖民地的主要港口。《格陵兰人萨迦》把它同比亚尔尼·赫约尔夫松联系起来：他寻找父亲时偏航，见到了北美海岸。格陵兰改宗基督教后，当地建立教堂；十三世纪重建的教堂是诺斯格陵兰第三大教堂。

十四世纪时，聚落仍在运转。挪威教士伊瓦尔·巴尔德松称赫约尔夫斯内斯为主要港口，并记载水手称这里为“桑德”。后来的斯考尔特地图把它标在法韦尔角附近，使其成为图上唯一标出的格陵兰聚落。随着海冰和风暴使旧冰岛航路更加危险，往来船只逐渐减少。

赫约尔夫斯内斯与附近峡湾中的图勒因纽特活动并存。农耕日趋困难时，捕海豹、捕鱼以及海象牙和独角鲸牙贸易维持了诺斯居民的生计。关于诺斯格陵兰的最后可靠书面记载出现在十五世纪初，残余人口可能又延续数十年。此后捕鲸者和海豹猎手仍使用这一地区。

english: Altayxa lies near the upper Uyandina and the valley of the Buor-Yuryakh. The Uyandina is formed by rivers rising near the Selennyakh and Polousny ranges, then turns east across the Aby Lowland to join the Indigirka. Its right-bank tributary, the Buor-Yuryakh, flows down from the Moma Range.
simp_chinese: 阿尔泰哈靠近乌扬迪纳河上游和布奥尔尤里亚赫河谷。乌扬迪纳河由发源于谢连尼亚赫山脉和波洛乌斯内山脉附近的河流汇成，随后转向东流，穿过阿贝低地汇入因迪吉尔卡河；右岸支流布奥尔尤里亚赫河则从莫马山脉流下。

english: The Altamachi forests cover steep valleys on the eastern side of the Bolivian Andes. The Altamachi River flows through this humid mountain country towards the lowland drainage beyond. Cloud forest on the upper slopes gives way to warmer vegetation below, while ridges separate the river basin from neighbouring valleys and the colder highlands of Cochabamba.
simp_chinese: 阿尔塔马奇森林覆盖玻利维亚安第斯东侧的陡峭河谷。阿尔塔马奇河穿过湿润山地，流向远方低地水系。上坡的云雾林向下过渡为温暖地带的植被，山脊将流域与邻近河谷及科恰班巴较寒冷的高地分隔开来。

english:
Altamaha was a town in the Oconee River valley and a centre of the late Mississippian chiefdom of Ocute. Its people lived among agricultural settlements and earthwork centres in the wooded interior of Georgia. In 1540, as Hernando de Soto's expedition travelled through the region, inhabitants of Altamaha carried the Spaniards across a river in dugout canoes. The army continued toward Ocute and Cofaqui.

In the seventeenth century Altamaha became a leading centre of the province known to the Spanish as La Tama. Raids by the Westo in the 1660s drove its communities from the interior. Some moved west toward the Chattahoochee, while others joined people on the coast. Altamaha remained the name of a town among the communities that later became known as the Yamasee.
simp_chinese:
阿尔塔马哈是奥科尼河谷的一座村镇，也是密西西比文化晚期奥库特酋邦的中心之一。佐治亚内陆林地间分布着农业聚落和土方中心，当地居民就生活在这一地区。1540年，埃尔南多·德索托的远征队经过时，阿尔塔马哈居民用独木舟载西班牙人渡河。军队随后继续前往奥库特和科法基。

十七世纪，阿尔塔马哈成为西班牙人所称拉塔马地区的主要中心。十七世纪六十年代，韦斯托人的袭击迫使当地社群离开内陆。一些人向西迁往查特胡奇河，另一些人加入沿海居民。阿尔塔马哈的名字后来仍为一座村镇所用，它的居民属于日后被称为亚马西人的社群。

english: Altamaha Sound receives the waters of the Altamaha River on the Atlantic coast of Georgia. The river divides through a low coastal delta before reaching the sea among marshes and barrier islands. In 1721 British colonists built Fort King George at the river mouth to defend their claims against rival European powers. The fort marked an imperial frontier in a region already inhabited by Native peoples.
simp_chinese: 阿尔塔马哈湾位于佐治亚大西洋海岸，接纳阿尔塔马哈河的河水。河流穿过低平的海岸三角洲分汊，在沼泽与障壁岛之间入海。1721年，英国殖民者在河口修建乔治王堡，以抵御欧洲对手并维护其领土主张。这座堡垒标示着帝国边界，而原住民早已生活在这片地区。

english:
Altamura stands on the broad limestone plateau of the Murge, among the grain-growing lands of inland Apulia. Emperor Frederick II promoted the town and founded its cathedral, whose towers rise above the old streets. Houses cluster around small enclosed courts known as claustri, giving the historic centre a distinctive pattern. The cathedral and its square formed a visible focus for the community founded under the emperor.

In 1799 Altamura supported the Parthenopean Republic proclaimed at Naples. Its inhabitants resisted the royalist military forces led by Cardinal Fabrizio Ruffo, but the town was taken and plundered. During the French period that followed, a court of appeal sat at Altamura from 1808 to 1817, bringing judicial business from several neighbouring southern provinces to the town.
simp_chinese:
阿尔塔穆拉坐落在穆尔杰石灰岩高原上，周围是阿普利亚内陆的产粮地区。皇帝腓特烈二世扶植城镇并创建大教堂，双塔耸立于旧街之上。房屋围绕称为克劳斯特里的小型封闭庭院聚集，使历史城区拥有独特格局。大教堂与广场成为皇帝时期建立的社群醒目的中心。

1799年，阿尔塔穆拉支持在那不勒斯宣布成立的帕尔特诺佩共和国。居民抵抗法布里齐奥·鲁福枢机领导的保王派军队，但城镇最终陷落并遭洗劫。随后的法国统治时期，1808至1817年上诉法院设于此地，将南方数省的司法事务带入城镇。

english:
Altan Gadas belongs to the Selenga river country of northern Mongolia. The river forms where the Ider and Delger meet and then runs roughly 992 to 1,024 kilometres before entering Lake Baikal. Its basin is a semi-arid region covering about 280,000 square kilometres, with scattered forests and extensive mountain ranges. Because the Selenga reaches Lake Baikal through the Angara, it forms part of the most distant headwaters of the Yenisey–Angara river system. Climate strongly influences the river.

The Siberian High brings harsh winters, and the water generally freezes from November to April. Warmer summers produce annual floods whose size can range from ordinary to catastrophic. At its mouth the river creates a delta of about 680 square kilometres and supplies almost half of the riverine water entering Lake Baikal. The basin also contains a long record of human activity.

Paleolithic sites such as Ust-Kyakhta-3 show that people lived along the Selenga from the Stone Age. The river connected mountain pasture, forest steppe and routes northward through Buryatia. Its channels were an axis for movement and settlement, while the delta's wetlands sheltered many birds and provided habitat for species including the Baikal sturgeon.
simp_chinese:
阿尔坦嘎达斯属于蒙古北部色楞格河流域。伊德尔河与德尔格尔河汇合后形成色楞格河，河水向北流入贝加尔湖，流程约992至1024公里。流域面积约28万平方公里，是半干旱地区，境内分布零散森林和绵延山脉。色楞格河经安加拉河与叶尼塞水系相连，因此构成叶尼塞—安加拉水系最遥远的源头之一。

气候深刻影响河流。西伯利亚高压带来严酷冬季，河面通常从11月封冻到次年4月；温暖夏季则形成年度洪水，其规模从普通到灾难性不等。河流入湖处形成约680平方公里的三角洲，为贝加尔湖提供近一半的河流入水量。

流域还保存着长期人类活动迹象。乌斯季基亚赫塔三号等遗址表明，色楞格河沿岸自旧石器时代起就有人居住。河谷把山地牧场、森林草原与穿越布里亚特的北行道路串在一起，是迁徙和聚落分布的重要轴线；三角洲湿地则养育众多鸟类，可供贝加尔鲟等物种栖息。

english: The Tigiretsky Range rises in the north-western Altai between the basins of the Charysh and Uba. Its highest summit, Obzornaya, reaches 2,298 metres. Forest steppe on the lower slopes gives way to tall aspen and fir forest, then to cedar and fir, with sparse larch woodland higher still.
simp_chinese: 季吉列茨基山脉耸立在阿尔泰山西北部，分隔恰雷什河与乌巴河流域。最高峰奥布佐尔纳亚山海拔二千二百九十八米。低坡的森林草原向上转为高大的白杨和冷杉林，再往上是西伯利亚松与冷杉林，以及稀疏的落叶松林。

english:
Southern Siberia's forested uplands include the Kuznetsk Alatau, a chain of ridges between the Kuznetsk and Minusinsk depressions. Its western slopes descend sharply, while the eastern side falls more gently towards the Yenisei basin. Forest covers much of the mountain country below the exposed heights, and valleys provide passages through the ridges.

Communities in the wider region used forests and waterways for hunting, gathering and travel. Seasonal changes shaped access to resources and routes, while river valleys linked the uplands with the lowlands beyond. Knowledge of the forest and its passages remained important as Russian expansion reached southern Siberia in the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese:
西伯利亚南部的森林高地包括库兹涅茨克阿拉套，其山脊横亘在库兹涅茨克盆地与米努辛斯克盆地之间。西坡陡峭，东坡较为和缓，伸向叶尼塞河流域。裸露的高处以下多为森林，河谷提供穿越山岭的通道。

更广阔地区的社群利用森林和水道狩猎、采集与旅行。季节变化影响资源获取和通行，河谷则将高地与外围低地相连。十七世纪俄国势力进入西伯利亚南部后，对森林和路径的了解仍然十分重要。

english: The forests of this wasteland lie along the Kan River, a right tributary of the Yenisei in the Kansk country of southern Siberia. The Kan drains about 36,900 square kilometres, and its valley forms the southern boundary of the Yenisei Range, a land of dark taiga, river terraces and forest-covered hills. Russian Cossacks founded a fort on the Kan in 1628 and moved it to its present site in 1636, making it a base for collecting fur tribute from the surrounding peoples.
simp_chinese: 这片针叶林位于叶尼塞河右岸支流坎河的流域，属于南西伯利亚的坎斯克地区。坎河流域面积约3.69万平方公里，河谷构成叶尼塞山脊的南部边界，这里是幽暗的泰加林、河阶地与林木覆盖的丘陵。俄国哥萨克于1628年在坎河上建立堡寨，1636年迁至现址，此后以此为据点向周边居民征收毛皮贡赋。

english: The Altay Mountains stretch across the heart of Asia, joining the Sayan ranges in the northeast and descending towards the Gobi in the southeast. Snow, glaciers and alpine meadows crown their heights, while forests and steppe occupy lower slopes. The mountain country contains the headwaters of great rivers including the Irtysh and Ob, and has long been home to peoples whose livelihoods combined herding, hunting and travel through the valleys.
simp_chinese: 阿尔泰山脉横亘亚洲腹地，东北与萨彦岭相连，东南逐渐降低，伸向戈壁。积雪、冰川和高山草甸覆盖高处，森林与草原分布于较低的山坡。额尔齐斯河、鄂毕河等大河的源头位于这片山地；当地各族长期以放牧、狩猎和穿越山谷往来为生。

english: Altayn Ovor Gobi lies in the arid country of southwestern Mongolia, near the Shar Teg beds. These rocks preserve the remains of a Jurassic landscape: fossil plants, fish and a remarkable variety of insects have been found in their layers. Mayflies, stoneflies and the cases of caddisfly larvae recall waters that existed here long before the dry Gobi took its present form.
simp_chinese: 阿尔泰诺尔戈壁位于蒙古西南部干旱地带，靠近沙尔特格地层。这些岩石保存了侏罗纪时期的景观：岩层中发现过植物、鱼类和种类繁多的昆虫化石。蜉蝣、襀翅目昆虫与石蛾幼虫的虫鞘，让人想见这片干旱戈壁形成以前曾经存在的水域。

sources.title: 271075313 Upper Jurassic Lagerstatte Shar Teg Southwestern Mongolia

english:
Altayskoye lies among the northern foothills of the Altai, where wooded slopes rise above river valleys and meadows. The settlement was founded in 1808 as Verkhne-Kamenskaya, or Upper Kamenka. By the 1830s it had acquired the name Altayskoye. The surrounding country joins the plain at the foot of the mountains with spurs of the Anuy, Cherga and Seminsky ranges, whose streams drain towards the upper Ob basin.

The later city of Gorno-Altaysk lies here.
simp_chinese:
阿尔泰斯科耶坐落在阿尔泰山北部山麓，林木覆盖的山坡高出河谷与草地。聚落建于1808年，原名上卡缅斯卡娅，即上卡缅卡；到十九世纪三十年代，它已改称阿尔泰斯科耶。周围地带连接山前平原与阿努伊、切尔加和谢明斯基山脉的支岭，溪流流向鄂毕河上游流域。

后来的戈尔诺-阿尔泰斯克即位于此地。

english:
Altdorf stands on the eastern bank of the Reuss, close to the river's entrance into Lake Uri. Recorded in 1223, it lies where routes towards the Gotthard and Klausen passes meet. By the late Middle Ages its markets and carriers served traffic in wine, cattle, cheese, grain and salt travelling over the Gotthard. The Dorfbach canal supplied water and powered mills and sawmills.

The people of Uri redeemed rights held by Zürich's Fraumünster abbey in 1359, and in 1428 Altdorf's parishioners gained the choice of their priest. Cattle raising became a leading occupation, and villagers secured rights to much of the common land around 1522. Fires struck the town in 1693 and 1799; after the latter, authorities required houses to be rebuilt with stone and tile. According to legend, Altdorf was also where William Tell shot an apple from his son's head.
simp_chinese:
阿尔特多夫位于罗伊斯河东岸，靠近河流注入乌里湖的地方。1223年的文献记载了此地；通往圣哥达和克劳森山口的道路在这里交会。中世纪后期，集市和运输者为翻越圣哥达山口的葡萄酒、牛、奶酪、谷物和盐提供服务。多尔夫巴赫水渠供应生活用水，并驱动磨坊和锯木场。

1359年，乌里居民赎回苏黎世圣母修道院持有的权利；1428年，阿尔特多夫教区居民获得选择神父的权利。养牛成为主要生计，约1522年村民取得了大部分共有土地的使用权。1693年和1799年的大火重创城镇；后一次火灾后，当局要求用石材和瓦重建房屋。传说中，威廉·退尔也曾在阿尔特多夫射落儿子头顶的苹果。

english: Altena lies in the Sauerland beneath the castle from which a branch of the counts of Mark took its early name. The stronghold remained important after the family established other seats. During a feud in 1323, the bishop of Münster was captured and held here for ransom. Count Engelbert III of Mark granted the settlement below the castle limited town rights in 1367. By 1392 Altena was the seat of a local bailiff, and the castle also housed the county's archives. After the succession disputes of 1609, the County of Mark passed to Brandenburg.
simp_chinese: 阿尔特纳坐落在绍尔兰地区一座城堡之下，马克伯爵家族的一个支系早年曾以此堡为名。家族建立其他驻地后，这座据点仍然重要。1323年的一场争斗中，明斯特主教被俘，关押于此以待赎金。1367年，马克伯爵恩格尔贝特三世授予城堡下方的聚落有限的城市权利。到1392年，阿尔特纳已是地方行政官驻地，城堡还保存着伯国档案。1609年的继承争端后，马克伯国转归勃兰登堡。

english:
Altenburg stands on the Pleisse in the fertile Osterland, where low hills and open farmland form the eastern edge of Thuringia. The river supplied water and mills, roads crossed toward Leipzig and Bohemia, and the surrounding fields supported a substantial rural population. A Slavic castle on the Schlossberg guarded the crossing before the German town developed.

Altenburg was first mentioned in a deed of 976. Its position on the Via Imperii between Halle and Cheb made it part of the salt trade, while the Hohenstaufen emperors made the town an imperial palatinate during the twelfth century. Frederick Barbarossa visited several times and encouraged building around the market. A mint, priory and parish church developed under imperial patronage.

The Augustinian monastery’s twin towers, known as the Red Spires, survive from the twelfth century, and a wall with five gates enclosed the town by about 1200. After the defeat at Lucka in 1307, the Wettin margraves gained Altenburg and the Pleisse lands. The town remained a regional residence and market center, combining imperial roads, crafts and fertile agriculture. Craftsmen and merchants gathered around its market.
simp_chinese:
阿尔滕堡位于肥沃奥斯特兰的普莱瑟河畔，低丘与开阔农田构成图林根东部边缘。河流供水并推动磨坊，道路通往莱比锡和波希米亚，周围田地供养较多人口。城堡山上的斯拉夫堡垒在德意志城镇形成前守卫渡口。

阿尔滕堡976年首次见于文献。它位于哈雷至海布的帝国大道上，参与盐业贸易；十二世纪霍亨斯陶芬皇帝又使城镇成为帝国行宫。腓特烈·巴巴罗萨多次到访并推动市场周边建设。铸币所、修院和堂区教堂在帝国保护下发展。

奥古斯丁修院双塔“红尖塔”保存十二世纪建筑，约1200年五座城门的城墙围住城镇。1307年卢卡战败后，韦廷藩侯取得阿尔滕堡及普莱瑟地区。城镇继续作为区域居所和市场中心，把帝国道路、手工业与肥沃农业结合起来。工匠与商人在市场周围聚集。

english:
Altenkirchen in the Westerwald was recorded in 1131 as an estate of the church of Saints Cassius and Florentius in Bonn. The counts of Sayn acquired it and built a castle, and King Louis the Bavarian granted town rights in 1314. The counts introduced the Reformation in 1561, and their estates met here in 1574 and 1584.

Inheritance divisions made Altenkirchen the seat of a branch of the house of Sayn that passed by marriage to the dukes of Saxe-Eisenach in 1661. A great fire destroyed almost the whole town in 1728. It later passed through Brandenburg-Ansbach, Prussia and Nassau before returning to Prussia in 1815. French and imperial forces fought a battle nearby in 1796; the French general Marceau died in the town after being wounded in later fighting.
simp_chinese:
韦斯特瓦尔德地区的阿尔滕基兴于1131年见诸记载，当时是波恩圣卡修斯与圣弗洛伦提乌斯教会的庄园。赛恩伯爵取得此地并修筑城堡，国王巴伐利亚的路易于1314年授予城市权。伯爵于1561年推行宗教改革，领地等级会议于1574年和1584年在此召开。

继承分封使阿尔滕基兴成为赛恩家族一支的驻地，1661年它通过婚姻归于萨克森—艾森纳赫。1728年大火几乎毁掉全城。此后领地先后归勃兰登堡—安斯巴赫、普鲁士和拿骚，1815年又重归普鲁士。1796年，法国与帝国军队在附近交战；法军将领马尔索在后来的战斗中受伤，于城中去世。

english:
Altınekin, formerly Zıvarık, stands on the dry uplands of Konya Province near the site of the ancient city of Pegella. Its broad district is dominated by grain fields, low hills and open plains where rainfall is uncertain and wells are essential. The name Altınekin, “golden crop,” refers to the fertility of the soil when water is available.

During the Seljuk period, Zıvarık prospered because it lay on the trade road between Ankara and Konya. The fourteenth-century Zıvarık Han provided shelter, water and security for caravans, and a wooden mosque served the surrounding community. Merchants carried grain, salt and textiles across the plateau, while villages supplied animals, food and repairs. The caravanserai's stone walls made the settlement a recognised stage on a long and exposed route.

The Ottoman state incorporated the region into its provincial system while maintaining the importance of agriculture and horse breeding. Routes shifted gradually, but the old road, mosque and han continued to anchor the town. Settlement spread among neighbouring villages, and the upland fields produced cereals, fodder and livestock. Altınekin's later identity remained tied to the caravan route that had once made Zıvarık an active centre of Anatolian trade.
simp_chinese:
阿尔特内金旧名泽瓦勒克，位于科尼亚省干燥高原，邻近古代佩盖拉城。县域以粮田、低丘和开阔平原为主，降雨不稳定，井水十分关键。“阿尔特内金”意为金色庄稼，指有水时土壤的肥沃。

塞尔柱时期，泽瓦勒克因处在安卡拉至科尼亚商路而繁荣。十四世纪的泽瓦勒克商队驿站为商旅提供住所、饮水和保护，木制清真寺则服务周围社群。商人越过高原运送谷物、盐和织物，村庄供应牲畜、食物和修理。驿站石墙使聚落成为漫长道路上可辨识的站点。

奥斯曼国家把当地纳入行省体系，农业和养马业继续重要。道路后来逐渐改变，清真寺、驿站和旧路仍构成地方身份的支点。聚落散布在邻村之间，高地田地出产谷物、饲料并放牧牲畜。阿尔特内金后来的地位，始终离不开曾使泽瓦勒克活跃的商队路线，驿站和宗教建筑则把过往商旅留在城镇中心。

english:
Altıntaş lies in the highlands of Kütahya Province in western Anatolia. Its Turkish name means “goldstone” and refers to the district's abundant stone, especially marble. That geological wealth was used in antiquity: marble quarried nearby went into the construction of Aizanoi. The Roman city of Soa also stood within the present district, while Abya, near Pınarcık village, produced its own coins. A mausoleum at Osmaniye dates from the second or third century, and Chalcolithic artifacts show occupation long before Roman rule.

The highland setting joined broad plains, wooded slopes and routes between the interior and western Anatolia. Farms and villages supplied grain, livestock and timber, while quarrymen and stoneworkers moved between imperial cities. Rural society retained its own customs during the Byzantine and Turkish conquests, and its landscape kept the visible remains of villas, roads and tombs for later settlements.

Stone and inherited architecture continued to mark the district. The Seydisül Tomb incorporates a Byzantine arch showing the Deesis, an example of older Christian stonework reused within a later Muslim structure. In the Ottoman period, a rebellion was suppressed at Altıntaş during the reign of Sultan Bayezid II. Ancient quarrying, rival Roman towns and reused Byzantine stone thus remain joined within one Anatolian upland landscape.
simp_chinese:
阿尔滕塔什位于安纳托利亚西部屈塔希亚省的高地，土耳其语名称意为“金石”，指区内丰富的大型石材，尤其是大理石。早在古代，当地开采的石料便用于修建附近的艾扎诺伊。罗马城市索阿也位于今日区境，皮纳尔哲克村附近的阿比亚曾铸造钱币；奥斯曼尼耶村有二至三世纪陵墓，铜石并用时代遗物更说明罗马统治以前很久已有人活动。

高地环境由平原、林坡及连接内陆与安纳托利亚西部的道路组成。农田和村庄供应谷物、牲畜和木材，采石者与石匠则在帝国城市之间流动。拜占庭统治和突厥征服时期，乡村社会保留自身习俗，景观中的别墅、道路和墓葬遗迹又被后来的聚落继续利用。

石材与旧建筑持续影响地方历史。塞迪苏尔陵墓采用带有耶稣与圣徒图像的拜占庭拱券，显示旧基督教石构被后来的穆斯林建筑重新使用。奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德二世在位时，阿尔滕塔什的一场战斗平定了叛乱。古代采石、罗马城市和再利用的拜占庭石材，至今仍叠合在同一片安纳托利亚高地景观中。

english:
Altit stands in the Hunza Valley of Gilgit-Baltistan, above irrigated terraces and the river gorge. Its Burusho population speaks Burushaski, and the name Altit means “this side down” in that language. The older names Hunukushal and Broshal preserve traditions of migration and the spread of Burushaski speakers.

The fort and Shikari Tower are roughly a thousand years old. They were the residence of the Mirs of Hunza before the ruling family moved to the younger Baltit Fort three centuries later. Small rooms, low doorways and carved timber reflect a mountain architecture suited to scarce fuel and steep ground.

Hunza controlled a taxing point between the Indus and the passes toward China. Orchard irrigation, livestock and wool supported the population, while the Mirs drew wealth from trade and tolls. The arrival of Islam in the fifteenth century gradually changed local ritual, and most inhabitants converted by the early nineteenth.

A sixteenth-century marriage with Baltistan is traditionally linked to the rebuilding of Altit and Baltit forts; the bride brought Balti craftsmen, whose work shaped the carved interiors. The fort therefore combines local Burusho rule, mountain agriculture and wider connections across the Karakoram.
simp_chinese:
阿尔提特位于吉尔吉特—巴尔蒂斯坦的罕萨谷地，俯瞰灌溉梯田与河峡。居民属于布鲁绍人，使用布鲁沙斯基语；地名意为“这一侧向下”。旧名胡努库沙尔和布罗沙尔保存着迁徙及布鲁沙斯基语传播的记忆。

城堡和希卡里塔约有千年历史，曾是罕萨米尔家族的居所；三百年后，统治家族才迁往较新的巴尔提特堡。小房间、低门洞和木雕适应燃料稀少、坡地陡峻的山地环境。

罕萨控制印度河与中国方向山口之间的收费节点。果园灌溉、牲畜和羊毛维持人口，米尔则从贸易与关税获利。十五世纪传入的伊斯兰教逐步改变地方礼仪，至十九世纪初大多数居民已经改宗。

传统把十六世纪同巴尔蒂斯坦的联姻同阿尔提特、巴尔提特两堡的重建联系起来；公主带来巴尔蒂工匠，其技艺塑造了木雕室内。城堡因此汇聚布鲁绍地方统治、山地农业与跨越喀喇昆仑的更大联系。

english: Altun Ha was a Maya center in the lowlands of northern Belize, a short distance inland from the Caribbean coast. Its temples and plazas stood amid a landscape of settlements linked to trade between the coast and the interior. A carved jade head of the sun god Kinich Ahau, found in a tomb beneath a temple, attests to the wealth and craftsmanship of its Classic-period rulers. After a long decline, the site saw renewed, smaller-scale occupation in the late Postclassic period.
simp_chinese: 阿尔通哈是伯利兹北部低地的一处玛雅中心，距加勒比海岸不远。它的神庙和广场周围分布着众多聚落，参与海岸与内陆之间的贸易。一座神庙下的墓葬出土了太阳神基尼奇·阿豪的玉雕头像，展示了古典期统治者的财富与工匠的技艺。经过长期衰落，这里在后古典期晚期又出现规模较小的居住活动。

english: Altun Kupri stands on the Little Zab between Kirkuk and Erbil. The river divides around a rocky island, giving the town a distinctive setting at an important crossing. Its Turkish name means “golden bridge”, while its Kurdish name Pirdi also refers to a bridge. Ottoman bridges crossed the two channels before the eighteenth century, linking the island settlement to both banks. In the early nineteenth century Muhammad Pasha of Soran extended his authority to the town as his mountain principality grew.
simp_chinese: 阿尔通库普里位于基尔库克与埃尔比勒之间的小扎卜河上。河流绕一座岩岛分成两支，使城镇在重要渡口拥有独特的位置。突厥语名称意为「金桥」，库尔德语名称皮尔迪也指桥梁。十八世纪以前，奥斯曼桥梁已横跨两条水道，将岛上聚落与两岸连接。十九世纪初，索兰的穆罕默德帕夏扩大山地公国势力，将此镇纳入其权威之下。

english: The Altun Mountains stretch along the southeastern edge of the Tarim Basin, separating its desert from the high Tibetan Plateau. Their ridges rise above the oases of Charchan and Ruoqiang, while the dry uplands to the south contain enclosed basins and salt lakes. The mountains form a long barrier between the southern Tarim road and the interior of the plateau, broken by difficult passes and valleys.
simp_chinese: 阿尔金山沿塔里木盆地东南缘延伸，将盆地沙漠与青藏高原隔开。山岭耸立在且末、若羌绿洲之上，南面的干燥高地则分布着封闭盆地和盐湖。绵长山脉是塔里木南道与高原腹地之间的屏障，仅有艰险的山口与谷地可以穿越。

sources.title: 2008 Silk Roads of Northern Tibetan Plateau during Early Middle Ages by Tong s.pdf

english:
The Altyn-Tagh forms a boundary between the Tarim Basin and the Tibetan Plateau. Its eastern reaches separate Qinghai from Xinjiang and Gansu. Near the eastern end of the range, routes leaving the Hexi Corridor led towards the northern and southern margins of the Tarim Basin. The mountains helped define the difficult southern edge of that wider network of oasis routes.

The range also separates different dry basins. To its west and south, the Altyn-Tagh helps enclose the Qaidam Basin and the V-shaped endorheic country shared with the Kunlun. Farther east it divides the western side of Qaidam from the Kumtagh Desert. Its profile changes repeatedly: rugged snowy peaks in the southwest, average elevations near 4,000 metres in the middle, and renewed ranges around 5,000 metres in the east.

Rivers are few in this dry mountain wall. Small western streams descend toward desert basins or Lake Ayakkum, while much of the range remains without surface water. The result is a high barrier crossed through scattered passes rather than a single corridor.
simp_chinese:
阿尔金山脉是塔里木盆地与青藏高原之间的分界，其东段分隔青海与新疆、甘肃。山脉东端附近，出河西走廊的道路通向塔里木盆地南北两缘。这道山脉构成更广阔绿洲交通网络南侧的一处艰险边界。

山脉还分隔多片干旱盆地。西面和南面，它与昆仑山共同围出“V”形内流地带，并影响到柴达木盆地；再向东，阿尔金山又把柴达木盆地西侧同库姆塔格沙漠隔开，使荒漠与高盆地分属两侧。山势沿走向变化明显，西南是崎岖雪峰，中部平均约4000米，东部又升至约5000米。

这座干燥山墙上的河流很少。西部小溪流向荒漠盆地或阿牙克库木湖，其余大部分山体缺少地表水。因此，它是一道靠零散山口穿越的高耸屏障，并非一条单一通道。

english: The Altun Mountains form a long barrier along the northern edge of the Tibetan Plateau. Their eastern ridges meet the Qilian Mountains near the western end of the Hexi Corridor. To the south lies the dry Qaidam Basin; to the north, routes of the Silk Road skirt the mountains towards the Tarim Basin. The Turkic name Altyn Tagh means “gold mountain”.
simp_chinese: 阿尔金山沿青藏高原北缘形成绵长屏障，东部山脊在河西走廊西端附近与祁连山相接。南面是干旱的柴达木盆地，北面的丝绸之路沿山脉通往塔里木盆地。山名阿尔金塔格在突厥语中意为“金山”。

english: Altyntobe, the 'golden mound', rises above the left bank of the Karzhansu in the foothills south of Shymkent. From the tenth to the sixteenth century a fortified town stood here on the Silk Road: a square central mound 13 to 15 metres high, ringed by a ditch, with a platform of some 140 by 80 metres beside it, enclosed on three sides by an earthen rampart, and a steep drop to the river on the east. Jugs and ornamented bowls have been found among its buildings.
simp_chinese: 阿尔滕托别意为“金丘”，位于奇姆肯特以南的山前地带，卡尔然苏河左岸。十至十六世纪，这里有一座丝绸之路上的设防城镇：方形主丘高13至15米，四周环绕壕沟；旁边是一片约140米乘80米、三面围着土垒的台地，东边陡坡直落河岸。遗址中出土过陶壶和带纹饰的碗。

english: Altyshevo lies northeast of Alatyr in the forest country of the Sura basin. Founded by Erzya settlers from Alovo no later than 1612, it was also known as Altyshevskaya Polyana, the clearing of Altyshevo. Its inhabitants paid tribute as yasak peasants before becoming palace peasants in the eighteenth century. Fields and woodland around the village formed part of the mixed agricultural landscape of the Alatyr district.
simp_chinese: 阿尔特舍沃位于阿拉季尔东北，地处苏拉河流域的林区。村庄由来自阿洛沃的厄尔兹亚人建立，最迟见于1612年，也称阿尔特舍沃林中空地。居民最初作为缴纳牙萨克贡赋的农民，18世纪转为宫廷农民。村庄周围田地与森林交错，是阿拉季尔地区农业景观的一部分。

english:
Alubera is an indigenous name for Tobago, an island northeast of Trinidad at the southeastern approach to the Caribbean.
