Amiskaciwiy’s early history belongs to this meeting of prairie, beaver country and the river routes that linked the interior of northern North America.
simp_chinese:
阿米斯卡奇维是克里语地名，指萨斯喀彻温林草交错带中的“海狸丘”乡野，开阔草原在这里与白杨和柳树林相接。低丘、浅湖和河谷切分平原。海狸、野牛和水禽提供食物、毛皮与材料，林脊则为冬季挡风。

克里人家庭远在欧洲地图命名以前便往来于此。他们沿季节性小径往返猎场、渔湖和营地，并同阿西尼博因等邻族交换物品。地名保存的是海狸栖息地的重要性，而非某座建立的城市或堡垒。

1690年起，欧洲探险者进入萨斯喀彻温地区；到1774年，商人已建立最早的定居点。毛皮站把原住民猎人接入更大市场，但大量往来仍沿旧有小径进行。冬季营地通常设在靠近平草、猎物和干柴的林谷。阿米斯卡奇维的早期历史，正属于草原、海狸栖地和通往北美内陆的河路交汇。

english: The ǂ'Amkoe languages belong to the Kx'a family of southern Africa and are spoken on the margins of the Kalahari. Their varieties include Nǃaqriaxe, ǂHoan and Sasi. Like neighbouring Gǀui and Taa, ǂ'Amkoe has an exceptionally rich set of consonants, including clicks made with the lips as well as with the tongue. Its speakers have long lived among communities speaking other languages of the Kalahari.
simp_chinese: 阿姆科埃语属于南部非洲的克哈语系，使用者生活在卡拉哈里边缘。其变体包括纳克里亚赫、霍安和萨西。与邻近的格维语、塔语一样，阿姆科埃语的辅音极为丰富，既有用舌头发出的搭嘴音，也有用双唇发出的搭嘴音。使用这一语言的人与卡拉哈里其他语言社群长期相邻而居。

english:
Åmli lies in the uplands of Agder in southern Norway, among forested valleys, lakes and rocky ground. The region began as a petty kingdom and, after Norwegian unification, formed part of Egðafylki and later Agdesiden. Small farms occupied the valley floors and lower slopes, while hunters, herders and charcoal burners used the surrounding forests.

During the Middle Ages, the area became part of the diocese and parish system of southern Norway. The church at Åmli served a dispersed rural population, and local assemblies handled disputes and taxation. Timber, iron and livestock connected inland valleys with the coastal towns of Arendal and Kristiansand. Rivers carried logs downstream when water levels were high, while winter sledges used frozen tracks.

The county of Agdesiden was divided during the seventeenth century into smaller administrative districts, removing the old name from official use for a long period. Farms nevertheless preserved local names and boundaries, and the village at Åmli grew around a church and later a transport route. Its upland location kept settlement scattered; the landscape was organized around farms and forest work rather than a dominant town.
simp_chinese:
奥姆利位于挪威南部阿格德尔高地，周围是森林谷地、湖泊与岩石地面。该地区最初是小王国，挪威统一后先后属于埃格达郡和阿格德西登。小农庄占据谷底和低坡，猎人、牧民及烧炭者在周围森林活动。

中世纪时，当地纳入南挪威的教区和主教区体系。奥姆利教堂服务分散的乡村人口，地方会议处理纠纷和税收。木材、铁和牲畜把内陆谷地与阿伦达尔、克里斯蒂安桑等沿海城镇联系起来。水位高时河流可放运木材，冬季雪橇则沿冻结道路运输。

十七世纪，阿格德西登被划成若干较小行政单位，旧名称长期退出官方使用。农庄保存了地方名称与边界，奥姆利村则围绕教堂和后来的交通路线发展。高地位置使聚落保持分散，地方生活由农庄与林区劳动组织，而非一座占支配地位的城镇。

english:
Amman occupies a group of hills where the Levantine plateau opens toward the desert. Springs and arable valleys made the site suitable for settlement, while routes crossed the surrounding ridges between Syria, Palestine and Arabia. Its high position offered defence but divided the town into steep quarters and narrow wadis.

By the Iron Age the city was Rabat Aman, capital of the Ammonite kingdom. It controlled farmland, grazing and caravan roads; olive oil, grain and trade goods supported a fortified royal centre. The Assyrians, Babylonians, Persians and Hellenistic kingdoms absorbed the region into wider empires.

Ptolemaic rule renamed the city Philadelphia, and the Romans incorporated it into the Decapolis. Colonnaded streets, theatres and baths were added around the old citadel. Control passed to the Byzantines and then to the Rashidun Caliphate in the seventh century, when the name Amman returned.

Earthquakes, changes in trade and the movement of imperial centres reduced the town to a small settlement during the later Islamic and Ottoman centuries. Villages and Bedouin groups still used nearby springs and pastures, but the ancient urban fabric lay largely abandoned. The earlier city remained visible in its citadel, theatre and fragments of monumental streets.
simp_chinese:
安曼坐落在一片丘陵上，黎凡特高原在这里向沙漠敞开。泉水和可耕谷地适宜定居，道路则穿过周围山脊，连接叙利亚、巴勒斯坦和阿拉伯地区。高地为防御提供优势，却把城市分成陡峭街区和狭窄干谷。

铁器时代，这里是亚扪王国都城拉巴特阿曼。城市控制农田、牧场和商队道路，橄榄油、谷物与贸易品支撑设防王城。亚述、巴比伦、波斯以及后来的希腊化王国先后把地区纳入更大帝国。

托勒密王朝把城市改名费拉德尔菲亚，罗马又将其纳入十城地区。围绕旧卫城修建了列柱街、剧场和浴场。七世纪控制权转入拜占庭和正统哈里发国，安曼旧名随之恢复。

地震、商路变化和帝国中心转移，使城市在晚期伊斯兰与奥斯曼时代缩为小型聚落。附近村庄和贝都因群体仍利用泉水和牧场，古老城区则大体荒废，只留卫城、剧场与纪念性街道的残迹。

english: The Ammonoosuc rises on the western slopes of Mount Washington in the White Mountains. One branch begins at the Lakes of the Clouds, high between Mount Washington and Mount Monroe. The river flows west and then southwest through the mountain country to meet the Connecticut. Its Abenaki name means “small, narrow fishing place,” recalling the waters that descend from the high peaks.
simp_chinese: 阿莫努苏克河发源于白山中华盛顿山的西坡。一条源流来自华盛顿山与门罗山之间高处的云中湖。河水先向西、再向西南穿过山地，最后汇入康涅狄格河。它的阿贝纳基语名称意为“狭小的捕鱼之处”，令人想起从高峰流下的水域。

english: Ammoscongon is an Eastern Abenaki name for the Androscoggin River above the Great Falls. From its northern reaches, the river winds through the wooded interior before joining the Kennebec at Merrymeeting Bay. Its many falls mark the descent toward the sea. Below the Great Falls, the river was known by another name, Pejepscook; the English name Androscoggin was derived from the name of the upper river.
simp_chinese: 阿莫斯康贡是东阿贝纳基人对大瀑布以上安德罗斯科金河的称呼。河水从北方蜿蜒穿过森林内陆，在梅里米廷湾与肯尼贝克河汇合；沿途众多瀑布见证了河流向海的落差。大瀑布以下的河段另有佩杰普斯库克之名，而英语中的安德罗斯科金则来自上游河段的名称。

english:
Amnye Machen rises above Golog in southeastern Qinghai as the highest peak of the mountain range bearing its name. The massif is an eastern extension of the Kunlun Mountains and runs from northwest to southeast through Golog and adjacent parts of Hainan, reaching toward Gannan in Gansu. High ridges, exposed slopes and thin air give the range an austere setting. In Tibetan Buddhism it is revered as the home of Machen Pomra, the chief indigenous deity of Amdo. The mountain is inseparable from the course of the Yellow River.

The river travels for hundreds of kilometres along the southwest side of the range through Golog before turning nearly 180 degrees near the borders of Gansu and Sichuan. It then passes along the northeast side and flows northwest through other parts of northeastern Qinghai. The ridge thus helps define one of the great bends of the river, joining sacred geography to the wider hydrology of the high plateau. Pilgrimage gave the range a lasting place in communal life.

The peak itself was estimated at 6,282 metres, but knowledge of it reached wider audiences gradually.
simp_chinese:
阿尼玛卿耸立于青海东南部果洛之上，是同名山脉的最高峰。这座山系属于昆仑山脉的东部延伸，自西北向东南穿过果洛以及海南藏族自治州的相邻地区，并伸向甘肃甘南。高耸的山脊、裸露的坡面和稀薄的空气塑造出严酷环境。在藏传佛教中，这里被尊为安多首席本土山神玛卿博拉的居所。

这座山与黄河的流向密不可分。河水沿山脉西南侧流经果洛数百公里，在接近甘肃与四川边界处几乎转向一百八十度，再从东北侧经过，向西北流过青海东北部的若干地区。山脊因此参与了黄河一次宏大转折的形成，使神圣地理与高原地表水系紧密相连。围绕山峰的朝圣活动长期维系着共同体的记忆。

山峰海拔估算为六千二百八十二米，但外界对它的了解逐步才扩大。

english:
Amol stands beside the Haraz River in the fertile lowlands south of the Caspian Sea. A major town of medieval Tabaristan, it was known for its mosques and markets among the trees by the river. Its surviving monuments include the characteristic tomb towers of Mazandaran, small round or many-sided structures crowned by steep roofs.

In 1359 Mir Qewam al-Din established a Shiite principality based at Amol. Timur sacked the city in 1393, massacred its inhabitants and deported the ruling sayyids to Samarqand. Under Shah Abbas I, the shrine of Mir Bozorg was rebuilt as an elaborate domed complex, decorated inside with painted tiles. Bridges built in his reign crossed the rivers of Mazandaran, including a twelve-arched bridge linking Amol to its eastern suburb.
simp_chinese:
阿莫勒坐落在里海南方肥沃低地的哈拉兹河畔，是中古塔巴里斯坦的重要城镇。城中清真寺和市场散布于河边树木之间。现存建筑中有马赞达兰颇具特色的墓塔：小巧的圆形或多边形建筑上覆盖着陡峭的屋顶。

1359年，米尔·格瓦姆丁以阿莫勒为中心建立什叶派政权。1393年帖木儿攻陷城市，屠杀居民，并将统治当地的赛义德家族迁往撒马尔罕。沙阿阿拔斯一世时期，米尔博佐尔格圣陵重建为精美的穹顶建筑群，内部饰有彩绘瓷砖。他在位时还在马赞达兰各河上修桥，其中一座十二拱桥将阿莫勒与东郊连接起来。

english:
Amol stood beside an important crossing of the Oxus on the road from Merv to Bukhara. Desert surrounded the river oasis, but the crossing joined Khorasan with Transoxiana. The town of Farab lay opposite on the other bank. Medieval writers distinguished this Amol from its namesake near the Caspian by calling it Amol on the Oxus or Amol of the desert. Its name was also associated with the river itself, later called the Amu Darya.

Restored after the Mongol conquest, Amol remained inhabited through the fourteenth century and served the Timurids as a strategic crossing. From the late fifteenth century the name Charjuy, referring to four channels, gradually replaced the older name. Muhammad Shaybani took the town in 1504, and it became part of the Uzbek realm associated with Bukhara. Boats carried travellers and merchants across the broad river; armies could be moved over on bridges of boats. In 1740 Nader Shah crossed here during his campaign against Bukhara, demonstrating the continuing importance of the passage.
simp_chinese:
阿模里位于阿姆河的重要渡口旁，处在木鹿通往布哈拉的道路上。河边绿洲周围尽是沙漠，但渡口将呼罗珊与河中相连。对岸是法拉布城。中世纪作家为区别里海附近的同名城市，称此地为“阿姆河畔的阿模里”或“沙漠阿模里”。地名也与河流本身有关，河后来被称为阿姆河。

蒙古征服后，阿模里得到重建，十四世纪仍有人居住，并在帖木儿王朝时期作为战略渡口。十五世纪末起，意为“四条水道”的察尔朱逐渐取代旧名。1504年穆罕默德·昔班尼占领此城，它成为与布哈拉相连的乌兹别克政权的一部分。船只运送旅人和商人渡过宽阔河流，大军则可通过浮桥。1740年纳迪尔沙征讨布哈拉时从这里渡河，显示了渡口持续的重要性。

english: Amollan, also called Amula, was a lordship in the southern highlands of Jalisco. Its territory extended toward the slopes of the volcanoes and included communities such as Tuxcacuesco, Tonaya and Zapotitlán. By 1580 a colonial account recorded a severe decline in the population of Amula, and the seat of the district had moved to Tuxcacuesco. Indigenous people from Amula founded the settlement of San Gabriel in 1576.
simp_chinese: 阿莫兰又称阿穆拉，曾是哈利斯科南部高地的一个领地。其领土延伸至火山山坡，包含图斯卡库埃斯科、托纳亚和萨波蒂特兰等社区。1580年的一份殖民记载称阿穆拉人口锐减，辖区中心已迁往图斯卡库埃斯科。1576年，来自阿穆拉的原住民建立了圣加夫列尔聚落。

english: Amoltepec lies in the mountainous Mixtec country of western Oaxaca, where steep ridges and pine-oak forest separate small river valleys. Mixtec communities farmed maize, beans and squash on the terraces and mined copper and other ores in the hills. A painted map from around 1580 records settlements, place names and features of the region, and it shows how Mixtec lords and their towns were organized before colonial reordering. Trails linked the valley to the Oaxaca basin and to the coast, carrying salt, cloth and metal goods between the highlands and the lowlands.
simp_chinese: 阿莫尔特佩克位于奥阿哈卡西部的米斯特克山区，陡峭山脊与松栎林分隔着一座座小河谷。米斯特克社群在梯田上种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，并在山中开采铜矿和其他矿石。约1580年绘制的一幅图画地图记录了该地区的聚落、地名与地貌，显示了殖民重组之前米斯特克领主及其城镇的组织方式。小路把河谷与奥阿哈卡盆地及沿海地区相连，在高地与低地之间运送盐、布匹和金属器具。

english: The Amomegosode were one of the local groups of the Ayoreo, whose homeland stretched across the forests and dry plains of the northern Chaco. Ayoreo groups moved through extensive territories, hunting and gathering while planting small fields in the rainy season. Each group had its own leadership and could divide or reunite as circumstances changed. Together their territories formed Eami, the country known through generations of Ayoreo life.
simp_chinese: 阿莫梅戈索德是阿约雷奥人的地方群体之一，其故土横跨查科北部的森林与干燥平原。阿约雷奥各群体在广阔领地内迁徙，以狩猎采集为生，也在雨季种植小块田地。各群体拥有自己的领袖，并可随情况分开或重新聚合。这些领地共同组成埃阿米，即世代阿约雷奥人熟悉的土地。

english: Amonokoa lies near the Mississippi and the mouth of Henderson Creek. Farther north on the river is Yellow Banks, a landing known to the Sauk and Meskwaki. In April 1832 Black Hawk and his band crossed the Mississippi near this place, returning to the Illinois side after spending the winter near the old Fort Madison. Their movement led into the Black Hawk War. The Phelps brothers laid out the town of Oquawka at Yellow Banks in 1836.
simp_chinese: 阿莫诺夸靠近密西西比河与亨德森溪河口。沿河向北是黄岸渡口，索克人和梅斯夸基人熟悉此地。1832年4月，黑鹰及其部众在旧麦迪逊堡附近过冬后，在此地附近渡过密西西比河，返回伊利诺伊一侧；这次行动引出了黑鹰战争。1836年，费尔普斯兄弟在黄岸规划了奥夸卡镇。

english: Amora Gadal lies east of Lake Ashenge, where the Ethiopian highlands descend toward the Afar lowlands. In the fifteenth century the Dobe'a inhabited the country between Ashenge and Enderta, adjoining the Afar sultanate of Dankali to the east. Emperor Ba'eda Maryam campaigned against the Dobe'a and encouraged their conversion to Christianity. The traveller Francisco Álvares later described Manadeley, a market town on the highland edge, as a gathering place for merchants from lands as distant as Egypt and India.
simp_chinese: 阿莫拉加达勒位于阿申盖湖以东，埃塞俄比亚高地在这里向阿法尔低地下降。十五世纪，多贝亚人居住在阿申盖与恩德尔塔之间，东邻阿法尔人的丹卡利苏丹国。贝达·马利亚姆皇帝曾征讨多贝亚人，并鼓励他们皈依基督教。旅行者弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯后来记述，高地边缘的集镇马纳德莱伊吸引了远自埃及和印度的商人。

english: Amorgos, the easternmost of the Cyclades, lies on the sea route between the Aegean islands and the coast of Asia Minor. On its steep southern shore stands the monastery of Chozoviotissa, whose foundation is recorded in later documents as dating to the reign of Emperor Alexios I Komnenos in 1088. Its buildings cling to a cliff above the sea. The island passed among Venetian lords after the Fourth Crusade and was taken by the Ottoman admiral Hayreddin Barbarossa in 1537. The monastery remained a centre of religious life through the centuries that followed.
simp_chinese: 阿莫戈斯是基克拉泽斯群岛最东端的岛屿，位于爱琴海群岛与小亚细亚海岸之间的航路上。南岸陡峭的悬崖上建有霍佐维奥提萨修道院；后世文献记载，它于1088年阿莱克修斯一世在位时创建。修道院建筑紧贴岩壁，俯临大海。第四次十字军东征后，岛屿先后落入威尼斯领主之手，1537年又被奥斯曼海军统帅海雷丁·巴巴罗萨夺取。此后数百年，修道院仍是岛上宗教生活的中心。

english:
Amoskeag Falls descend over a short stretch of the Merrimack River. The Pennacook name Namoskeag means approximately “good fishing place,” and Indigenous people caught migrating salmon, sturgeon and alewives in its rapids, sometimes using large nets stretched across the river. Settlements stood nearby, including on the high eastern bank overlooking the falls and its abundant fishing grounds.

A 1634 account described Amoskeag as a notable Indigenous habitation. In 1807 Samuel Blodgett began a canal and lock system to let boats pass around the falls. The river drops fifty feet over a quarter mile here, and that water power was later used to drive mills along its banks. The Amoskeag Manufacturing Company became central to the growth of Manchester as a textile town.
simp_chinese:
阿莫斯基格瀑布是梅里马克河上一段短促而陡降的水流。彭纳库克语名称纳莫斯基格大致意为“好渔场”，原住民在急流中捕捉洄游的鲑鱼、鲟鱼和西鲱，有时将大网横布河面。附近有居民聚落，包括俯瞰瀑布和丰饶渔场的东岸高地。

1634年的一份记载称阿莫斯基格是重要的原住民居住地。1807年，塞缪尔·布洛杰特开始修建运河和船闸，让船只绕过瀑布。河水在四分之一英里内下降五十英尺，这股水力后来用于驱动工厂，阿莫斯基格制造公司成为曼彻斯特纺织城镇成长的核心。

english: Åmot takes its name from a meeting of rivers: here the Rena joins the Glomma in the forested valley of Østerdalen. North of the junction the Glomma alternates between swift reaches and deeper pools; below it the river becomes broader and quieter. Farms and woodlands along these waterways formed part of a district whose river carried timber downstream towards the sea.
simp_chinese: 奥莫特因河流交汇而得名：雷纳河在林木茂密的东达伦谷地汇入格洛马河。汇合处以北，格洛马河的急流与深潭交替；往南河面渐宽，水流也趋于平缓。沿岸的农庄和森林属于这片河谷地区，河流将木材向下游运往海边。

english: Point Amour faces the Strait of Belle Isle from the southern coast of Labrador, across the narrow water from Newfoundland. The strait's currents, seasonal ice and fog make it a difficult passage between the Gulf of St. Lawrence and the Atlantic. Near the point, a stone burial mound overlooking the water bears witness to a child buried by Maritime Archaic people some 7,700 years ago. In the sixteenth century Basque whalers came to the strait, arriving when the ice cleared and departing before winter.
simp_chinese: 阿穆尔角位于拉布拉多南岸，面向贝尔岛海峡，隔着狭窄水道与纽芬兰相望。海峡的潮流、季节性海冰与浓雾，使这条连接圣劳伦斯湾和大西洋的水路颇为险峻。岬角附近一座俯瞰海面的石冢，见证了约七千七百年前海洋古文化人群安葬一名孩童的仪式。十六世纪，巴斯克捕鲸人来到海峡，在冰消后抵达、冬季来临前离去。

english:
Amoyeli Gunahita is the Cherokee name for Long Island in the Holston River, a sacred meeting place on the Great Indian Warrior Path. Travellers following the route between the Cherokee country and lands to the north crossed near the island, which also served as neutral ground for settling disputes. Its position made it valuable to traders and settlers as well as to the Cherokee.

During the Cherokee War of 1776, fighting reached the Holston settlements near the island. The following year Cherokee representatives met commissioners from North Carolina and Virginia at Long Island and concluded treaties of peace that ceded further land. The Cherokee retained their claim to the island itself until a later treaty in 1806 transferred it to the United States.
simp_chinese:
阿莫耶利·古纳希塔是霍尔斯顿河长岛的切罗基语名称。这座岛是大印第安勇士之路上的神圣会盟地，旅行者沿路往返切罗基地区与北方土地时会经过附近。岛上也作为中立地点处理纷争，其位置使它对商人、移民和切罗基人都十分重要。

1776年的切罗基战争期间，战火波及岛附近的霍尔斯顿聚落。次年，切罗基代表与北卡罗来纳及弗吉尼亚的专员在长岛会晤，缔结和平条约，并割让更多土地。切罗基人继续保有对岛本身的权利，直到1806年条约将其转交美国。

english: Amoyescheck lies near Kings Mountain in the Carolina backcountry. On 7 October 1780, Patriot militia from the Appalachian settlements and the Carolinas surrounded a Loyalist force on the wooded ridge. Its commander, Major Patrick Ferguson, was killed and his men defeated. The battle ended a British effort to secure the western Carolina frontier and strengthened resistance to Cornwallis's campaign in the South.
simp_chinese: 阿莫耶谢克靠近卡罗来纳内陆的金斯山。1780年10月7日，来自阿巴拉契亚聚落及卡罗来纳的爱国派民兵包围了山脊上的保王派部队。指挥官帕特里克·弗格森少校战死，其部队随之败北。这场战斗挫败了英国控制卡罗来纳西部边疆的努力，也加强了对康沃利斯南方战役的抵抗。

english: Ampotaka lies in the uplands near Andriba, south of the Betsiboka's middle course. Farther south the rolling Tampoketsa plateau is cut by valleys carrying tributaries towards the Ikopa, one of the Betsiboka's principal rivers. Seasonal rain feeds these watercourses, while steep-sided gullies known as lavaka scar parts of the highland slopes.
simp_chinese: 安普塔卡位于安德里巴附近的高地，在贝齐布卡河中游以南。更南面的坦普凯察高原起伏和缓，支流穿过山谷流向贝齐布卡河的主要支流伊库帕河。季节降雨补给这些水道，高地坡面上则分布着名为拉瓦卡的陡壁侵蚀沟。

english: Amqui lies where the Humqui River joins the Matapédia, downstream from Lake Matapédia. Mi'kmaq and Wolastoqiyik people travelled and lived in the valley before European settlement. In 1830 work began on the Kempt Road through the Matapédia country, linking the St. Lawrence valley with the Maritimes; the road was completed in 1833.
simp_chinese: 昂基位于于姆基河与马塔佩迪亚河交汇处，在马塔佩迪亚湖下游。欧洲人定居前，米克马克人和沃拉斯托基伊克人已在河谷生活、往来。1830年，穿过马塔佩迪亚地区的肯普特公路开始修建，连接圣劳伦斯河谷与滨海地区，1833年竣工。

english:
Amrabad occupies the Nallamala hills of the Eastern Ghats, where forested plateaus, deep valleys and rocky ridges make movement difficult. Seasonal streams and the Krishna system surround much of the country, while settlements remain scattered among fields and woodland. Chenchu communities have long depended on hunting, gathering, honey, roots and small-scale cultivation.

The forest formed both refuge and frontier. Kakatiya, Bahmani, Qutb Shahi and later Asaf Jahi rulers claimed the plains and passes, but direct control weakened inside the hills. Local chiefs and Chenchu groups maintained paths, sacred sites and access to seasonal harvests. Forts watched strategic routes rather than wide agricultural territories.

Amrabad became a market and administrative point where produce from the forest met lowland traders. Grain, pulses, honey and forest goods moved outward, while salt, cloth and metal entered. Rivers and difficult crossings made the plateau more isolated than its central position suggests.

By the early nineteenth century Amrabad remained a small upland centre within the Hyderabad state. Its importance came from links between hill communities, passes and markets, not from dense population. Forest and difficult terrain continued to preserve a distinct Chenchu country.
simp_chinese:
阿姆拉巴德位于东高止山脉的纳拉马拉丘陵，森林高原、深谷和岩脊令通行困难。季节河与克里希纳水系环绕大部分地区，聚落分散在田地与林地之间。琴楚社群长期依靠狩猎、采集蜂蜜和块根以及小规模耕作生活。

森林既是避难地，也是边境。卡卡提亚、巴赫曼尼、库特卜沙希以及后来的阿萨夫贾希统治者宣称控制平原和山口，但山内直接治理较弱。地方酋长和琴楚群体维护小径、圣地及季节资源的使用权，堡垒监视的是战略路线而非广阔农区。

阿姆拉巴德逐渐成为林产品与低地商人交汇的集市和行政点。谷物、豆类、蜂蜜和林货向外运出，盐、布匹和金属制品流入。河流与困难渡口使高原比其中心位置显得更加隔绝。

到十九世纪初，阿姆拉巴德仍是海得拉巴国家内的小型高地中心。它的重要性来自山地社群、山口与市场之间的联系，而非密集人口。森林与崎岖地形继续保存着独特的琴楚人家园。

english:
Amravati is a town of the Berar plain, known for the shrine of Ambadevi. Local tradition connects the goddess’s temple with the story of Krishna and Rukmini: Rukmini is said to have visited the shrine before Krishna carried her away from a marriage arranged against her wishes. The tale places the town within the sacred geography of Vidarbha, and the goddess has long been honoured by families throughout the region.

The Berar country passed through the hands of Deccan sultans and the Mughals before Maratha and Hyderabad authorities shared claims to its revenues in the eighteenth century. The Bhonsle rulers of Nagpur maintained collectors in Berar under this arrangement. The Ambadevi shrine continued to be a focus of local devotion; one account attributes repairs around 1660 to the ascetic Janardan Swami.
simp_chinese:
阿姆拉沃蒂是贝拉尔平原上的城镇，以安巴德维神庙闻名。当地传统将这座女神神庙与克里希纳和卢克米妮的故事联系起来：相传卢克米妮曾来此参拜，随后克里希纳带她离开一场违背她意愿的婚姻。这一传说使城镇成为维达尔巴圣地景观的一部分，女神长久以来受到地区各家族的尊奉。

贝拉尔地区先后由德干苏丹和莫卧儿统治，十八世纪马拉塔与海得拉巴当局共同分享对其税收的权利。那格浦尔的本斯勒统治者依照这一安排在贝拉尔派驻收税官。安巴德维神庙继续是当地信仰中心；一种记载将约1660年的修缮归于苦行者贾纳尔丹·斯瓦米。

english: Amreli lies in the interior of Saurashtra, among the plains and low hills of Kathiawar. In the eighteenth century the Maratha general Damaji Rao Gaekwad extended his influence into the peninsula. He established military posts at Amreli and nearby Lathi in 1742–43, placing the town within the expanding authority of the Gaekwad rulers of Baroda. Local chiefs and communities continued to shape the surrounding countryside under this larger power.
simp_chinese: 阿姆雷利位于索拉什特拉内陆、卡提阿瓦尔的平原与低丘之间。十八世纪，马拉塔将领达马吉·拉奥·盖克瓦德将影响扩展到半岛。他于1742至1743年在阿姆雷利和附近拉蒂设立军事据点，使城镇处于巴罗达盖克瓦德统治者不断扩大的权力之下。在这一较大势力治下，地方首领和社群继续塑造周围乡野。

english: Amrum is a North Frisian island with dunes and heath on its sandy ground, a broad western beach facing the North Sea, and tidal flats along its eastern shore. Frisian settlers arrived in the early Middle Ages, and the island appears in King Valdemar II's census book of 1231. Islanders combined fishing and agriculture with salt-making and seafaring. After struggles over Schleswig, Amrum and western Föhr remained Danish enclaves beside the duchy.
simp_chinese: 阿姆鲁姆是北弗里西亚群岛之一，沙质土地上分布着沙丘和石南荒地，西面宽阔的海滩面向北海，东岸则是潮间滩涂。弗里西亚人在中世纪早期来到岛上，1231年的瓦尔德马二世地籍册已有岛名。岛民从事渔业和农业，也煮盐、出海谋生。争夺石勒苏益格的战争后，阿姆鲁姆与西弗尔岛作为丹麦飞地保留在公国边上。

english:
Amsterdam takes its name from the dam built across the Amstel in the thirteenth century. The first record is the toll exemption Count Floris V gave to the people of Amstelredamme on 27 October 1275, and Bishop Guy of Utrecht called them burghers soon after 1300, which suggests town rights. In 1323 Count William III made the town a toll point for beer from Hamburg, and the beer trade became the stepping stone to Baltic commerce and to Amsterdam's rise as a trading town; in 1342 Count William IV gave it a new charter.

Houses stood on long wooden piles driven into the sand beneath the marsh, and timber and fire made the medieval town vulnerable. In 1345 a dying man's host was said to survive the flames, the Miracle of Amsterdam, which turned the chapel into a pilgrimage site. By the fifteenth century Amsterdam was the most important trading city in Holland, and ring-shaped canals dug for defence and drainage marked its growth.

In 1578 the Catholic city government was deposed in the Alteratie, and Amsterdam joined the revolt against Spain, mainly for the sake of trade. After Spain took Antwerp in 1585, many merchants of the Southern Netherlands arrived with their networks, along with Portuguese Jews and Huguenots. The East India Company of 1602 and the Exchange Bank of 1609 made the city the hub of a worldwide trade. The population grew from under 30,000 around 1570 to more than 100,000 in 1622, and the concentric canal belt with its merchants' houses and warehouses was dug to house them. By the end of the seventeenth century more than 200,000 people lived in the city, one of Europe's largest. Growth slowed after 1680, and the population sank to about 180,000 by 1815. Louis Bonaparte chose Amsterdam as the capital of his Kingdom of Holland and entered the city on 20 April 1808.
simp_chinese:
阿姆斯特丹的名字来自13世纪在阿姆斯特尔河上修建的水坝。最早的记载是1275年10月27日伯爵弗洛里斯五世给予“阿姆斯特尔河坝”居民的免税特权；1300年后不久，乌得勒支主教居伊称当地居民为市民，说明已有城市权。1323年，伯爵威廉三世把这里定为汉堡啤酒的征税口岸，啤酒贸易成为通向波罗的海贸易的跳板，也是阿姆斯特丹作为商业城市崛起的开端；1342年，伯爵威廉四世又给了城镇新的特许状。

房屋建在打进沼泽下方沙层的长木桩上，木材和火灾使中世纪的城镇十分脆弱。1345年，传说一名临终者吐出的圣体在火中完好无损，这便是“阿姆斯特丹的奇迹”，小礼拜堂由此成为朝圣地。15世纪，阿姆斯特丹已是荷兰最重要的商业城市，为防御和排水挖掘的环形运河标志着它的扩张。

1578年，天主教的市政府在“更替”中被推翻，阿姆斯特丹加入反抗西班牙的起义，主要是为了贸易。1585年西班牙攻陷安特卫普后，许多南尼德兰商人带着他们的商业网络来到这里，葡萄牙犹太人和胡格诺教徒也相继到来。1602年成立的东印度公司和1609年开办的汇兑银行，使这里成为遍及世界的贸易枢纽。人口从1570年前后的不足3万增长到1622年的10万以上，同心圆的运河带和商人宅邸、仓库便是为安置他们而修建的。17世纪末，城中居民超过20万，是欧洲最大的城市之一。1680年后增长放缓，到1815年人口降到约18万。路易·波拿巴选择阿姆斯特丹作为他的荷兰王国首都，于1808年4月20日入城。

english:
Amstetten occupies a corridor in western Lower Austria between Vienna and Linz, beside the Ybbs River and near the Danube. The Ybbs valley links Alpine foothills with the broad river plain, while the surrounding land supports grain, orchards and animal husbandry. Roads and river crossings have long gathered settlement along this east–west route.

Ulmerfeld, later part of Amstetten, was first mentioned in 995, and Amstetten itself appears in records in 1111. Medieval farms, mills and markets grew around churches and manor houses. The Mostviertel drew its name from Most, the fermented pear and apple drink produced in the fruit-growing countryside. By the pre-industrial period, local markets traded grain, fruit, timber and livestock.

Rivers and wooded slopes surround the old core, while roads follow the Ybbs corridor toward the Danube. Amstetten’s identity rests on this meeting of fruit-growing hills, river routes and a long administrative center. Orchards and mills supported its villages.
simp_chinese:
阿姆施泰滕占据下奥地利西部维也纳与林茨之间的走廊，位于伊布斯河畔、多瑙河附近。伊布斯谷地连接阿尔卑斯山麓与宽阔河原，周围土地支持谷物、果园和养畜。道路与渡口长期把聚落吸引到这条东西通道上。

阿姆施泰滕所辖的乌尔默费尔德995年首次见于文献，阿姆施泰滕本身则1111年出现。中世纪农庄、磨坊和市场围绕教堂与庄园发展。“莫斯特菲尔特尔”名称来自当地果园用梨和苹果制成的微发酵果汁。近代早期，市场交换谷物、水果、木材与牲畜。

河流和林坡环绕旧核心，道路沿伊布斯走廊通向多瑙河。阿姆施泰滕身份建立在水果丘陵、河路与长期行政中心的交汇。果园和磨坊供养周围村庄。

english: South of the Kunlun range, the Aksai Chin River flows into the enclosed basin of Amtogor Tso. The lake's salty water gathers at the foot of high mountains rather than continuing to the sea. Its catchment lies on an exceptionally dry part of the plateau, where the cold and scant precipitation limit vegetation around the shore.
simp_chinese: 昆仑山南侧，阿克赛钦河流入阿木古郎措所在的封闭盆地。咸水汇集于高山脚下，不再流向海洋。湖泊集水区位于格外干燥的高原地带，寒冷与稀少的降水限制了湖畔植被。

english: Amtogor Tso, also called Aksai Chin Lake, is a salt lake south of the Kunlun Mountains. It has no outlet to the sea and receives its principal surface inflow from the Aksai Chin River. The lake lies at nearly 4,850 metres above sea level, in a cold basin with very little precipitation.
simp_chinese: 阿木古郎措又称阿克赛钦湖，是昆仑山南麓的内陆盐湖。湖水没有出海口，主要地表入流是阿克赛钦河。湖面海拔近4850米，所在盆地寒冷干燥，降水稀少。

english:
Amud was a substantial stone-built town in the highlands of the northern Horn of Africa. Its remains include hundreds of houses and a large rectangular mosque with a mihrab facing Mecca. The town belonged to a landscape of Muslim settlements between the inland plateau and the port of Zeila. Pottery and glass found among the ruins reflect connections that extended beyond the surrounding countryside.

The later city of Borama lies here.
simp_chinese:
阿穆德曾是非洲之角北部高地上一座规模可观的石造城镇。遗迹包括数百座民居和一座大型长方形清真寺，寺中壁龛朝向麦加。这座城镇属于内陆高原与泽伊拉港之间的穆斯林聚落网络；遗址发现的陶器和玻璃，显示它的联系延伸到周围乡野之外。

后来的博拉马即位于此地。

english: Amulaca lies in the Kwango country near Popokabaka, on the right bank of the Kwango River. The river runs north toward the Kasai basin, while the neighboring Kwilu also flows north from Angola. The Kwilu valley was the homeland of Lukeni lua Nimi, remembered as the first king of Kongo around the turn of the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 阿穆拉卡位于宽果地区，靠近宽果河右岸的波波卡巴卡。宽果河向北流向开赛河流域，邻近的奎卢河也从安哥拉向北流淌。奎卢河谷是卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米的故乡；他被认为是十五世纪前后刚果王国的第一位国王。

english:
Amundava lies in the humid forest country of Rondônia, between the Ji-Paraná and Guaporé drainage systems. Streams, seasonally flooded ground and dense woodland shape settlement, travel and the distribution of game. The Amondawa belong to the wider Kagwahiva-speaking world of Tupi-Guarani peoples, whose villages were linked by kinship and forest paths. The canoe and trail network let families use different river valleys without abandoning their kin settlements.

Families combined hunting, fishing, gathering and small clearings for cassava and other crops. Arrows tipped with plant poison were used for large game, and forest knowledge governed when camps moved and where gardens could be made. Villages shifted as soils, animals and social obligations changed, leaving a landscape of old clearings and regrowth. Old clearings, fish traps and named landscape features gave families a detailed map of food and shelter across the forest.

The Amondawa shared this territory with other Indigenous peoples, including groups that long avoided sustained contact with Brazilian society. Rivers connected communities that European maps often treated as empty. State settlement, mining and logging later pushed into the forest, but before those frontiers the region remained a network of kin villages rather than a single town.
simp_chinese:
阿蒙达瓦位于朗多尼亚湿润森林，处在吉帕拉纳与瓜波雷水系之间。溪流、季节泛滥地和密林决定聚落、通行以及猎物的分布。阿蒙达瓦人属于更广大的卡瓜希瓦图皮—瓜拉尼语世界，村落通过亲属关系和森林道路相连。独木舟与小径网络让各家能够利用不同河谷，同时维持亲属聚落之间的联系。

各家兼营狩猎、捕鱼、采集，并开垦小块土地种植木薯等作物。猎取大型野兽时使用植物箭毒，森林知识决定营地何时迁转、园地设在何处。土壤、动物和社会义务变化时，村落随之移动，留下旧林地和再生林组成的地景。旧林间地、鱼梁和具名地物共同构成一张关于食物与庇护的森林地图。

阿蒙达瓦人与其他原住民共同使用这片土地，其中一些群体长期避免同巴西社会持续接触。河流连接的社区，在早期外来地图上常被误作无人区。后来的国有垦殖、采矿和伐木逐步侵入森林，但在此以前，这里是亲属村落组成的网络，而非单一城镇。

english: Amurang lies on the northern coast of Sulawesi beside the mouth of the Ranoyapo River. Its shore forms part of the Minahasa country, facing the Celebes Sea. In the seventeenth century the expanding kingdom of Bolaang Mongondow brought Amurang, known in its history as Umuda, and settlements along the Ranoyapo under its influence. Farther east, the Spanish presence at Manado and the subsequent arrival of the Dutch changed the balance among the powers of the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 亚巫兰位于苏拉威西北岸，毗邻拉诺亚波河口，米纳哈萨地区的海岸在此面向苏拉威西海。十七世纪，扩张中的博拉昂蒙贡多王国将亚巫兰及拉诺亚波河沿岸聚落纳入势力范围；当地在其历史中被称为乌穆达。更东面的万鸦老先后出现西班牙人和荷兰人，改变了半岛各势力之间的均衡。

english: Amurang Bay indents the northern coast of Sulawesi, facing the Celebes Sea. Its gently sloping shores and shallow coastal waters lie beneath the mountainous Minahasa Peninsula. Tides and waves move through the bay, while the larger sea opens westward towards Borneo and northward towards the islands of the southern Philippines.
simp_chinese: 阿穆朗湾凹入苏拉威西北岸，面向苏拉威西海。海湾岸坡平缓，近岸水浅，后方是多山的米纳哈萨半岛。潮汐与海浪在湾中流动，外海向西通往婆罗洲，向北延伸至菲律宾南部诸岛。

english:
Amur Bay forms the western arm of Peter the Great Gulf on the Sea of Japan. The Muravyov-Amursky Peninsula and Eugénie Archipelago separate it from Ussuri Bay, while the narrow Eastern Bosphorus gives ships a route between the two bodies of water. The bay stretches about sixty-five kilometres, reaches widths of ten to twenty kilometres and remains relatively shallow at roughly twenty metres. Several rivers reach its shores, including the Razdolnaya, Amba, Narva and Barabashevka.

Their freshwater and sediment meet cold maritime waters beneath a seasonal cycle of winter ice, spring melt and monsoon rains. The bay’s sheltered configuration creates important fishing grounds and anchorages, while the peninsula forms a prominent coastal landmark.
simp_chinese:
阿穆尔湾是日本海彼得大帝湾西侧的重要海湾。穆拉维约夫—阿穆尔斯基半岛和叶夫根尼群岛把它与乌苏里湾分隔，狭窄的东博斯普鲁斯海峡则为两片水域之间提供航路。海湾长约六十五公里，宽十至二十公里，水深约二十米，整体较为浅缓。

拉兹多尔纳亚河、阿姆巴河、纳尔瓦河和巴拉巴舍夫卡河等多条河流汇入这里。河水与泥沙同寒冷海水相遇，在冬季结冰、春季融雪和夏季降雨的季节变化中不断改变海岸环境。受半岛遮挡的水域形成重要渔场和锚地，醒目的半岛也构成沿海航行的地标。

english:
Amyint is an old town near the Chindwin River, where stupas, temples and brick mounds recall its former importance. A moat surrounded the settlement, and local records describe numerous shrines and water channels. Burmese tradition connects the town with rulers of Pagan and Ava, including Swa Saw Ke. Under the Konbaung dynasty Amyint supplied men for royal service. Its surviving Buddhist monuments and inscriptions preserve the religious life of a community on the western approaches to the Irrawaddy heartland.

The later city of Monywa also lies here.
simp_chinese:
阿敏是钦敦江附近的古城，佛塔、寺庙和砖丘令人想起它昔日的地位。城邑周围有壕沟，地方记录中还提及众多圣所和水道。缅甸传统将这里与蒲甘及阿瓦的统治者联系起来，其中包括苏瓦绍凯。贡榜王朝时期，阿敏为王室征调兵员。留存的佛教建筑与碑铭，保存了伊洛瓦底江腹地西侧这一社区的宗教生活。

后来的蒙育瓦也位于此地。

english: An-Nabhaniyah lies in western Qasim, east of the dark mountain of Aban and close to Wadi al-Rummah. The early geographer Lughdah al-Isfahani described it as a large village inhabited by the Banu Walibah. The hills nearby preserve traces of old buildings and fortifications, while inscriptions and drawings are found on Jabal al-Kuwayfir. The broad wadi passes between the Aban mountains as it crosses Qasim.
simp_chinese: 纳巴尼亚位于卡西姆西部、深色的阿班山以东，靠近鲁迈赫谷。早期地理学家卢格达·伊斯法哈尼将其描述为巴努瓦利巴人居住的大村庄。附近山丘留有古建筑与防御工事的痕迹，库韦菲尔山上还可见铭文和图画。宽阔的鲁迈赫谷穿过卡西姆，在阿班诸山之间流过。

english:
An-Nafūd is a vast red-sand desert in northern Arabia, occupying an oval depression roughly 290 kilometres long and 225 kilometres wide. Sudden winds build broad crescent dunes and move sand across the basin; rain normally comes only once or twice a year. Around its rim, especially near the Hejaz mountains, low oases raise dates, barley, vegetables and fruit. These islands of cultivation make the surrounding roads possible.

Southeastward, the Dahna forms a long corridor of gravel plains and sand that links the Nafud with the Rub al Khali. Travellers seeking the wells and markets of the northern oases could skirt the deepest dunes while keeping to firm ground. Jubbah and Tayma made the desert edge part of a wider Arabian route system, joining the Red Sea approaches with the interior and the Persian Gulf.

The desert was not empty between journeys. Rock art and archaeological remains record seasonal human movement and long-distance exchange in the arid interior. Camel caravans reduced the risks of crossing by carrying water, fodder and trade goods together. The Nafud therefore remained both a barrier and a corridor: an expanse of shifting sand that separated settled districts, yet directed those who knew its wells toward the oases on its margins.
simp_chinese:
内夫得是阿拉伯北部一片广阔的红色沙海，位于长约二百九十公里、宽约二百二十五公里的椭圆形盆地。骤起的强风堆起宽阔新月形沙丘，使沙粒不断越过盆地；多数年份只有一两次降雨。靠近汉志山脉的低地绿洲可以种植椰枣、大麦、蔬菜和水果，成为周围道路得以通行的依靠。

向东南，代赫纳以砾石平原和长条沙丘连接内夫得与鲁卜哈利沙漠。前往北部绿洲和集市的旅人可以绕开最深的沙丘，沿坚实地面前行。朱拜和泰马使沙漠边缘成为阿拉伯路线体系的一部分，把红海沿岸、半岛内陆与波斯湾方向连在一起。

沙海并非只在旅途中才有人使用。岩画和考古遗存记录了干旱内陆的季节性迁徙与远距离交换。骆驼商队同时携带饮水、饲料和货物，以降低穿越风险。内夫得因此既是屏障，也是通道：不断移动的沙丘隔开定居区域，却凭井泉与绿洲把熟悉地形的行人引向固定方向。

english: North of the Nafud sand sea, the desert of Al-Jawf contains rocky ground and shallow depressions as well as stretches of sand. The Nafud itself is known for its red dunes and strong winds. Around its margins, ancient artists carved remarkably large, naturalistic images of camels into rock. Related engravings have been found at several sites across northern Arabia, evidence of a shared artistic tradition long before the present desert routes.
simp_chinese: 内夫得沙海以北，焦夫的荒漠既有沙地，也有岩石地面和浅洼。内夫得本身以红色沙丘与强风闻名。沙漠边缘的古人在岩石上刻出体形巨大的写实骆驼图像；阿拉伯北部多处地点发现了相关岩刻，表明远在后来荒漠道路形成之前，这里便存在共同的艺术传统。

english: West of the Great Nafud, the desert around Wadi al-Qalibah is a country of exposed sandstone and dry channels. The rocks of the Tabuk formation stretch from the sand sea toward the Jordanian frontier. In places, erosion has cut their level beds into mesas and isolated hills, while wadis divide the broad stony surface. Wadi al-Qalibah can carry powerful floods when heavy rain falls over the Tabuk country.
simp_chinese: 大内夫得沙漠以西，卡利拜河谷周围裸露着砂岩，干涸的水道切过荒地。塔布克地层从沙海边缘延伸至约旦方向；有些地方，侵蚀将平坦岩层切割为方山和孤丘，干谷则划分广阔的石质地面。塔布克地区降下大雨时，卡利拜河谷会汇集猛烈的洪水。

english:
The Nafud covers an oval depression in northern Arabia with an area near 65,000 square kilometres. Brick-red sand is heaped into large crescent dunes, separated by rocky tracts and shallow hollows. Sudden winds can erase tracks and alter the surface within hours. Only one or two rains normally arrive in a year, so vegetation remains sparse away from wells and runoff channels.

At the western margin, springs and wells support oases that grow dates, barley, vegetables and fruit. These cultivated islands supplied pastoral groups and travellers moving between the Hejaz and central Arabia. To the southeast, the Dahna forms a long corridor of gravel and sand linking the Nafud with the Rub al Khali. Together, the two deserts and the Dahna created a chain of routes rather than a single barrier.

The dunes also contain a deep record of human presence. A fossil human finger found in the Nafud was dated to about 85,000 years ago, and camel engravings indicate later seasonal journeys through northern Arabia. These traces belong to periods of changing rainfall and movement, when what is dry in the present age was crossed by people following water and game. The inner Nafud thus preserves both an imposing landscape and a long history of adaptation. The dunes preserve that record beneath shifting crests and gravel margins.
simp_chinese:
内夫得沙漠覆盖阿拉伯北部一处椭圆形洼地，面积接近六万五千平方公里。砖红色沙粒堆成大型新月丘，其间夹杂岩地和浅洼。骤起的风数小时内便能抹去足迹并改变地表。每年通常只有一两次降雨，水井和径流通道以外的地方植被十分稀疏。

西缘的泉眼与水井滋养绿洲，出产枣椰、大麦、蔬菜和水果。这些耕作孤岛为往返汉志与阿拉伯中部的牧民和旅人提供补给。东南方，达赫纳形成一条由砾石和沙丘组成的长廊，把内夫得同鲁卜哈利连接起来。两片沙漠与达赫纳因而不是单一天然障碍，而是一串彼此衔接的路线。

沙丘还保存着深厚的人类活动记录。在内夫得发现的古人类手指化石约可追溯至八万五千年前，骆驼岩刻则显示后来仍有人季节性穿越阿拉伯北部。这些遗迹属于降雨和迁徙不断变化的年代；当时尚可利用的地方，后来多为旱地。内陆内夫得因此兼有壮阔地貌与漫长的适应史。流动沙脊和砾石边缘保存着这段历史。

english: An-Nakhil is a village in the valley country north of al-Hinakiyah, east of Medina. It stood on a route between Fayd and Medina, where travellers could find fresh water and palm gardens. The early writer Waki' described a palace, houses, a market and a water channel fed by springs. The cultivated enclosures and palms made the settlement a welcome halt on the road across the dry interior.
simp_chinese: 纳希尔是麦地那以东、希纳基耶北方谷地中的村落。它位于费德与麦地那之间的道路上，旅人可以找到淡水和椰枣园。早期作者瓦基记述了这里的宫舍、民居、市场及泉水供给的水渠。围起的耕地和棕榈，使聚落成为穿越干旱内陆时受欢迎的停驻点。

english: An-Nasifah lies in Wadi Sirhan, near al-Uzaymat in northern Arabia. The valley is a long depression linking the al-Jawf oases with the country towards Syria, and its scattered watering places have served people travelling through an otherwise arid landscape. Basalt-covered ground borders parts of the valley, while its lowlands provide routes and seasonal grazing for pastoral communities.
simp_chinese: 纳西法位于阿拉伯北部的锡尔汉谷，靠近乌宰马特。锡尔汉谷是一条长洼地，连接焦夫绿洲与通向叙利亚的地区；零散水源供穿行干旱地带的人使用。谷地部分边缘为玄武岩覆盖，低地则为牧民提供道路和季节性牧场。

english: An-Nibaj is the old name of the oasis district of al-Asyah in Qasim, associated with Ayn Ibn Fuhayd. It was also called Nibaj Ibn Amir after Abdullah ibn Amir, a governor of Basra entrusted with the route taken by pilgrims to Mecca and Medina. The Basra road reached this oasis before dividing: one branch ran southwest toward Mecca and past settlements near Unayzah, while another led toward Medina.
simp_chinese: 尼巴吉是卡西姆阿斯亚赫绿洲地区的古名，与艾因·伊本·富海德有关。它也称伊本·阿米尔的尼巴吉，得名于巴士拉总督阿卜杜拉·伊本·阿米尔；通往麦加和麦地那的朝觐道路曾由他负责。巴士拉道路抵达此绿洲后分岔：一支向西南通往麦加，经过欧奈宰附近的聚落；另一支则通向麦地那。

english:
An-Nil lies on the flat alluvial plain between the Tigris and the Euphrates, a little east of Baghdad, in the heart of lower Mesopotamia. The land is a level expanse of silt that depends on irrigation: date palms, barley and wheat grow along the canals, while summers are extremely hot and dry and winters are mild. The name An-Nil, the Arabic name of the Nile, was given in medieval Iraq to a canal linking the Euphrates with the Tigris and to the town on its banks.

Southern Mesopotamia also contained some of the world's earliest literate urban societies, whose growth depended on riverine agriculture. Baghdad, founded by the caliph al-Mansur in 762, drew its food from the canal-watered plain around it, and the network of canals between the two rivers fed its markets for centuries. After the Mongol conquest of Baghdad in 1258 many canals silted up, and the country fell back on narrower strips of cultivation and on nomadic herders. Ottoman rule began in 1534, and the region was later governed from Baghdad by Mamluk governors. The settlements of the plain have always depended on the balance between flood, silt and the labour of keeping the canals open.
simp_chinese:
尼勒位于底格里斯河与幼发拉底河之间的平坦冲积平原上，在巴格达以东不远处，处于美索不达米亚下游的腹地。这里是一望无际的淤积平地，依赖灌溉：枣椰、大麦和小麦沿水渠生长，夏季极为炎热干燥，冬季温和。“尼勒”是尼罗河的阿拉伯语名称，在中世纪伊拉克被用来称呼一条连通幼发拉底河与底格里斯河的运河，以及河岸上的城镇。

南美索不达米亚还孕育了世界上最早的一批文字社会与城市，它们的发展离不开河流农业。762年哈里发曼苏尔建立的巴格达，靠周围运河灌溉的平原供养，两河之间的运河网络数百年来为它的市场提供粮食。1258年蒙古人攻陷巴格达后，许多运河淤塞，这片土地退回到更窄的耕作地带和游牧牧民的世界。奥斯曼统治始于1534年，此后这一地区由驻巴格达的马穆鲁克总督治理。平原上的聚落始终取决于洪水、淤泥和疏浚运河的劳作之间的平衡。

english: An-Nuhaytiyyah lies in the dry country south of al-Sulaymi, near the upper reaches of Wadi al-Rummah. Granite hills rise above the plateau around Qana and Awarid, while the wadi crosses the country farther south. Seasonal rain brings pasture to the ground between the hills, where camel herds graze.
simp_chinese: 努海提亚位于苏莱米以南的干旱地区，靠近鲁迈赫河上游。加纳和阿瓦里德一带的花岗岩丘陵高出高原，鲁迈赫河谷从更南面经过。季节性降雨在丘陵间催生牧草，骆驼群在此放牧。

english: An-Nuqrah is a historic stopping place in the high country between Qasim and Medina. Known as Maadin an-Nuqrah, it lay on the Iraqi pilgrimage route, where travellers found wells and pools of fresh water. The route from Basra to Medina joined the Kufa road here; those bound for Mecca could instead turn south toward Dariyah. Its older name also recalls the mineral workings of the district.
simp_chinese: 努格拉是卡西姆与麦地那之间高地上的古老驿站，也称麦丁·努格拉。这里位于伊拉克朝觐路线上，旅人可以在井和蓄水池中找到淡水。从巴士拉通往麦地那的道路在此与库法道路会合；前往麦加的人则可向南转往达里耶。其旧名也让人想起这一地区的矿业活动。

english: Lý Sơn, home to An Vĩnh, is a volcanic island off the central Vietnamese coast. Crater rims and dark volcanic rock rise above the surrounding sea, while fishing has long linked its inhabitants to waters beyond the island. The Nguyễn lords recruited men from An Vĩnh for the Hoàng Sa flotilla. Lê Quý Đôn recorded that its crews sailed seasonally to distant islands to collect goods and marine products.
simp_chinese: 安永所在的李山岛是越南中部海岸外的一座火山岛。火山口边缘和深色岩石高出周围海面，捕鱼长期将岛民与岛外广阔的海域联系起来。阮主从安永招募黄沙队队员；黎贵惇记载，这些船员按季节乘船航向远方岛屿，收集漂落的货物以及海产。

english: The Gulf of Ana María lies along the central southern coast of Cuba, behind the island chain of the Jardines de la Reina. Mangrove cays and reefs separate the gulf’s shallow waters from the open Caribbean, forming a long, broken barrier off the Cuban shore. The archipelago extends eastwards towards the Gulf of Guacanayabo, while channels between its cays admit water from the sea.
simp_chinese: 安娜玛丽亚湾位于古巴中部南岸，处在哈丁内斯德拉雷纳群岛之后。红树林礁岛与珊瑚礁将海湾浅水与开阔的加勒比海分开，在古巴海岸外形成一道绵长而断续的屏障。群岛向东延伸至瓜卡纳亚沃湾附近，礁岛之间的水道则让海水流入湾内。

english: Anaa lies in the wooded uplands of the Uda basin east of Lake Baikal. The Uda flows west to join the Selenga, gathering water from a broad basin before it reaches the larger river. Its waters shelter fish including Siberian taimen, lenok and grayling. Forest and river valleys give this country a character distinct from the more open steppe farther south.
simp_chinese: 阿纳位于贝加尔湖以东、乌达河流域森林覆盖的高地。乌达河汇集广大流域的水流，向西注入色楞格河。河中生活着西伯利亚哲罗鲑、细鳞鲑和茴鱼等鱼类。森林与河谷赋予此地独特面貌，有别于更南方开阔的草原。

english: The Anabar flows north from the Central Siberian Plateau to the Laptev Sea. Its basin crosses northern taiga, forest tundra and tundra before the river reaches the Arctic coast. Ice grips the river through the long winter, and much of its annual flow arrives with the spring and summer thaw. Its lower waters broaden toward Anabar Bay.
simp_chinese: 阿纳巴尔河从中西伯利亚高原向北流入拉普捷夫海。流域横跨北方泰加林、森林苔原和苔原，河流最终抵达北极海岸。漫长冬季冰封河道，全年大部分径流集中于春夏融化时期。下游河面逐渐展宽，通向阿纳巴尔湾。

english: The Anacé are an Indigenous people of the northern Ceará coast and the Serra da Japuara. Their territory includes coastal lowlands and hills west of the Ceará River. Communities maintained ties to this land through the upheavals of Portuguese expansion, which brought settlers, missions and conflict to the region from the seventeenth century onward. Anacé memory preserves relationships with ancestral places and the beings associated with them.
simp_chinese: 阿纳塞人是塞阿腊北部海岸与雅普阿拉山地的原住民族。他们的领地包括塞阿腊河以西的沿海低地和山丘。自十七世纪起，葡萄牙扩张将殖民者、传教站和冲突带到这里；在这一动荡过程中，社区仍维系着与土地的联系。阿纳塞人的记忆保留了他们与祖先之地及与这些地方相关的灵体之间的关系。

english: Anaco lies near the river of the same name in the plains of northeastern Venezuela. In 1735 the Franciscan friar Joseph Jurado founded the Indigenous town of Santa Ana in the vicinity, gathering Carib inhabitants into a mission settlement. In 1750 the community was moved to Orocopiche. The river and surrounding plains lie between the coastal region of Barcelona and the great Orinoco drainage farther south.
simp_chinese: 阿纳科位于委内瑞拉东北平原，靠近同名河流。1735年，方济各会士何塞·胡拉多在附近建立圣安娜原住民聚落，将加勒比人聚集到传教区。1750年，社区迁至奥罗科皮切。河流与周围平原介于巴塞罗那海岸地区和更南面的奥里诺科大流域之间。

english: Anacopia crowns a steep hill above the Black Sea coast of Abkhazia. Its stone walls and towers guarded one of the region's strongest fortresses, with a church and cistern inside the citadel. In the eighth century Leon of Abkhazia held the fortress against the army of Marwan, whose siege failed. Anacopia became an early capital of the Abkhazian kingdom before its rulers moved their seat to Kutaisi.
simp_chinese: 阿纳科皮亚高踞阿布哈兹黑海岸上方的陡山，其石墙与塔楼守护着地区最坚固的要塞之一，卫城内还有教堂和蓄水池。八世纪，阿布哈兹的列昂据守堡垒，抵御马尔万的军队，后者围攻未果。阿纳科皮亚成为阿布哈兹王国早期都城，后来统治者将治所迁往库塔伊西。

english:
Anacostia takes its name from Nacotchtank settlements on the river of the same name, in what is now southeastern Washington, D.C. Archaeology shows Indigenous settlement near the river going back at least four thousand years. The Nacotchtank were an Algonquian-speaking people tied to the Piscataway, and they drew fish from the rivers and grew corn, beans and squash on the flat land inland. Before European colonization, the Nacostine villages were a lively trade center visited by peoples from distant regions, including the Iroquois of New York.

Captain John Smith sailed up the river in 1608, mistaking it for the main stem of the Potomac, and met the Anacostans. In the early 1620s a party of colonists seeking corn from the Nacotchtank came to blows with them, and the young Henry Fleet, the only survivor, lived among them for years. After Maryland was founded in 1634, Leonard Calvert named Anacostan as one of the three best places in the colony for trading with Native peoples. Tobacco planting, disease and war soon pressed on the Nacotchtank: around 1668 war pushed neighbouring Native communities northward, and Anacostine Island appeared on a map drawn two years later. By 1697 the survivors had taken refuge among the Piscataway.
simp_chinese:
阿纳科斯蒂亚得名于同名河岸的纳科奇坦克聚落，这一带今属华盛顿特区东南部。考古遗存表明，原住民至少在四千年前便已在河边定居。纳科奇坦克人讲阿尔冈昆语，与皮斯卡塔韦人关系密切，他们从河中捕鱼，并在内陆平坦土地上种植玉米、豆类和南瓜。欧洲殖民者到来前，纳科斯廷村落是活跃的贸易中心，远方的易洛魁等族群也会来此交换物品。

1608年，约翰·史密斯船长溯河而上，误以为这里就是波托马克河主河道，并遇见了阿纳科斯廷人。1620年代初，一队向纳科奇坦克人换取玉米的殖民者与他们发生冲突，唯一的幸存者年轻的亨利·弗利特在他们中间生活了多年。马里兰于1634年建立后，莱纳德·卡尔弗特把阿纳科斯坦列为殖民地同原住民贸易的三个最佳地点之一。烟草种植、疾病和战争很快压迫着纳科奇坦克人：约1668年，战争迫使附近的原住民社群向北迁移，两年后绘制的地图上出现了阿纳科斯廷岛。到1697年，幸存者已投靠皮斯卡塔韦人。

english: The Anadyr winds east through the broad Markovo lowland, spreading into channels among lakes and islands before continuing toward the Bering Sea. It is fed by rivers descending from the Anadyr and Anyuy highlands and freezes for much of the year. In the seventeenth century, Semyon Dezhnev and his companions established Anadyrsk near this stretch of the river. The fortified post became a Russian base in the far northeast before being abandoned in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 阿纳德尔河在马尔科沃低地蜿蜒东流，分汊穿过湖泊与岛屿，随后继续流向白令海。河流汇集阿纳德尔高地和安纽伊高地流下的支流，一年中大部分时间都处于冰封之下。十七世纪，谢苗·杰日尼奥夫及其同伴在这一河段附近建立阿纳德尔斯克。这座堡寨成为俄国人在东北边陲的据点，十八世纪时被废弃。

english: Across the Anadyr lowlands, routes follow rivers and tundra toward the broad estuary on the Bering Sea. The Anadyr divides into many channels among lakes and marshes, while snow and ice transform the landscape in winter. Chuvan, Chukchi and other northern communities moved through the wider river country with reindeer, using their knowledge of the seasons to travel between the interior and the coast.
simp_chinese: 穿越阿纳德尔低地的道路沿河流和苔原延伸，通往白令海上宽阔的河口湾。阿纳德尔河在湖泊与沼泽之间分成多条水道，冬季的冰雪又改变了这片景观。楚万、楚科奇等北方社群带着驯鹿在更广阔的河流地区迁徙，凭借季节知识往返内陆与海岸。

english: The Anagance is a small river that meets the Petitcodiac at its western bend, in a wooded country between the Bay of Fundy and the Saint John valley. Its name recalls a portage: travellers could cross from the Anagance to the Kennebecasis and continue into the lower Saint John system. The Mi'kmaq also had a winter camp at the meeting of the Anagance and North rivers, where the Petitcodiac begins.
simp_chinese: 阿纳甘斯是一条小河，在珀蒂科迪亚克河最西边的弯曲处与之相接，所在林地介于芬迪湾和圣约翰河谷之间。河名让人想起一条陆路转运道：旅行者可从阿纳甘斯渡至肯尼贝卡西斯河，再进入圣约翰河下游水系。米克马克人还在阿纳甘斯河与北河交汇、珀蒂科迪亚克河起源之处设有冬季营地。

english:
Anagni stands in the hills above the Latin Valley southeast of Rome. Once a religious centre of the Hernici, it later became a bishop's seat and a favoured residence of the popes. Its cathedral and papal palace recall an age when the town was closely tied to the government of the Church.

Anagni was the birthplace of Boniface VIII, who was seized here in 1303 by enemies acting for the French king and the Colonna family. The townspeople freed the pope, but he died soon afterward. The removal of the papal court to Avignon contributed to Anagni's decline, and troops of Werner von Urslingen sacked it in 1348. In 1556 Spanish forces under the Duke of Alba again besieged and plundered the town during war with Pope Paul IV.
simp_chinese:
阿纳尼坐落在罗马东南、拉丁河谷上方的丘陵中。这里曾是赫尔尼基人的宗教中心，后来成为主教驻地和教皇喜爱的居所。主教座堂与教皇宫见证了这座城镇与教会政务紧密相连的时代。

教皇卜尼法斯八世出生于阿纳尼。1303年，法国国王与科隆纳家族的敌人在此将他扣押；居民随后救出了教皇，但他不久便去世。教皇宫廷迁往阿维尼翁加剧了阿纳尼的衰落，1348年，乌尔斯林根的维尔纳率军洗劫此城。1556年，在与教皇保禄四世的战争中，阿尔瓦公爵率西班牙军队再次围攻并劫掠了城镇。

english:
Anah lies on the middle Euphrates, where islands break the river's course through the desert. The ancient and medieval town occupied an island known as Qal'at Ana, a defensible position that had served as a frontier stronghold under successive empires. In Islamic times Anah became a caravan town and a centre of Bedouin power, commanding a route between Iraq and the lands to the west.

From around 1535 the town was the effective seat of the Abu Rish emirs, whom the Ottomans employed as governors and desert rulers. The traveller Leonhart Rauwolff found Anah divided in 1574: one part was surrounded by water and reached by boat, while a larger Arab settlement stretched along the bank. By the seventeenth century the island town had given way to a village and palm gardens, and the main settlement stood on the right bank. Travellers still counted Anah a leading Arab town on the Euphrates, with influence extending towards Palmyra.
simp_chinese:
阿纳位于幼发拉底河中游，河水穿过荒漠时在此分出岛屿。古代和中世纪的城镇坐落在卡拉特阿纳岛上；这处易守之地曾是历代帝国的边境要塞。伊斯兰时期，阿纳成为商队城镇和贝都因人的权力中心，扼守伊拉克通往西方的道路。

约从1535年起，阿纳实际上是阿布里什埃米尔的驻地；奥斯曼人任命他们担任地方总督和沙漠地区的统治者。1574年，旅行者劳沃尔夫见到城镇分为两部分：一处被河水包围，只能乘船抵达；较大的阿拉伯聚落则沿河岸伸展。到十七世纪，岛上古城已变成村庄与棕榈园，主要聚落迁到右岸。旅行者仍称阿纳是幼发拉底河上的重要阿拉伯城镇，其影响延伸至巴尔米拉方向。

english: The country around Montes Claros lies in the northern Minas Gerais backlands, between wooded hills and the valleys draining toward the São Francisco. Antônio Gonçalves Figueira received a land grant here in 1707 and established the Fazenda de Montes Claros. The settlement that grew around the estate became known as Montes Claros de Formigas and was raised to the status of a town in 1831.
simp_chinese: 蒙特斯克拉鲁斯一带位于米纳斯吉拉斯北部腹地，介于林木覆盖的丘陵与流向圣弗朗西斯科河的诸河谷之间。安东尼奥·贡萨尔维斯·菲盖拉于1707年在此获得土地，建立蒙特斯克拉鲁斯庄园。围绕庄园发展起来的聚落称为蒙特斯克拉鲁斯·迪福尔米加斯，1831年升格为镇。

english:
Anajás occupies the western part of Marajó Island, where the Anajás River and many tidal channels cut through flooded forest. The town itself is a small administrative centre within a huge municipality, but the surrounding landscape supplied fish, turtles, timber, fruit, and fertile ground for seasonal cultivation. Movement followed water rather than roads.

Marajó supported the Marajoara culture from roughly 400 to 1200. Its communities built earthen mounds above seasonal floods, produced elaborate painted ceramics, and combined agriculture with fishing and gathering. Later Aruã communities inherited the same riverine environment. Archaeological estimates suggest a large regional population before European contact.

The Portuguese reached the Amazon delta in the sixteenth century, bringing epidemics and mission settlement. Jesuit activity drew the Anajás people into colonial villages, while the place later called Mocoões remained part of the administration of Chaves and then Breves. Its history in this period belongs to indigenous and mission-era river communities rather than an established town.
simp_chinese:
阿纳雅斯位于马拉若岛西部，阿纳雅斯河与众多潮汐水道穿行于洪水森林之间。城镇本身只是巨大市镇中的小型行政中心，周围环境则提供鱼类、龟、木材、果实和适合季节耕作的土地。居民往来依靠水路，而不是道路。

马拉若岛大约在公元400年至1200年间孕育了马拉若阿拉文化。当地社群在季节性洪水以上修建土丘，制作彩绘陶器，并把农业、捕鱼和采集结合起来。后来的阿鲁阿社群延续了同样的河口生活。考古估计显示，欧洲人到来以前这里已有大量人口。

十六世纪，葡萄牙人进入亚马孙河口，也带来疫病和传教聚落。耶稣会活动把阿纳雅斯人纳入殖民村落；后来称为莫科埃斯的地方先后隶属沙维什和布雷维斯。这一时期的历史属于原住民和传教时代的河口社群，而非成形的城镇。

english: Anak lies on the western side of the fertile Chaeryŏng plain. Its ancient past is visible in the painted Koguryŏ tombs of the district: an inscription in Tomb No. 3 records the career of Tongsu, who died in 357, though the identity of the tomb's occupant remains disputed. Much later, in 1413, the Joseon government confirmed Anak as a county and appointed a magistrate.
simp_chinese: 安岳位于肥沃的载宁平原西侧。当地高句丽壁画古墓展现了久远的历史：三号墓的一篇墨书记载了357年去世的冬寿的仕历，但墓主人身份仍有争议。很久以后，朝鲜政府于1413年将安岳确定为郡，并派驻郡守。

english:
Anaklia stands where the Inguri River reaches the Black Sea, on the coast of Mingrelia. A small fortified port at the edge of the coastal plain, it attracted the attention of the rulers of Mingrelia and neighboring Abkhazia as well as the Ottomans, who sought a foothold on this shore.

The Ottomans captured Anaklia in 1723 and made it a maritime outpost and a center of the Black Sea slave trade in captives. In 1802 Kelesh Bey Sharvashidze of Abkhazia exploited a dispute within Mingrelia to force Prince Grigol Dadiani to surrender the place; Grigol's son Levan was taken as a hostage. The contest over Anaklia showed how a small harbor could become entangled in the rivalries of the Black Sea coast.
simp_chinese:
阿纳克利亚位于明格列利亚海岸，英古里河在此注入黑海。这座沿海平原边缘的小型设防港口，引起了明格列利亚、邻近的阿布哈兹以及寻求在此岸立足的奥斯曼人的关注。

1723年，奥斯曼人占领阿纳克利亚，将它变为海上据点和奴隶贸易中心。1802年，阿布哈兹的凯列什贝伊·沙尔瓦希泽利用明格列利亚内部争端，迫使格里戈尔·达迪亚尼亲王交出此地，并将格里戈尔之子莱万扣为人质。围绕阿纳克利亚的争夺，反映了一座小港如何卷入黑海沿岸诸势力的竞争。

english: Anakovik lies on the southern side of the Seward Peninsula, near the mouth of the Sinuk River. Across the water stands Sledge Island, named by James Cook in 1778 after a sledge found on shore. Iñupiat traded at the Sinuk mouth and Cape Rodney when Joseph Billings visited the coast; some approached his ship in large skin boats to exchange goods.
simp_chinese: 阿纳科维克位于苏厄德半岛南侧，靠近西努克河口。隔水相望的是斯莱奇岛，詹姆斯·库克1778年因在岛岸发现一架雪橇而为它命名。约瑟夫·比林斯到访这片海岸时，伊努皮亚特人在西努克河口和罗德尼角交易；有些人乘大型皮船接近他的船只，交换货物。

english: The Anambas Islands lie in the South China Sea between the Malay Peninsula and Borneo. Their scattered, forested islands are separated by channels and sheltered bays, with coral reefs fringing parts of the coast. They belong to the island groups historically known as the Seven Islands, associated with the Malay rulers of Riau and Lingga. For sailors crossing these waters, the archipelago offered landfalls amid the open sea between the larger coasts.
simp_chinese: 阿南巴斯群岛位于马来半岛与婆罗洲之间的南海。林木覆盖的岛屿散布海中，水道和避风海湾将它们分开，部分海岸有珊瑚礁环绕。群岛属于历史上称为“七岛”的诸岛之一，与廖内和林加的马来统治者有关。对于穿越这些水域的船员，群岛是在两大海岸之间广阔海面上的落脚处。

english: The Anambé are an Indigenous people of the forested country west of the lower Tocantins. Their earlier territory included the headwaters of the Pacajá, a river that flows toward the Pará estuary south of Marajó Island. The waterways and forests between the Pacajá and Tocantins formed the setting of their movements and encounters with neighbouring peoples, long before the region acquired its later colonial settlements.
simp_chinese: 阿南贝人是托坎廷斯河下游以西森林地带的原住民族。他们早期的领地包括帕卡雅河源头，这条河流向马拉若岛南面的帕拉河口。帕卡雅河与托坎廷斯河之间的水道和森林，是他们迁徙并与邻近民族相遇的地方；这种历史早于这一地区后来出现的殖民聚落。

english:
Anamur occupies a narrow coastal plain beneath the Taurus, near a cape projecting into the Mediterranean. The ancient city of Anemurium stood beside the sea, its walls, baths and necropolis recalling an earlier port on the route along the Cilician coast. To the east, the towers and walls of Mamure Castle guard the shore, enclosing courtyards and a mosque within their massive circuit.

The castle incorporates work from several periods. According to the inscription preserved in local accounts, the Karamanid ruler Mahmud Bey captured and restored it in the early fourteenth century, giving it the name Mamure. Later rulers maintained and altered the fortress, whose position commanded the coastal road and the anchorage. Its walls show how the rulers of this mountainous shore invested in the defence of a place exposed to attacks from the sea.
simp_chinese:
阿纳穆尔坐落在托罗斯山下狭窄的海岸平原，靠近伸入地中海的岬角。古城阿内穆里翁滨海而立，城墙、浴场和墓地令人想起奇里乞亚海岸航路上的旧港。东面的马穆雷城堡以塔楼和城墙守护海岸，厚重的围墙内有庭院和清真寺。

城堡融合了不同时期的建筑。当地记载所引铭文称，十四世纪初卡拉曼王朝的马哈茂德贝伊攻占并修复城堡，赋名马穆雷。后世统治者继续维护和改造这座扼守海岸道路与锚地的堡垒。城墙显示这片山地海岸的统治者如何投资防卫，以应对来自海上的袭击。

english:
Añana is a valley and municipality in Álava, in the Basque Country of northern Spain. Its chief settlement, Salinas de Añana, grew around brine springs linked to Triassic salt deposits. Water rises naturally and is collected in shallow evaporation pans, a technique suited to an inland valley without a coast or extensive fuel supply.

Archaeological traces point to thousands of years of salt making, making the site one of the oldest continuously used saltworks. The visible terraces were largely developed around the first century BCE, and thousands of pans were built in the Roman and medieval periods. Salt exports became a major business after the community received special rights in 1114. The Spanish Crown claimed the works in 1564 and managed production through appointed officials.

Spring water, terraced pans and export rights explain how the valley's society organized itself around one durable product. Salt collectors, pan keepers, carters and merchants formed a specialized local economy. Roads carried salt toward inland markets, while the village clustered around cisterns, channels and drying platforms that made the mineral spring productive.
simp_chinese:
阿尼亚纳是西班牙北部巴斯克地区阿拉瓦省的一个谷地和市镇，主要聚落为萨利纳斯·德·阿尼亚纳。当地含盐泉水与三叠纪盐层有关，泉水自然涌出后进入浅盘蒸发，适合没有海岸和大宗燃料的内陆河谷。

考古遗存表明，当地制盐已延续数千年，是世界上使用时间最长的盐场之一。现存盐盘大多发展于公元前一世纪前后，罗马与中世纪时期又修建了数千个蒸发池。获得1114年的特别权利后，食盐外销成为重要产业；西班牙王室在1564年接管盐场，并通过官员管理生产。

泉水、梯级盐盘和外销权利解释了当地社会如何围绕一种持久产品组织。取盐者、盐盘管理者、车夫和商人形成专门经济，道路把盐运往内陆市场，村庄则围绕蓄水池、渠道和晾晒平台发展。盐场依靠渠道和盐盘的持续维护，生产季节也决定劳力和运输安排。

english: Ananatuba gives its name to an early pottery tradition on Marajó, the great island at the mouth of the Amazon. Remains associated with this tradition show that pottery-making communities inhabited the island long before the better-known Marajoara tradition. The island’s rivers, wetlands and seasonally flooded ground formed the setting for a long succession of Indigenous settlements and ceramic styles.
simp_chinese: 阿纳纳图巴为马拉若岛上的一种早期陶器传统提供了名称。这座大岛位于亚马孙河口；与这一传统有关的遗存表明，早在更为人熟知的马拉若阿拉传统出现之前，制作陶器的社区就已居住在岛上。河流、湿地和季节性淹水的土地，构成了岛上原住民聚落与陶器风格长期变迁的背景。

english: Ananiv lies on the Tyligul River in the steppe between the Dniester and the Southern Bug. It first appears in documents in 1767 as the sloboda of Anani, whose name is associated with an early settler, the Zaporozhian Cossack Ananii. Some accounts place the settlement's beginnings earlier in the century. The river valley formed part of a frontier where Cossack, Nogai and Ottoman spheres met before the Russian Empire expanded across the region.
simp_chinese: 阿纳尼夫位于德涅斯特河与南布格河之间草原上的特利胡尔河畔。1767年，文献首次将它记作阿纳尼斯洛博达，地名与早期定居者、扎波罗热哥萨克阿纳尼有关。另有记述认为聚落在更早的时候便已存在。河谷曾处于哥萨克、诺盖人和奥斯曼势力相接的边疆，俄国后来扩张至此。

english: Anantapur takes its name from Anantasagaram, a great tank whose name means “endless ocean.” Tradition attributes the villages of Anantasagaram and Bukkarayasamudram to Chikkavodeya, a minister of Bukka I of Vijayanagara. In the sixteenth century the town and surrounding country were granted to Hanumappa Nayudu of the Hande family, in recognition of his help to Rama Raya. The town came to be known as Hande Anantapur after its chiefs.
simp_chinese: 阿嫩达布尔得名于一座大水库阿南塔萨伽拉，意为“无尽之海”。相传阿南塔萨伽拉与布卡拉亚萨穆德拉姆两个村庄由毗奢耶那伽罗君主布卡一世的大臣奇卡沃德亚创建。十六世纪，拉马·拉亚将城镇及周围地区赐给汉德家族的哈努马帕·奈杜，以酬谢他的帮助。城镇后来因这支首领家族而被称为汉德阿嫩达布尔。

english:
Anar lies between Yazd and Rafsanjan on the dry roads of central Iran. Its old citadel occupies a mound in the town, enclosed by walls and towers; its origins are considered pre-Islamic, though it was altered in later centuries. Medieval geographers knew the settlement as Aban, in a district associated with Rudan. Its desert setting brought hot summers and cold winters.

The name Anar became common by the Safavid period, when the citadel was rebuilt and used again. Caravanserais in the district, including those at Astaneh and Bayaz, also date to that era and were repaired in later generations. Their courtyards offered shelter to travellers and animals on the roads linking the settlements of Yazd and Kerman. The fort and caravanserais show the different needs of a town that served both local inhabitants and people passing through the desert.
simp_chinese:
阿纳尔位于亚兹德与拉夫桑詹之间，坐落在伊朗中部干燥的道路上。城中旧堡建在土丘上，四周有城墙和塔楼；其起源被认为早于伊斯兰时代，后世又有改建。中世纪地理学家称此地为阿班，将它列入与鲁丹有关的地区。沙漠环境使这里夏季炎热，冬季寒冷。

萨法维时期，阿纳尔之名已广泛使用，城堡得到重修并再次投入使用。当地的阿斯塔内和巴亚兹商队旅舍也建于这一时期，后世又经修缮。旅舍的庭院为往来亚兹德与克尔曼各聚落之间的旅人及牲畜提供庇护。城堡与旅舍反映了这座城镇既服务居民，也接待穿越沙漠的过客。

english: Anarak stands at the southern edge of the Dasht-e Kavir, northeast of Nain, amid barren hills and desert plains. The surrounding country is rich in mineral deposits, including copper, silver and antimony. Copper mining here may reach back to pre-Islamic times; old workings followed the veins into the hills, where wind catchers helped ventilate the shafts. The settlement's position at the edge of the great salt desert gives its mining landscape a stark and distinctive setting.
simp_chinese: 阿纳拉克位于纳因东北、达什特卡维尔沙漠南缘，四周是荒山与沙漠平原。当地蕴藏铜、银、锑等矿物，铜矿开采可能早在伊斯兰时代以前便已开始。古老矿坑沿矿脉深入山体，山坡上的风塔为坑道通风。聚落毗邻广阔盐漠，使这一矿业地区的景观显得格外苍凉。

english: Between Anarak and Jandaq, the southern fringe of the Dasht-e Kavir gives way to desert basins and isolated settlements. Anarak lies in a basin near the Kuh-e Ashin, while Jandaq stands at the edge of the great salt desert. Qanats watered fields around Anarak, whose mineral-bearing hills also yielded copper. The arid country between these places formed part of the difficult landscape facing travellers on the Iranian plateau.
simp_chinese: 在阿纳拉克与詹达格之间，大盐漠南缘分布着荒漠盆地与孤立的聚落。阿纳拉克坐落在阿欣山附近的盆地里，詹达格则位于辽阔盐漠的边缘。坎儿井灌溉着阿纳拉克周围的田地，附近含矿的山丘也出产铜。这两地之间的干旱地带，是伊朗高原上的旅人必须面对的艰险地形。

english: Anar Darreh lies in the dry country west of Farah, among low hills and valleys leading toward the Iranian frontier. Its name, meaning pomegranate valley, belongs to a region whose settlements are separated by wide stretches of barren ground. Farther east, the Farah River descends from the Afghan highlands toward the inland lakes of Sistan, sustaining cultivated land along its course.
simp_chinese: 阿纳尔达雷位于法拉赫以西的干旱地带，低矮丘陵和河谷向伊朗边境延伸。地名意为“石榴谷”，当地聚落之间隔着大片荒地。更东面的法拉赫河从阿富汗高地流向锡斯坦内陆湖泊，沿途滋养着耕地。

english: Anasagunticook is one of the recorded names of the Androscoggin, a river that runs through the northern New England interior to meet the Kennebec at Merrymeeting Bay. Eastern Abenaki names distinguished its upper course from the stretch below the Great Falls. The river descends through a succession of falls on its way toward the sea, passing through a country of wooded hills and valleys.
simp_chinese: 阿纳萨甘蒂库克是安德罗斯科金河见于记载的名称之一。这条河流经新英格兰北部内陆，在梅里米廷湾与肯尼贝克河汇合。东阿贝纳基人对河流上游与大瀑布以下的河段有不同的称呼。河水穿过森林覆盖的丘陵与谷地，沿途经过一连串瀑布，逐渐向大海下降。

english:
Anatahan rises from the Pacific about 120 kilometres north of Saipan as an elliptical volcanic island roughly nine kilometres long and four kilometres wide. Its 33.9 square kilometres form the summit of a stratovolcano reaching 790 metres. A caldera 2.3 kilometres across is divided into western and eastern basins, with the eastern portion about 250 metres lower.

The island was first charted by Europeans in late October 1543 by the Spanish navigator Bernardo de la Torre aboard the San Juan de Letrán, and at that time it was settled by Chamorros. In 1695 the Spanish forcibly removed the islanders to Saipan, and three years later to Guam. The island’s steep slopes, volcanic soil and small coast shaped what could be grown and where people could land.
simp_chinese:
阿纳塔汉岛位于塞班岛以北约120公里的太平洋中，是一座长约九公里、宽约四公里的椭圆形火山岛，面积33.9平方公里。岛屿本身是海拔790米的成层火山顶部，拥有直径2.3公里的破火山口；火口分为东西两部分，东侧比西侧低约250米。

1543年10月下旬，西班牙航海家贝尔纳多·德拉托雷乘“圣胡安·德莱特兰”号首次在海图上标出该岛，当时岛上已有查莫罗人居住。1695年，西班牙人强行把岛民迁往塞班，三年后又迁往关岛。陡坡、火山土壤和狭小的海岸线，决定了这里能种什么，人又能在何处登陆。

english: Anatahan is a volcanic island in the Northern Mariana Islands, and its coast faces the open Pacific. The Spanish navigator Bernardo de la Torre first charted it in October 1543, while sailing from Sarangani back toward New Spain aboard the carrack San Juan de Letrán. Guguan, a neighbouring island a short distance to the north, was charted in 1668 by the Spanish missionary Diego Luis de Sanvitores as San Felipe, and it was never colonized.
simp_chinese: 阿纳塔汉是北马里亚纳群岛中的一座火山岛，海岸面向开阔的太平洋。1543年10月，西班牙航海者贝尔纳多·德拉托雷乘“圣胡安德莱特兰”号从萨兰加尼返回新西班牙途中首次测绘了该岛。北面不远的古古安岛于1668年由传教士迭戈·路易斯·德·桑维托雷斯测绘并命名为“圣费利佩”，此后从未殖民。

english: The uplands of the Anadyr basin form a rugged interior of mountain ridges and river valleys in northeastern Siberia. Streams descend from these heights into the Anadyr and its tributaries, including the Yeropol, before reaching the Bering Sea. The severe climate leaves the rivers frozen for much of the year, while the brief summer brings a burst of life to tundra and valley vegetation.
simp_chinese: 阿纳德尔河流域的高地是西伯利亚东北部崎岖的内陆，山脊与河谷交错。溪流从高处流入阿纳德尔河及其支流，包括叶罗波尔河，最终到达白令海。严酷的气候使河流一年中大部分时间封冻，短暂的夏季则让苔原和河谷植被焕发生机。

english:
These Anauls Uplands form part of the eastern Siberian world of the Yukaghir peoples. The Yukaghirs are an Indigenous group of the Russian Far East, living by the eighteenth century in the Sakha Republic and Chukotka Autonomous Okrug. Tundra communities are associated with Nizhnekolymsky District, while Taiga communities also live in Magadan's Srednekansky District. By the seventeenth century, Yukaghir groups ranged across a broad territory from the Lena River to the mouth of the Anadyr.

Within that country, the Anaouls were remembered as sedentary hunters and fishers, using rivers and upland habitats for food and travel. Their subsistence depended on reading seasonal movement and maintaining knowledge of water, game and shelter across difficult northern terrain. The Yukaghirs likely descend from the late Neolithic Ymyyakhtakh culture. Indigenous population fell sharply between the seventeenth and nineteenth centuries under epidemics, internecine war and tsarist colonial policy, while some communities assimilated with Yakuts, Evens and Russians.

The uplands remain associated with a people whose traditional hunting and fishing culture survived through adaptation rather than permanent concentration in towns. The combination of river foods and upland hunting grounds made small communities resilient, but exposed them to the wider pressures brought by imperial expansion.
simp_chinese:
这片阿瑙尔高地属于西伯利亚东部尤卡吉尔人的世界。尤卡吉尔是俄罗斯远东原住民族，如今主要生活在萨哈共和国和楚科奇自治区；苔原社群分布于下科雷姆斯克区，针叶林社群也生活在马加丹中科雷姆斯克区。到十七世纪，尤卡吉尔诸群体活动于从勒拿河到阿纳德尔河口的广大区域。

在这片乡土中，阿瑙尔人以较定居的狩猎者和捕鱼者留下记录，他们依靠河流及高地生境取得食物和通行条件。其生计需要理解季节变化，并掌握艰险北方地形中的水源、猎物与遮蔽知识。尤卡吉尔人被认为源自新石器时代晚期的伊梅亚赫塔赫文化。

十七至十九世纪，疫病、群体冲突和沙俄殖民政策使人口急剧减少，部分社群同化于雅库特人、埃文人和俄罗斯人。高地仍联系着一个依靠适应环境而延续狩猎和捕鱼传统的民族。河流资源与高地猎场相结合，使小社群具备韧性，却也不得不面对帝国扩张带来的更大压力。

english:
The Anauls Uplands belong to the northeastern Siberian country once occupied by Yukaghir peoples. Before Russian colonization, their groups ranged from the Lena River to the mouth of the Anadyr, a distance spanning several severe climatic zones. Within that broad region, the Anaouls are remembered as sedentary hunters and fishers rather than strictly mobile reindeer herders. Such communities needed detailed knowledge of rivers, seasonal fish runs, woodland game and upland refuges.

Their practices tied movement to water and animal cycles, creating small settlements that could shift with conditions without losing access to hunting grounds. Yukaghir traditions also preserve strong spiritual relationships with nature: shamans mediated with ancestral and elemental spirits, while elk and deer hunting carried rituals and taboos. Russian expansion brought pressure from the seventeenth century onward, and epidemics, wars and colonial policies reduced the Indigenous population. Some survivors later adopted Yakut, Even or Russian identities.

The uplands therefore recall a dense web of camps, trails and seasonal foods, much of it remembered through oral tradition rather than monumental settlement. In a region of long distances and severe winters, knowledge of fish runs, animal migration and safe routes mattered as much as any fixed dwelling.
simp_chinese:
阿瑙尔高地属于西伯利亚东北部曾由尤卡吉尔诸民族占据的乡土。俄罗斯殖民以前，他们的活动范围从勒拿河一直延伸到阿纳德尔河口，跨越数个严酷气候带。在这片广大地区里，阿瑙尔人以较定居的狩猎者和捕鱼者为人所记，并非完全逐水草迁徙的驯鹿牧民。

这些社群需要熟悉河流、鱼类洄游、森林猎物和高地避风处，把迁徙与水体及动物周期相连，形成可随环境调整、又不失狩猎地使用权的小聚落。尤卡吉尔传统还保留与自然相关的强烈精神联系：萨满沟通祖灵和自然神灵，猎取驼鹿与鹿群也有仪式和禁忌。十七世纪以后，俄罗斯扩张带来压力，疫病、战争和殖民政策使原住民人口减少，一些幸存者后来接受雅库特、埃文或俄罗斯身份。

高地因此承载着由营地、路径和季节资源组成的密集网络，许多记忆通过口头传统而非大型聚落遗址延续。在距离遥远、冬季严酷的地区，掌握鱼群洄游、动物迁徙与安全路线，与拥有固定住所同样重要。

english:
Anavarza rises from the Cilician plain on a long, imposing rock. Below the fortress lie the remains of ancient Anazarbus, once a major city and the capital of the Roman province of Cilicia Secunda. Its walls, colonnaded streets and monuments testify to a prosperous urban centre, while the height above offered a commanding view across the surrounding plain.

Armenian rulers turned the rocky summit into a formidable stronghold. Prince Toros I made Anavarza a seat of his power in the early twelfth century, and the castle contained churches and chapels associated with the ruling house. The church of Toros reused an inscription from the older Byzantine town, bringing ancient stone into a new Armenian monument. In the fourteenth century Mamluk campaigns destroyed the remaining Armenian kingdom of Cilicia. The ancient city declined, but its walls and the castle on the height continued to mark the plain.
simp_chinese:
阿纳瓦尔扎的修长巨岩高耸于奇里乞亚平原之上。堡垒下方是古代阿纳扎尔布斯的遗址，它曾是重要城市和罗马奇里乞亚第二行省的首府。城墙、柱廊街道与纪念建筑见证了城市昔日的繁荣，山顶则俯瞰四周平原。

亚美尼亚统治者把岩峰建成坚固要塞。十二世纪初，托罗斯一世王子以阿纳瓦尔扎为权力中心，城堡内建有与王室有关的教堂和小礼拜堂。托罗斯教堂重新使用旧拜占庭城镇的一块铭文，将古代石料融入新的亚美尼亚纪念建筑。十四世纪马穆鲁克人的军事行动摧毁了奇里乞亚残存的亚美尼亚王国。古城衰落，但城墙和高处的堡垒仍是平原上的醒目标志。

english: Anavik, also known as Ujarassuit, was a Norse farm above a branch of the Nuuk fjord in Greenland's Western Settlement. Its buildings included a church and a substantial storehouse, signs of a prominent estate among the scattered farms of the region. Across the fjord are deposits of soapstone, a material used to make vessels and lamps. The remains of quarries and workshops show how the stone's resources were used by different peoples in Greenland over a long period.
simp_chinese: 阿纳维克又名乌亚拉苏伊特，是格陵兰北欧西部聚落中一座农场，位于努克峡湾支湾的高地上。建筑包括教堂和坚固仓库，显示它在地区零散农场中地位显著。峡湾对岸有皂石矿，石材可用于制作容器和灯具。采石场与作坊遗迹表明，格陵兰不同人群长期利用了这里的石材资源。

english:
Anaya is a name associated with Indigenous Jamaica in accounts of the island at the time of European arrival. Taíno-speaking communities lived across the island, cultivating cassava and fishing the surrounding waters. Their villages were organized under local leaders, whose names and places entered Spanish records during the first encounters. Anaya is among the names preserved from that Indigenous landscape before the colonial transformation of Jamaica.

The later city of Mandeville lies here.
simp_chinese:
阿纳亚是与欧洲人抵达时牙买加原住民社会相关的名称。讲泰诺语的社群遍布岛屿，种植木薯并在周围水域捕鱼。他们的村落由当地首领领导，首领与地名在最初相遇期间进入西班牙记载。阿纳亚是牙买加殖民变迁之前原住民地域留下的名称之一。

后来的曼德维尔即位于此地。

english:
An Bang was a northeastern frontier region of Đại Việt, encompassing a coast of wooded hills, islands and sheltered waters. Its position connected the Red River delta with the routes towards southern China. In 1466 the Lê court established An Bang as an administrative region. The name later became An Quảng, while the coast and its island ports continued to mark the kingdom's northeastern maritime approaches.

The later city of Hạ Long lies here.
simp_chinese:
安邦是大越东北边地，境内海岸分布着林木山丘、岛屿和受风浪庇护的水域。这里连接红河三角洲与通往中国南方的道路。1466年，黎朝将安邦设为一处行政区域，后来又改称安广。这片海岸及其岛屿港口长期构成王国东北方的海上门户。

后来的下龙市即位于此地。

english: Anbian was a fortified post on the Ming frontier wall in northern Shaanxi. The site was formerly known as Shenjing'er; in 1437 the Ming built forts here and at nearby Dingbian, placing garrisons on the western approaches to the Yansui frontier. The name Anbian expressed the hope of securing the border. The earthen wall ran past the fort across an open landscape of loess and sand, linking it with a series of other fortified posts and beacon towers.
simp_chinese: 安边是陕西北部明代长城沿线的营堡，旧地名深井儿。1437年，明朝同时在此和邻近定边筑堡设营，守卫延绥边防西路。“安边”之名寄托安定边疆之意。土筑长城从营堡旁穿过黄土与沙地，连接其他营堡和烽火台。

english:
The Ancares Range runs southwest from the western end of the Cantabrian Mountains as part of the Galician Massif. It forms a natural boundary between Galicia and Castile and León, while the parallel Serra do Courel continues the mountain country farther south. Cuiña Peak reaches 1,987 metres, and Miravalles and Mustallar rise almost as high. Vegetation follows altitude and drainage.

Willow and European alder line watercourses, while chestnut, ash, hazel, oak and holly grow across the lower slopes. Above 1,600 metres, tree heath, juniper and brushland replace taller woodland. The mountains therefore combined sheltered wooded valleys with open grazing uplands, a contrast that shaped routes and seasonal use. The Ancares were home to isolated rural communities, whose most striking buildings were the pallozas, or casas teito, stone houses with a circular or elliptical plan and an ancient origin. The high passes divide river basins as well as provinces, making Ancares both a barrier and a chain of difficult connections. Pilgrims on the road to Santiago crossed the gap between the Ancares and the Courel at O Cebreiro.
simp_chinese:
安卡雷斯山脉自坎塔布连山脉西端向西南延伸，属于加利西亚山块，并构成加利西亚与卡斯蒂利亚－莱昂之间的自然边界；库雷尔山脉在更南面与它平行。库尼亚峰高1987米，米拉瓦列斯峰和穆斯塔利亚尔峰也几乎同样高。植被随海拔和水分条件变化。

柳树与欧洲桤木沿水道生长，栗树、梣树、榛树、栎树和冬青覆盖较低山坡；一千六百米以上则由石南、杜松和灌丛取代较高森林。山地因此形成有林木遮蔽的谷地与开阔放牧高地，并影响道路和季节性利用。安卡雷斯山中有与外界隔绝的乡村社群，最有特色的建筑是帕略萨，又称特伊托屋，即平面呈圆形或椭圆形的古老石屋。高峻山口既分隔河流与省份，也把安卡雷斯变成障碍与艰难通道并存的山区。前往圣地亚哥的朝圣者在奥塞布雷罗穿过安卡雷斯与库雷尔之间的垭口。

english: Anchau lies east of Zaria in the country of the old kingdom of Zazzau. Local traditions connect its beginnings with people from Bornu: some attribute its foundation to a Kanuri prince, others to traders. These accounts place the settlement on routes linking Bornu to Zazzau and recall the presence of Kanuri families among its rulers and inhabitants. Other traditions describe communities from Bornu taking part in the defence of the eastern frontier against the Jukun. Anchau is one of several settlements in this area whose histories preserve ties between the two kingdoms.
simp_chinese: 安乔位于扎里亚以东，属于古代扎造王国的土地。当地传统把它的起源与来自博尔努的人们联系起来：有的说城镇由一位卡努里王子建立，另有说法称建立者是商人。这些故事将安乔置于连接博尔努与扎造的道路上，也记述了当地统治者和居民中的卡努里家族。另一些传说讲述博尔努来民参与保卫东部边境、抵御朱昆人。安乔是这一带保存着两国联系记忆的若干聚落之一。

sources.title: 343893236 An Assessment of the Borno Factor in the History of Zazzau Before 1900

english:
Anchun belongs to the Ussuri basin, a forested and mountainous region extending through the Russian Far East and southeastern Heilongjiang. The Ussuri rises in the Sikhote-Alin and runs about 897 kilometres north to the Amur near Khabarovsk. Rain supplies most of its water, snowmelt contributes a large share, and springs feed the rest.

Udege and other Tungusic peoples used the valleys for hunting, fishing and seasonal camps. Dense forests held fur-bearing animals, while salmon runs and river fish provided food. Boats and winter trails followed the main channel and tributaries, and trade connected forest communities with Chinese, Manchu and later Russian settlements. The river’s name appeared as “soot-black river” and as “River of Foxes” in local languages.

Severe winter ice and summer floods shaped settlement along the lowlands. The Ussuri joined the Amur corridor and became a route for furs, grain and manufactured goods. Anchun’s identity comes from this broad forest-river landscape of Tungusic communities and seasonal movement rather than from a single fortified town. Salmon runs supplied seasonal abundance. Fish drying and fur preparation supported winter exchange, while river ice opened routes to distant settlements of the lower Amur. Forked channels held fish through winter.
simp_chinese:
安春属于乌苏里江流域，这是横跨俄罗斯远东和黑龙江东南部的森林山地地区。乌苏里江发源于锡霍特山脉，向北流约八百九十七公里，在哈巴罗夫斯克附近入阿穆尔河。降雨提供大部分水量，融雪占很大比例，泉流补给余下部分。

乌德盖人和其他通古斯族群利用谷地狩猎、捕鱼和设置季节营地。密林栖息毛皮兽，鲑鱼洄游与河鱼提供食物。船只和冬季小径沿主河及支流延伸，贸易把森林社群同中国、满洲及后来的俄国聚落连接。河名在地方语言中有“乌黑之河”和“狐河”等含义。

严冬冰封和夏季洪水塑造沿岸低地聚落。乌苏里江汇入阿穆尔河走廊，成为毛皮、粮食和制成品路线。安春身份来自通古斯社群和季节迁徙构成的广阔森林河流景观，而非单一设防城镇。鲑鱼洄游带来季节丰饶，河岸聚落以鱼干和兽皮交换布匹与铁器。晒鱼和整理毛皮支持冬季交换，河冰又打开通往阿穆尔河下游远方聚落的道路。分汊水道在冬季保有鱼类。

english: Ancuase lies beside the lower Zambezi, upstream of Sena. The river spreads around islands here, its channels changing with the seasons. On its northern bank lived Maganja communities of the Maravi tradition, while the wider valley was home to free cultivators and enslaved people. The lands of Ancuase later formed one of the prazos, estates that grew along the Zambezi under Portuguese claims and local authority.
simp_chinese: 安夸塞位于赞比西河下游，处在塞纳的上游。河水在这一带绕过岛屿，河道随季节变化。北岸居住着具有马拉维传统的马甘贾社群，更广阔的河谷里还有自由耕作者和被奴役的人。安夸塞的土地后来成为赞比西河沿岸的一处普拉佐庄园，这些庄园在葡萄牙的声索和当地权力之下逐渐发展。

english:
Ancud stands on the northern coast of Chiloé, overlooking the waters that separate the island from the mainland. Its sheltered position made it an important harbour and a place from which to guard the approaches to the archipelago. The surrounding island was home to indigenous communities before the arrival of the Spanish.

In 1768 Governor Carlos de Beranger founded the fortified villa of San Carlos de Chiloé, bringing settlers from Chacao. Forts around the bay, including San Carlos and San Miguel de Agüi, formed part of a defensive system protecting shipping and the Spanish possessions in the south. Beranger designed and built San Carlos between 1768 and 1771; the fort marked the site around which the new town grew. Agüi was begun in 1779, initially using timber and fascines. From 1784 the town was the seat of the intendancy of Chiloé, administered under the Viceroyalty of Peru.

Chiloé remained a royalist stronghold during the wars of independence. An expedition under Antonio Pareja sailed from the island in 1813, while later Chilean campaigns sought to capture it. The Chilean commander Ramón Freire directed the final expedition against the strongly defended town itself. After fighting at Pudeto and Bellavista in 1826, the Treaty of Tantauco brought the archipelago under Chilean rule. In 1834 San Carlos received the name Ancud and became a city.
simp_chinese:
安库德位于奇洛埃岛北岸，俯瞰将岛屿与大陆分开的水域。避风的地势使这里成为重要港口，也便于守卫通向群岛的航道。西班牙人到来之前，岛上已有原住民社群居住。

1768年，总督卡洛斯·德贝兰赫建立设防的圣卡洛斯德奇洛埃镇，并从查考迁来居民。海湾周围的圣卡洛斯、圣米格尔德阿圭等堡垒组成防御体系，保护航运和西班牙在南方的属地。贝兰赫在1768年至1771年间设计和建造圣卡洛斯堡，新镇围绕它发展。阿圭堡于1779年动工，最初使用木材和柴捆修筑。1784年起，这座城镇成为奇洛埃行政区的所在地，隶属秘鲁总督辖区。

独立战争期间，奇洛埃仍是保王派据点。1813年，安东尼奥·帕雷哈率领远征队从岛上出发；此后智利军队多次试图夺取群岛。智利指挥官拉蒙·弗莱雷率领最后一次远征，直接进攻防守严密的城镇。1826年普德托和贝亚维斯塔战斗后，坦陶科条约使群岛归入智利。1834年，圣卡洛斯改名安库德并获得城市地位。

english: The Gulf of Ancud lies between the island of Chiloé and the mountainous Chilean mainland. Channels, islands and deep inlets form a sheltered inland sea, though strong tides move through the narrow passages connecting it to the Pacific. Indigenous navigators traveled these waters in canoes long before Spanish settlement began in Chiloé in 1567. Sea routes remained essential to the communities scattered across the archipelago and its deeply indented shores.
simp_chinese: 安库德湾位于奇洛埃岛与智利多山的大陆之间。水道、岛屿和深湾组成一片受庇护的内海，但连接太平洋的狭窄通道中潮流强劲。1567年西班牙人开始在奇洛埃定居之前很久，原住民航海者便乘独木舟往来于这些水域。海路始终是散居群岛和曲折海岸的社区的重要交通方式。

sources.title: La canoa de Chaicura y la navegación de tradición indígena en Chiloé.pdf

english:
The Andagua volcanic field fills a long, narrow valley in southern Peru with cinder cones, lava domes and lava-flow fields. The Valley of the Volcanoes stretches about sixty kilometres and descends toward the Colca River, with high mountains flanking its floor. Most vents lie within the valley or on its sides, their alignment following faults in the landscape. Activity spans the Pleistocene and Holocene. Chilcayoc Grande erupted between 1451 and 1523, and the youngest event, at Chilcayoc Chico, is dated to about 1650.

Lava has repeatedly altered drainage.
